def get_position_qty(conn: sqlite3.Connection, ticker: str) -> float:
    """Retourne la quantité détenue (0 si pas de position)."""
    row = conn.execute(
        """SELECT pp.quantity FROM portfolio_positions pp
           JOIN instruments i ON i.id = pp.instrument_id
           WHERE i.ticker = ?""",
        (ticker,)
    ).fetchone()
    return row["quantity"] if row else 0.0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Execution Cycle
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

DEFAULT_BROKER = PaperBroker(slippage_pct=0.001, fee_per_share=0.005)


def create_and_execute_order(conn, instrument_id, thesis_id, side, quantity,
                              order_type="market", limit_price=None,
                              broker=DEFAULT_BROKER) -> dict:
    price_row = conn.execute(
        """SELECT p.close FROM prices p
           JOIN instruments i ON i.id = p.instrument_id
           WHERE p.instrument_id = ?
           ORDER BY p.date DESC LIMIT 1""",
        (instrument_id,)
    ).fetchone()

    if not price_row:
        return {"success": False, "reason": "No price data for instrument"}

    current_price   = price_row[0]
    effective_price = limit_price if (order_type == "limit" and limit_price) else current_price

    risk_result = check_order(conn, instrument_id, thesis_id, side, quantity, effective_price)

    order_id = conn.execute(
        """INSERT INTO orders
               (instrument_id, thesis_id, side, quantity, order_type, limit_price,
                status, risk_check_result)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
        (instrument_id, thesis_id, side, quantity, order_type, limit_price,
         "pending_validation" if risk_result["approved"] else "rejected",
         json.dumps(risk_result))
    ).lastrowid

    log_event(conn, "order_created", "order", order_id, {
        "instrument_id": instrument_id, "side": side, "quantity": quantity,
        "risk_action": risk_result["action"],
    }, agent="ExecutionEngine")

    if not risk_result["approved"]:
        conn.execute("UPDATE orders SET status = 'rejected' WHERE id = ?", (order_id,))
        return {
            "success": False, "order_id": order_id,
            "reason": "Risk check rejected order", "risk_check": risk_result,
        }

    approved_qty = risk_result["approved_quantity"]
    conn.execute("UPDATE orders SET quantity = ? WHERE id = ?",
                 (approved_qty, order_id))

    return {
        "success": True, "order_id": order_id,
        "status": "pending_validation", "risk_check": risk_result,
    }


# =============================================================================
# TARGET WEIGHTS — table portfolio_targets (v6.1)
# =============================================================================
# v6.1 : on persiste les targets dans une vraie table portfolio_targets.
# Schéma : (ticker UNIQUE, target_weight_pct REAL, active INTEGER, source TEXT,
#           updated_at TEXT). Seed automatique si la table est vide.
# =============================================================================

DEFAULT_TARGET_WEIGHTS = {
    # Valeurs alignées avec ce qu'affiche l'UI "Portfolio idéal" (mai 2026).
    # Modifiables à chaud via POST /api/targets ou directement en SQL.
    "META": 2.0,
    "LINK": 1.0,
    "ETH": 0.8,
    "BTC": 1.0,
}


def _ensure_portfolio_targets_table(conn) -> None:
    """Crée la table portfolio_targets si absente et seed les valeurs par défaut.

    Idempotent : peut être appelé à chaque cycle, ne touche pas aux données
    existantes. Le seed n'a lieu qu'à la toute première exécution
    (table fraîchement créée et vide).
    """
    try:
        conn.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS portfolio_targets (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                ticker TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                target_weight_pct REAL NOT NULL,
                active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                source TEXT DEFAULT 'manual',
                updated_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
            )
        """)
        conn.commit()

        # Seed uniquement si vide
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM portfolio_targets"
        ).fetchone()
        n_existing = row["n"] if row else 0
        if n_existing == 0:
            conn.executemany(
                """INSERT INTO portfolio_targets
                   (ticker, target_weight_pct, active, source)
                   VALUES (?, ?, 1, 'seed_v6_1')""",
                [(t, w) for t, w in DEFAULT_TARGET_WEIGHTS.items()],
            )
            conn.commit()
            print(f"[targets] Table portfolio_targets seed\u00e9e avec "
                  f"{len(DEFAULT_TARGET_WEIGHTS)} tickers : "
                  f"{', '.join(DEFAULT_TARGET_WEIGHTS.keys())}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[targets] WARN : impossible de cr\u00e9er/seeder portfolio_targets : {e}")


def _load_target_weights(conn) -> dict:
    """Récupère les target_weights actifs depuis portfolio_targets.

    Retourne un dict {ticker: pct} ou {} si rien de trouvable.
    Ordre de priorité :
      1) Table portfolio_targets (source de vérité v6.1+)
      2) Fallback : colonne target_weights_json dans theses (legacy)
    """
    # Assurance : la table existe (idempotent, pas coûteux)
    _ensure_portfolio_targets_table(conn)

    # Source 1 — table dédiée (priorité absolue)
    try:
        rows = conn.execute(
            """SELECT ticker, target_weight_pct FROM portfolio_targets
               WHERE active = 1 AND target_weight_pct IS NOT NULL"""
        ).fetchall()
        if rows:
            return {r["ticker"]: float(r["target_weight_pct"]) for r in rows}
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Source 2 — fallback legacy depuis theses
    try:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT target_weights_json FROM theses "
            "WHERE target_weights_json IS NOT NULL "
            "ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1"
        ).fetchone()
        if row and row[0]:
            return json.loads(row[0])
    except Exception:
        pass

    return {}


def set_target_weight(conn, ticker: str, target_pct: float,
                     source: str = "manual") -> dict:
    """Helper public : insère ou met à jour le target d'un ticker.

    Utilisable depuis un endpoint API (ex. POST /api/targets) ou un script.
    Retourne l'état après écriture.
    """
    _ensure_portfolio_targets_table(conn)
    conn.execute("""
        INSERT INTO portfolio_targets (ticker, target_weight_pct, active, source, updated_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, 1, ?, datetime('now'))
        ON CONFLICT(ticker) DO UPDATE SET
          target_weight_pct = excluded.target_weight_pct,
          active            = 1,
          source            = excluded.source,
          updated_at        = datetime('now')
    """, (ticker.upper().strip(), float(target_pct), source))
    conn.commit()
    return {
        "ticker": ticker.upper().strip(),
        "target_weight_pct": float(target_pct),
        "source": source,
    }



def _build_target_gap_proposals(conn, total_value, existing_proposals, regime):
    """v6.4 — Génère des propositions synthétiques pour combler l'écart entre
    portfolio_targets (cibles de PortfolioConstructionAgent) et le portefeuille
    actuel.

    Pipeline :
      1. Lit portfolio_targets WHERE active=1
      2. Pour chaque ticker, calcule cible_pct − actuel_pct
      3. Si |delta| > TARGET_GAP_MIN_DELTA_PCT, crée une proposition synthétique
      4. Si un agent tactique a déjà proposé le même ticker du même côté, fusionne
         (garde le max des deux qty_pct) au lieu de doublonner.

    Args:
        conn : sqlite3.Connection
        total_value : NAV courant (float)
        existing_proposals : liste des propositions déjà générées par les agents
        regime : 'BUILD' | 'MAINTAIN' | 'REBALANCE'

    Returns:
        (synthetic_proposals, merged_proposals, stats) :
          * synthetic_proposals : nouvelles propositions à ajouter au flux
          * merged_proposals    : existing_proposals modifiées in-place (pour info)
          * stats : dict {n_buy_inj, n_sell_inj, n_merged, n_skipped_small, gap_total_pct}
    """
    stats = {
        "n_buy_inj": 0, "n_sell_inj": 0, "n_merged": 0,
        "n_skipped_small": 0, "gap_total_pct": 0.0,
        "n_conflict_resolved": 0,
    }
    synthetic = []

    # 1. Charger targets actifs
    targets = _load_target_weights(conn)
    if not targets:
        print("[target_gap] aucune cible active dans portfolio_targets — skip")
        return synthetic, existing_proposals, stats

    # 2. Charger positions actuelles + prix
    positions = {}
    prices = {}
    for r in conn.execute("""
        SELECT i.ticker, p.quantity, p.current_price
        FROM portfolio_positions p
        JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.id
    """).fetchall():
        tkr = r["ticker"]
        qty = float(r["quantity"] or 0)
        cp  = float(r["current_price"] or 0)
        positions[tkr] = qty
        if cp > 0:
            prices[tkr] = cp

    # 3. Compléter prices pour les tickers cibles non détenus
    missing_tkrs = [t for t in targets.keys() if t not in prices]
    if missing_tkrs:
        for tkr in missing_tkrs:
            row = conn.execute("""
                SELECT p.close FROM prices p
                JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.id
                WHERE i.ticker = ?
                ORDER BY p.date DESC LIMIT 1
            """, (tkr,)).fetchone()
            if row and row[0]:
                prices[tkr] = float(row[0])

    # 4. Index des propositions existantes par ticker (pour merge)
    by_ticker_side = {}  # (ticker, side) -> proposal
    for p in existing_proposals:
        key = (p.get("ticker"), p.get("side"))
        by_ticker_side[key] = p

    # 5. Boucle sur chaque cible
    for ticker, target_pct in targets.items():
        price = prices.get(ticker)
        if not price or price <= 0:
            print(f"[target_gap]   {ticker:<6} skip : pas de prix disponible")
            continue

        held_qty   = positions.get(ticker, 0.0)
        actual_val = held_qty * price
        actual_pct = (actual_val / total_value) * 100 if total_value > 0 else 0
        delta_pct  = target_pct - actual_pct
        stats["gap_total_pct"] += abs(delta_pct)

        # Seuil minimal
        if abs(delta_pct) < TARGET_GAP_MIN_DELTA_PCT:
            stats["n_skipped_small"] += 1
            continue

        side = "buy" if delta_pct > 0 else "sell"
        # quantité cible : on comble le delta entier (choix utilisateur : 1 cycle)
        delta_val = abs(delta_pct) / 100 * total_value
        qty       = math.floor(delta_val / price)

        # Pour les SELL, plafonner à la position détenue
        if side == "sell":
            qty = int(min(qty, math.floor(held_qty)))

        if qty <= 0:
            print(f"[target_gap]   {ticker:<6} skip : qty=0 (delta={delta_pct:+.2f}% px={price:.2f})")
            continue

        # Créer la proposition synthétique
        synth_prop = {
            "thesis_id":     None,                    # pas de thèse rattachée
            "ticker":        ticker,
            "side":          side,
            "quantity_pct":  abs(delta_pct),          # delta en % NAV
            "source":        "TargetGap",             # tag
            "agent_type":    "PortfolioConstructionAgent",
            "conviction":    TARGET_GAP_CONVICTION,   # 8.0
            "conviction_raw": TARGET_GAP_CONVICTION,
            "regime_mult":   1.0,                     # pas d'atténuation régime
            "reason":        f"Gap to target {delta_pct:+.2f}% NAV (cible {target_pct:.2f}% − actuel {actual_pct:.2f}%)",
        }
        if side == "sell":
            synth_prop["max_qty"] = held_qty

        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
        # v6.5 CLEANUP : résolution des conflits de sens opposé
        # Si TargetGap veut SELL et qu'un agent a un BUY (ou vice-versa),
        # on résout par conviction AVANT que le Reconciler ne le voie.
        # Cela évite les doublons Order/Fill observés en v6.4.
        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
        opposite_side = "buy" if side == "sell" else "sell"
        conflict_prop = by_ticker_side.get((ticker, opposite_side))
        if conflict_prop is not None:
            agent_conv = float(conflict_prop.get("conviction", 0))
            tg_conv    = float(synth_prop["conviction"])  # TARGET_GAP_CONVICTION = 8.0
            if tg_conv > agent_conv:
                # TargetGap gagne : on KEEP le sens TargetGap
                # et on RETIRE la proposition agent conflictuelle du flux
                existing_proposals[:] = [
                    p for p in existing_proposals if p is not conflict_prop
                ]
                # Mettre aussi à jour l'index local
                by_ticker_side.pop((ticker, opposite_side), None)
                stats["n_conflict_resolved"] += 1
                print(
                    f"[target_gap_dedup]   {ticker:<6} conflit SELL/BUY résolu "
                    f"en faveur TargetGap (conv TG={tg_conv:.1f} > agent={agent_conv:.1f}) "
                    f"— proposition agent {conflict_prop.get('source','?')} retirée"
                )
            else:
                # Agent gagne : on SKIP le SELL synthétique
                stats["n_conflict_resolved"] += 1
                print(
                    f"[target_gap_dedup]   {ticker:<6} conflit SELL/BUY résolu "
                    f"en faveur agent (conv agent={agent_conv:.1f} >= TG={tg_conv:.1f}) "
                    f"— SELL synthétique TargetGap ignoré"
                )
                continue  # on ne pousse pas le SELL synthétique

        # Fusion : si un agent a déjà proposé le même ticker/side, on garde le max
        existing = by_ticker_side.get((ticker, side))
        if existing is not None:
            existing_qty_pct = float(existing.get("quantity_pct", 0))
            if abs(delta_pct) > existing_qty_pct:
                # le gap est plus gros que ce que l'agent propose → élever la qty
                existing["quantity_pct"] = abs(delta_pct)
                existing["reason"] = (existing.get("reason") or "") + f" | merged TargetGap +{delta_pct:+.2f}%"
                # garder un floor de conviction à 8.0 pour bénéficier des overrides
                if float(existing.get("conviction", 0)) < TARGET_GAP_CONVICTION:
                    existing["conviction"] = TARGET_GAP_CONVICTION
                stats["n_merged"] += 1
                print(f"[target_gap]   {ticker:<6} {side.upper()} MERGED → qty_pct={abs(delta_pct):.2f}% (agent={existing.get('source')})")
            else:
                stats["n_merged"] += 1
                print(f"[target_gap]   {ticker:<6} {side.upper()} déjà couvert par {existing.get('source')} (qty_pct={existing_qty_pct:.2f}% >= delta {abs(delta_pct):.2f}%)")
            continue

        # Sinon, on ajoute une nouvelle proposition synthétique
        synthetic.append(synth_prop)
        if side == "buy":
            stats["n_buy_inj"] += 1
        else:
            stats["n_sell_inj"] += 1
        print(f"[target_gap]   {ticker:<6} {side.upper():<4} qty={qty:<6} ({abs(delta_pct):+.2f}% NAV) — {synth_prop['reason']}")

    return synthetic, existing_proposals, stats


def _build_reconciler_context(conn, total_value, proposals):
    """Construit current_positions, prices, target_weights pour le Reconciler."""
    current_pos = {}
    prices = {}

    # Positions actuelles + leur current_price
    for r in conn.execute("""
        SELECT i.ticker, p.quantity, p.current_price
        FROM portfolio_positions p
        JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.id
    """).fetchall():
        try:
            current_pos[r["ticker"]] = r["quantity"] or 0
            if r["current_price"]:
                prices[r["ticker"]] = r["current_price"]
        except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError):
            pass

    # Compléter prices avec les derniers close pour les tickers proposés non détenus
    proposed_tickers = {p["ticker"] for p in proposals if p.get("ticker")}
    missing = proposed_tickers - set(prices.keys())
    for tkr in missing:
        row = conn.execute("""
            SELECT p.close FROM prices p
            JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.id
            WHERE i.ticker = ?
            ORDER BY p.date DESC LIMIT 1
        """, (tkr,)).fetchone()
        if row:
            prices[tkr] = row[0]

    target_weights = _load_target_weights(conn)
    return current_pos, prices, target_weights


def _enrich_proposals_with_conviction(proposals, agent_results):
    """Ajoute conviction dans chaque proposal en lookant agent_results."""
    # Index : thesis_id → conviction
    thesis_conv = {}
    for agent_key in ("factor", "microstructure", "crypto", "altdata"):
        for item in agent_results.get(agent_key, []) or []:
            tid = item.get("thesis_id")
            if tid is not None:
                thesis_conv[tid] = item.get("conviction", 0)

    for p in proposals:
        if "conviction" not in p:
            p["conviction"] = thesis_conv.get(p.get("thesis_id"), 0)
    return proposals


def run_decision_cycle(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> dict:
    """
    Decision cycle PATCHED 2026-05-22 + 2026-05-24 :
      - conviction >= 5
      - FactorAgent overweight  → BUY (toujours)
      - FactorAgent underweight → SELL UNIQUEMENT si position détenue
      - MicrostructureAgent sell signal → SELL UNIQUEMENT si position détenue
      - CryptoAgent strong_buy/buy/accumulate → BUY ; sell/take_profit → SELL si tenu
      - OrderReconciler : déduplique conflits, drop bruit < 0,3 % NAV,
        bypass conviction >= 9
    """
    from agents import run_all_agents
    from memo_generator import generate_ic_memo

    print("[execution] Starting decision cycle...")

    # Step 1: Run agents
    agent_results = run_all_agents(conn)
    conn.commit()

    proposals = []

    # ----- FactorAgent -----
    for item in agent_results.get("factor", []):
        conv   = item.get("conviction", 0)
        tilt   = item.get("tilt")
        ticker = item.get("ticker")
        if conv < CONVICTION_THRESHOLD:
            continue

        if tilt == "overweight":
            proposals.append({
                "thesis_id": item["thesis_id"], "ticker": ticker,
                "side": "buy", "quantity_pct": FACTOR_POSITION_PCT,
                "source": "FactorAgent",
                "conviction": conv,
            })
        elif tilt == "underweight":
            held_qty = get_position_qty(conn, ticker)
            if held_qty > 0:
                proposals.append({
                    "thesis_id": item["thesis_id"], "ticker": ticker,
                    "side": "sell", "quantity_pct": FACTOR_POSITION_PCT,
                    "source": "FactorAgent",
                    "max_qty": held_qty,
                    "conviction": conv,
                })
            else:
                print(f"[execution] Skip SELL {ticker}: no position held (underweight thesis ignored)")

    # ----- MicrostructureAgent -----
    for item in agent_results.get("microstructure", []):
        conv   = item.get("conviction", 0)
        signal = item.get("signal", "").lower()
        ticker = item.get("ticker")
        if conv < CONVICTION_THRESHOLD:
            continue

        if "buy" in signal:
            proposals.append({
                "thesis_id": item["thesis_id"], "ticker": ticker,
                "side": "buy", "quantity_pct": MICRO_POSITION_PCT,
                "source": "MicrostructureAgent",
                "conviction": conv,
            })
        elif "sell" in signal or "reduce" in signal:
            held_qty = get_position_qty(conn, ticker)
            if held_qty > 0:
                proposals.append({
                    "thesis_id": item["thesis_id"], "ticker": ticker,
                    "side": "sell", "quantity_pct": MICRO_POSITION_PCT,
                    "source": "MicrostructureAgent",
                    "max_qty": held_qty,
                    "conviction": conv,
                })
            else:
                print(f"[execution] Skip SELL {ticker}: no position held (micro signal ignored)")

    # ----- CryptoAgent -----
    for item in agent_results.get("crypto", []):
        conv   = item.get("conviction", 0)
        signal = item.get("signal", "").lower()
        ticker = item.get("ticker")
        if conv < CONVICTION_THRESHOLD:
            continue

        if signal in ("strong_buy", "buy", "accumulate"):
            qty_pct = MICRO_POSITION_PCT * 2 if signal == "strong_buy" else MICRO_POSITION_PCT
            proposals.append({
                "thesis_id": item["thesis_id"], "ticker": ticker,
                "side": "buy", "quantity_pct": qty_pct,
                "source": "CryptoAgent",
                "conviction": conv,
            })
        elif signal in ("sell", "take_profit"):
            held_qty = get_position_qty(conn, ticker)
            if held_qty > 0:
                proposals.append({
                    "thesis_id": item["thesis_id"], "ticker": ticker,
                    "side": "sell", "quantity_pct": MICRO_POSITION_PCT,
                    "source": "CryptoAgent",
                    "max_qty": held_qty,
                    "conviction": conv,
                })
            else:
                print(f"[execution] Skip SELL {ticker}: no position held (crypto signal ignored)")

    # Step 2 : Compute NAV
    portfolio_state = conn.execute(
        "SELECT total_value, cash FROM portfolio_state WHERE id = 1"
    ).fetchone()
    total_value = portfolio_state["total_value"] if portfolio_state else 1_000_000

    # cycle_id partagé par ExitAgent, PortfolioRegime et Reconciler
    cycle_id = datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")

    # ============================================================
    # Step 2.3 : DÉTECTION DU RÉGIME DE PORTEFEUILLE (NEW — v6)
    # ============================================================
    # Calcule BUILD / MAINTAIN / REBALANCE selon % investi du NAV.
    # Sera appliqué après l'ExitAgent (pour atténuer les exit proposals)
    # et avant le Reconciler.
    try:
        regime_info = detect_portfolio_regime(conn)
        print(f"[regime] Régime détecté : {regime_info['regime']} "
              f"(invested={regime_info['invested_pct']:.2f} %, "
              f"NAV={regime_info['nav']:.0f}, cash={regime_info['cash']:.0f}, "
              f"positions={regime_info['n_positions']})")
    except Exception as e:
        import traceback
        print(f"[regime] ERREUR détection — fallback MAINTAIN : {e}")
        traceback.print_exc()
        regime_info = {"regime": "MAINTAIN", "invested_pct": 50.0,
                       "nav": total_value, "cash": 0.0, "n_positions": 0}

    # ============================================================
    # Step 2.4 : EXIT AGENT (patch 2026-05-24 b / v5)
    # ============================================================
    # Examine les positions ouvertes et émet SL / TP / DRIFT / TIME_DECAY.
    # En régime BUILD, les exit proposals seront atténués par le mult ×0.3
    # appliqué au Step 2.45.
    try:
        targets_cache = _load_target_weights(conn)
        exit_proposals = run_exit_agent(
            conn, cycle_id=cycle_id,
            targets=targets_cache, nav=total_value
        )
        if exit_proposals:
            print(f"[execution] ExitAgent : {len(exit_proposals)} signal(s) ajouté(s)")
            proposals.extend(exit_proposals)
    except Exception as e:
        import traceback
        print(f"[exit_agent] ERREUR (non bloquant) : {e}")
        traceback.print_exc()

    # ============================================================
    # Step 2.42 : TARGET GAP SYNTHESIZER (NEW — v6.4)
    # ============================================================
    # Lit portfolio_targets et génère des propositions synthétiques pour
    # combler tout écart > 0.30 % NAV avec les positions actuelles.
    # Doit tourner APRÈS les agents (pour pouvoir fusionner avec leurs
    # propositions) et AVANT le régime (pour bénéficier des caps).
    try:
        gap_synth, _, gap_stats = _build_target_gap_proposals(
            conn, total_value, proposals,
            regime=regime_info.get("regime", "MAINTAIN"),
        )
        if gap_synth:
            proposals.extend(gap_synth)
        print(
            f"[target_gap] {gap_stats['n_buy_inj']} BUY synthétiques, "
            f"{gap_stats['n_sell_inj']} SELL synthétiques, "
            f"{gap_stats['n_merged']} fusions avec agents, "
            f"{gap_stats['n_skipped_small']} écart(s) sous le seuil 0.30 % — "
            f"gap total |Δ|={gap_stats['gap_total_pct']:.2f} % — "
            f"{gap_stats['n_conflict_resolved']} conflit(s) BUY/SELL résolu(s) [v6.5]"
        )
    except Exception as e:
        import traceback
        print(f"[target_gap] ERREUR (non bloquant) : {e}")
        traceback.print_exc()

    # ============================================================
    # Step 2.45 : APPLICATION DU RÉGIME (NEW — v6)
    # ============================================================
    # 1) Enrichit chaque proposal avec sa conviction brute (depuis agent_results)
    # 2) Applique le multiplicateur (régime × agent_type) sur la conviction
    # 3) Plafonne la taille des SELL en % de la position détenue
    # 4) Plafonne la taille des BUY au target × overshoot
    # 5) Log dans regime_log
    try:
        proposals = _enrich_proposals_with_conviction(proposals, agent_results)
        targets_for_regime = _load_target_weights(conn) or {}
        regime_stats = apply_regime_to_proposals(
            conn, proposals, regime_info, target_weights=targets_for_regime
        )
        log_regime(conn, cycle_id, regime_info, regime_stats,
                   notes=f"v6 — {regime_stats['n_attenuated']} att., "
                         f"{regime_stats['n_sell_capped']} SELL capped, "
                         f"{regime_stats['n_buy_capped']} BUY capped")
        if regime_stats["n_sell_capped"] or regime_stats["n_buy_capped"] \
           or regime_stats["n_attenuated"]:
            print(f"[regime] {regime_info['regime']} appliqué : "
                  f"{regime_stats['n_attenuated']} convictions ajustées, "
                  f"{regime_stats['n_sell_capped']} SELL plafonnés, "
                  f"{regime_stats['n_buy_capped']} BUY plafonnés")
            # Trace détaillée des proposals modifiés
            for p in proposals:
                if p.get("cap_reason"):
                    print(f"[regime]   {p.get('ticker')} {p.get('side','').upper()}"
                          f" — {p['cap_reason']}")
                if abs(float(p.get("regime_mult", 1.0)) - 1.0) > 1e-9:
                    print(f"[regime]   {p.get('ticker')} {p.get('side','').upper()}"
                          f" {p.get('agent_type','?')} : conv "
                          f"{p.get('conviction_raw',0):.1f} × {p.get('regime_mult'):.2f}"
                          f" = {p.get('conviction',0):.2f}")
    except Exception as e:
        import traceback
        print(f"[regime] ERREUR application (non bloquant) : {e}")
        traceback.print_exc()

    # ============================================================
    # Step 2.5 : RECONCILIATION (patch 2026-05-24 a)
    # ============================================================
    proposals_before = len(proposals)
    try:
        # _enrich_proposals_with_conviction est idempotent — déjà appelé en 2.45
        # mais on le rappelle au cas où des proposals auraient été ajoutés ailleurs
        proposals = _enrich_proposals_with_conviction(proposals, agent_results)
        current_pos, prices_map, target_weights = _build_reconciler_context(
            conn, total_value, proposals
        )

        reconciler = OrderReconciler(
            conn=conn,
            nav=total_value,
            current_positions=current_pos,
            target_weights=target_weights,
            prices=prices_map,
            regime=regime_info.get("regime", "MAINTAIN"),  # v6.1 : Reconciler régime-aware
        )
        proposals = reconciler.reconcile(proposals, cycle_id=cycle_id)
        print(
            f"[reconciler] {proposals_before} proposals → {len(proposals)} après réconciliation"
            f" (cycle_id={cycle_id})"
        )
    except Exception as e:
        import traceback
        print(f"[reconciler] ERREUR : {e} — fallback : proposals inchangées")
        traceback.print_exc()
    # ============================================================

    # Step 3 & 4 : create pending orders
    _ = cycle_id  # cycle_id déjà défini plus haut (Step 2)
    pending_orders = []
    for proposal in proposals:
        inst = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM instruments WHERE ticker = ?", (proposal["ticker"],)
        ).fetchone()
        if not inst:
            continue

        price_row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT close FROM prices WHERE instrument_id = ? ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1",
            (inst["id"],)
        ).fetchone()
        if not price_row:
            continue

        price = price_row[0]
        target_value = total_value * (proposal["quantity_pct"] / 100)
        quantity = math.floor(target_value / price)

        # FIX : pour les SELL, plafonner à la position détenue
        if proposal["side"] == "sell" and "max_qty" in proposal:
            quantity = int(min(quantity, math.floor(proposal["max_qty"])))

        if quantity <= 0:
            continue

        # v6.4 — si la proposition est synthétique (TargetGap), créer une
        # thèse PortfolioConstructionAgent pour garder un audit propre
        if proposal.get("thesis_id") is None and proposal.get("source") == "TargetGap":
            synth_thesis_id = conn.execute("""
                INSERT INTO theses
                  (instrument_id, agent_type, thesis_text, conviction_score,
                   horizon, key_drivers, proposed_action, status,
                   created_at, updated_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'active',
                        datetime('now'), datetime('now'))
            """, (
                inst["id"],
                "PortfolioConstructionAgent",
                f"TargetGap synth: {proposal.get('reason', '')}",
                float(proposal.get("conviction", TARGET_GAP_CONVICTION)),
                "medium",
                "portfolio_targets gap",
                f"{proposal['side'].upper()} {proposal['ticker']} "
                f"to close target gap ({proposal.get('quantity_pct', 0):.2f}% NAV)",
            )).lastrowid
            proposal["thesis_id"] = synth_thesis_id
            conn.commit()
            print(f"[target_gap]   synth thesis id={synth_thesis_id} créée pour {proposal['ticker']} {proposal['side'].upper()}")

        result = create_and_execute_order(
            conn, inst["id"], proposal["thesis_id"],
            proposal["side"], quantity, broker=DEFAULT_BROKER
        )
        pending_orders.append({
            "ticker": proposal["ticker"], "side": proposal["side"],
            "quantity": quantity, "status": result.get("status", "rejected"),
            "order_id": result.get("order_id"), "result": result,
        })
        conn.commit()

    memo_id = generate_ic_memo(conn, agent_results)
    conn.commit()

    orders_pending = len([o for o in pending_orders if o["status"] == "pending_validation"])
    print(f"[execution] Cycle complete: {orders_pending} orders pending validation, memo_id={memo_id}")

    return {
        "agent_results": {
            "macro_stance":  agent_results["macro"].get("stance"),
            "factor_theses": len(agent_results["factor"]),
            "micro_theses":  len(agent_results["microstructure"]),
            "alt_theses":    len(agent_results["altdata"]),
        },
        "orders_pending": orders_pending,
        "orders": pending_orders,
        "memo_id": memo_id,
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    from models import init_db
    init_db()
    conn = get_db()
    result = run_decision_cycle(conn)
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    print(f"Decision cycle result: {result}")

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    print("[startup] Initializing database...")
    init_db()
    print("[startup] Initializing users table...")
    init_users_table()
    print("[startup] Seeding demo data...")
    seed()
    print("[startup] Starting geopolitical data pre-fetch (background)...")
    data_geopolitical.start_background_fetch()

    # ---- Scheduled refresh (APScheduler) ----
    from apscheduler.schedulers.background import BackgroundScheduler
    scheduler = BackgroundScheduler()

    def refresh_prices():
        """Refresh price data for all instruments, then update portfolio."""
        try:
            print("[scheduler] Refreshing prices...")
            data_ingestion.run_ingestion(period="5d")
            print("[scheduler] Prices refreshed. Updating portfolio...")
            _update_portfolio_from_latest_prices()
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[scheduler] Price refresh error: {e}")

    def refresh_macro():
        """Force-refresh macro dashboard (clear cache)."""
        try:
            print("[scheduler] Refreshing macro data...")
            data_macro._cache["data"] = None
            data_macro._cache["timestamp"] = None
            data_macro.fetch_vulnerability_dashboard(force_refresh=True)
            print("[scheduler] Macro data refreshed.")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[scheduler] Macro refresh error: {e}")

    def refresh_sentiment():
        """Force-refresh sentiment data (clear cache)."""
        try:
            print("[scheduler] Refreshing sentiment...")
            data_sentiment._cache["data"] = None
            data_sentiment._cache["ts"] = 0
            data_sentiment.get_sentiment()
            print("[scheduler] Sentiment refreshed.")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[scheduler] Sentiment refresh error: {e}")

    def refresh_geo():
        """Force-refresh geopolitical data."""
        try:
            print("[scheduler] Refreshing geopolitical data...")
            data_geopolitical.start_background_fetch()
            print("[scheduler] Geo data refresh triggered.")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[scheduler] Geo refresh error: {e}")


    def refresh_pplx_crypto():
        """[SCHEDULER_PPLX_V1] Refresh contexte Perplexity pour cryptos."""
        try:
            print("[scheduler] Refreshing Perplexity crypto contexts...")
            from pplx_crypto_agent import refresh_all_crypto_contexts
            refresh_all_crypto_contexts(ttl_hours=4)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[scheduler] PPLX crypto refresh error: {e}")

    def refresh_pplx_factor():
        """[SCHEDULER_PPLX_V1] Refresh contexte Perplexity qualite pour equities."""
        try:
            print("[scheduler] Refreshing Perplexity factor quality contexts...")
            from pplx_factor_agent import refresh_all_quality_contexts
            refresh_all_quality_contexts(ttl_hours=24)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[scheduler] PPLX factor refresh error: {e}")

    def refresh_pplx_geo():
        """[SCHEDULER_GEO_PPLX_V1] Refresh contexte geopolitique Perplexity (top 5 risques, 4h cache)."""
        try:
            print("[scheduler] Refreshing Perplexity geo context...")
            from pplx_geo_agent import run_geo_agent
            run_geo_agent(force=True)
            print("[scheduler] PPLX geo context refreshed.")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[scheduler] PPLX geo refresh error: {e}")

    from datetime import datetime as _dt, timedelta as _td
    _now = _dt.now()
    # Schedule: prices every 2h, macro every 6h, sentiment every 1h, geo every 4h
    # First price refresh 30s after startup to get fresh data quickly
    scheduler.add_job(refresh_prices,    'interval', hours=2, id='refresh_prices',    next_run_time=_now + _td(seconds=30))
    scheduler.add_job(refresh_macro,     'interval', hours=6, id='refresh_macro',     next_run_time=_now + _td(hours=6))
    scheduler.add_job(refresh_sentiment, 'interval', hours=1, id='refresh_sentiment', next_run_time=_now + _td(hours=1))
    scheduler.add_job(refresh_geo,       'interval', hours=4, id='refresh_geo',       next_run_time=_now + _td(hours=4))
    scheduler.add_job(refresh_pplx_crypto, 'interval', hours=4,  id='refresh_pplx_crypto', next_run_time=_now + _td(minutes=2))
    scheduler.add_job(refresh_pplx_factor, 'interval', hours=24, id='refresh_pplx_factor', next_run_time=_now + _td(minutes=5))
    scheduler.add_job(refresh_pplx_geo,    'interval', hours=4,  id='refresh_pplx_geo',    next_run_time=_now + _td(minutes=8))
    scheduler.start()
    app.state._scheduler = scheduler
    print("[startup] Scheduler started (prices:2h, macro:6h, sentiment:1h, geo:4h)")
    print("[startup] Nextones API ready.")
    yield
    scheduler.shutdown(wait=False)


def _update_portfolio_from_latest_prices():
    """Module-level helper: update portfolio_positions and portfolio_state from latest prices."""
    conn = get_db()
    try:
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        positions = conn.execute(
            'SELECT id, instrument_id, quantity, avg_cost FROM portfolio_positions'
        ).fetchall()
        if not positions:
            return
        total_market_value = 0
        total_prev_market_value = 0
        updates = []
        for pos in positions:
            # Get latest price
            price_row = conn.execute(
                'SELECT close FROM prices WHERE instrument_id = ? ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1',
                (pos['instrument_id'],)
            ).fetchone()
            if not price_row:
                continue
            latest = price_row['close']
            # Get previous day's close for daily P&L
            prev_row = conn.execute(
                'SELECT close FROM prices WHERE instrument_id = ? ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1',
                (pos['instrument_id'],)
            ).fetchone()
            prev_close = prev_row['close'] if prev_row else latest

            mv = pos['quantity'] * latest
            prev_mv = pos['quantity'] * prev_close
            pnl = pos['quantity'] * (latest - pos['avg_cost'])
            total_market_value += mv
            total_prev_market_value += prev_mv
            updates.append((latest, round(pnl, 2), round(mv, 2), pos['id'], pos['quantity'], pos['avg_cost']))

        ps = conn.execute('SELECT cash FROM portfolio_state WHERE id = 1').fetchone()
        cash = ps['cash'] if ps else 0
        total_value = cash + total_market_value
        total_prev_value = cash + total_prev_market_value

        for upd in updates:
            w = round(upd[2] / total_value * 100, 2) if total_value > 0 else 0
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE portfolio_positions SET current_price=?, unrealized_pnl=?, weight_pct=?, updated_at=datetime('now') WHERE id=?",
                (upd[0], upd[1], w, upd[3])
            )

        total_cost = sum(u[4] * u[5] for u in updates)
        total_pnl = total_market_value - total_cost
        # PATCH: % rapporté au capital initial (NAV), pas au cost basis des positions ouvertes
        INITIAL_CAPITAL = 1000000
        total_pnl_pct = (total_pnl / INITIAL_CAPITAL * 100) if INITIAL_CAPITAL > 0 else 0

        # PATCH: Daily P&L = NAV courant - dernière clôture STRICTEMENT avant aujourd'hui
        today_str = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        prev_row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT total_value FROM portfolio_history WHERE date < ? "
            "ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1",
            (today_str,),
        ).fetchone()
        total_prev_value = prev_row[0] if prev_row else total_value
        daily_pnl = total_value - total_prev_value
        daily_pnl_pct = (daily_pnl / total_prev_value * 100) if total_prev_value > 0 else 0

        # PATCH: Upsert du snapshot du jour dans portfolio_history
        conn.execute(
            """INSERT INTO portfolio_history (date, total_value, cash, total_pnl)
               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
               ON CONFLICT(date) DO UPDATE SET
                 total_value=excluded.total_value,
                 cash=excluded.cash,
                 total_pnl=excluded.total_pnl""",
            (today_str, round(total_value, 2), round(cash, 2), round(total_pnl, 2)),
        )

        conn.execute(
            """UPDATE portfolio_state
               SET total_value=?, total_pnl=?, total_pnl_pct=?,
                   daily_pnl=?, daily_pnl_pct=?, updated_at=?
               WHERE id=1""",
            (round(total_value, 2), round(total_pnl, 2), round(total_pnl_pct, 4),
             round(daily_pnl, 2), round(daily_pnl_pct, 4), datetime.now().isoformat())
        )
        conn.commit()
        print(f"[portfolio] Updated: total_value={total_value:.2f}, pnl={total_pnl:.2f}, daily_pnl={daily_pnl:.2f}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[portfolio] Update error: {e}")
    finally:
        conn.close()

def db() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    """Get a DB connection with Row factory."""
    return get_db()


def _parse_json_fields(d: dict) -> dict:
    """Recursively parse any string fields that look like JSON."""
    if not d:
        return d
    for k, v in d.items():
        if isinstance(v, str) and len(v) > 1 and v[0] in ('{', '['):
            try:
                d[k] = json.loads(v)
            except Exception:
                pass
    return d

@app.get("/api/dashboard")
def get_dashboard():
    """Portfolio summary: total value, cash, P&L, risk metrics, positions, recent events."""
    conn = db()
    try:
        # Portfolio state
        ps_row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM portfolio_state WHERE id = 1").fetchone()
        ps = row_to_dict(ps_row) or {}

        # Positions with instrument info and P&L
        positions_rows = conn.execute(
            """SELECT pp.id, pp.instrument_id, pp.quantity, pp.avg_cost,
                      pp.current_price, pp.unrealized_pnl, pp.weight_pct,
                      i.ticker, i.name, i.sector, i.asset_class,
                      p.close AS latest_close, p.date AS price_date
               FROM portfolio_positions pp
               JOIN instruments i ON i.id = pp.instrument_id
               LEFT JOIN (
                   SELECT instrument_id, close, date
                   FROM prices
                   WHERE (instrument_id, date) IN (
                       SELECT instrument_id, MAX(date)
                       FROM prices GROUP BY instrument_id
                   )
               ) p ON p.instrument_id = pp.instrument_id
               ORDER BY pp.weight_pct DESC"""
        ).fetchall()

        positions = []
        for row in positions_rows:
            d = dict(row)
            # Update with latest close if available
            if d["latest_close"]:
                market_value = d["quantity"] * d["latest_close"]
                total_val = ps.get("total_value", 1)
                d["current_price"]  = d["latest_close"]
                d["market_value"]   = round(market_value, 2)
                d["unrealized_pnl"] = round(d["quantity"] * (d["latest_close"] - d["avg_cost"]), 2)
                d["unrealized_pnl_pct"] = round(
                    (d["latest_close"] - d["avg_cost"]) / d["avg_cost"] * 100
                    if d["avg_cost"] else 0, 2
                )
                d["weight_pct"] = round(market_value / total_val * 100 if total_val else 0, 2)
            positions.append(d)

        # Recent events (last 20)
        events_rows = conn.execute(
            """SELECT id, event_type, entity_type, entity_id, details, agent, created_at
               FROM event_log ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"""
        ).fetchall()
        events = rows_to_list(events_rows)

        # Active theses count
        thesis_count = conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM theses WHERE status = 'active'"
        ).fetchone()[0]

        # Pending validation orders
        pending_orders = conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending_validation'"
        ).fetchone()[0]

        return {
            "portfolio": {
                "cash":           round(ps.get("cash", 0), 2),
                "total_value":    round(ps.get("total_value", 0), 2),
                "total_pnl":      round(ps.get("total_pnl", 0), 2),
                "total_pnl_pct":  round(ps.get("total_pnl_pct", 0), 4),
                "daily_pnl":      round(ps.get("daily_pnl", 0), 2),
                "daily_pnl_pct":  round(ps.get("daily_pnl_pct", 0), 4),
                "var_95":         round(ps.get("var_95", 0), 3),
                "max_drawdown":   round(ps.get("max_drawdown", 0), 4),
                "updated_at":     ps.get("updated_at"),
            },
            "positions": positions,
            "recent_events": events,
            "summary": {
                "active_theses": thesis_count,
                "pending_orders": pending_orders,
                "num_positions": len([p for p in positions if p.get("quantity", 0) > 0]),
            }
        }
    finally:
        conn.close()


@app.get("/api/portfolio/history")
def get_portfolio_history():
    """Last 30 days of portfolio value for the equity curve chart."""
    conn = db()
    try:
        rows = conn.execute(
            """SELECT date, total_value, cash, total_pnl
               FROM portfolio_history
               ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 30"""
        ).fetchall()
        data = list(reversed([dict(r) for r in rows]))

        # If no history, generate from portfolio_state
        if not data:
            ps = conn.execute("SELECT total_value FROM portfolio_state WHERE id = 1").fetchone()
            total = ps["total_value"] if ps else 1_000_000
            from datetime import date, timedelta
            today = date.today()
            data = [
                {"date": (today - timedelta(days=i)).isoformat(),
                 "total_value": total, "cash": total * 0.18, "total_pnl": 0}
                for i in range(29, -1, -1)
            ]

        return {"history": data}
    finally:
        conn.close()

@app.get("/api/theses")
def list_theses(
    agent: str = Query(None),
    status: str = Query("active"),
    ticker: str = Query(None),
    asset_class: str = Query(None),
):
    """List all theses with instrument info, conviction, horizon, agent."""
    conn = db()
    try:
        query = """
            SELECT t.id, t.instrument_id, t.agent_type, t.conviction_score,
                   t.horizon, t.proposed_action, t.status, t.created_at, t.updated_at,
                   t.key_drivers,
                   i.ticker, i.name, i.sector, i.asset_class
            FROM theses t
            LEFT JOIN instruments i ON i.id = t.instrument_id
            WHERE 1=1
        """
        params = []
        if status:
            query += " AND t.status = ?"
            params.append(status)
        if agent:
            query += " AND t.agent_type = ?"
            params.append(agent)
        if ticker:
            query += " AND i.ticker = ?"
            params.append(ticker.upper())
        if asset_class:
            query += " AND i.asset_class = ?"
            params.append(asset_class.lower())
        query += " ORDER BY t.conviction_score DESC, t.updated_at DESC"

        rows = conn.execute(query, params).fetchall()
        result = []
        for row in rows:
            d = dict(row)
            if isinstance(d.get("key_drivers"), str):
                try:
                    d["key_drivers"] = json.loads(d["key_drivers"])
                except Exception:
                    d["key_drivers"] = []
            # For global theses (no instrument), set display info based on agent
            if d.get("instrument_id") is None:
                if d.get("agent_type") == "MacroAgent":
                    d["ticker"] = "MACRO"
                    d["name"] = "SPY / QQQ / DIA"
                    d["asset_class"] = "macro"
                else:
                    d["ticker"] = d.get("agent_type", "N/A")
                    d["name"] = "Global thesis"
            result.append(d)
        return {"theses": result, "total": len(result)}
    finally:
        conn.close()


@app.get("/api/theses/{thesis_id}")
def get_thesis(thesis_id: int):

    conn = db()

        row = conn.execute(
            """SELECT t.*, i.ticker, i.name, i.sector, i.asset_class
               FROM theses t
               LEFT JOIN instruments i ON i.id = t.instrument_id

                      f.fill_price, f.filled_at

               WHERE o.thesis_id = ?

@app.post("/api/orders/{order_id}/approve")
def approve_order(order_id: int, user: dict = Depends(require_manager)):
    """Approve (PASS) a pending_validation order and execute it via PaperBroker."""
    from execution_engine import DEFAULT_BROKER
    conn = db()
    try:
        row = conn.execute(
            """
            SELECT o.*, i.ticker
            FROM orders o
            JOIN instruments i ON i.id = o.instrument_id
            WHERE o.id = ?
            """,
            (order_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        if not row:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Order not found")
        order = dict(row)
        if order["status"] != "pending_validation":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Order is not pending_validation (current: {order['status']})")

        # Get current price
        price_row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT close FROM prices WHERE instrument_id = ? ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1",
            (order["instrument_id"],)
        ).fetchone()
        if not price_row:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="No price data for instrument")
        current_price = price_row[0]

        validated_at = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        username = user.get("username", "unknown")

        # Set to approved
        conn.execute(
            """UPDATE orders SET status='approved', validated_by=?, validated_at=? WHERE id=?""",
            (username, validated_at, order_id)
        )

        # Execute via PaperBroker
        fill_result = DEFAULT_BROKER.execute_order(
            conn, order_id, order["instrument_id"], order["side"],
            order["quantity"], order["order_type"], order["limit_price"], current_price
        )

        from models import log_event
        log_event(conn, "order_approved", "order", order_id, {
            "validated_by": username,
            "ticker": order["ticker"],
            "side": order["side"],
            "quantity": order["quantity"],
            "fill_result": fill_result,
        }, agent="UserAction")
        conn.commit()

        return {
            "success": True,
            "order_id": order_id,
            "validated_by": username,
            "validated_at": validated_at,
            "fill": fill_result,
        }
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        conn.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))
    finally:
        conn.close()


@app.post("/api/orders/{order_id}/reject")
def reject_order(order_id: int, req: OrderRejectRequest, user: dict = Depends(require_manager)):
    """Reject a pending_validation order with a mandatory reason."""
    if not req.reason or not req.reason.strip():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Le motif de rejet est obligatoire")
    conn = db()
    try:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?", (order_id,)).fetchone()
        if not row:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Order not found")
        order = dict(row)
        if order["status"] != "pending_validation":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"Order is not pending_validation (current: {order['status']})")

        validated_at = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        username = user.get("username", "unknown")

        conn.execute(
            """UPDATE orders SET status='rejected', validated_by=?, rejection_reason=?,
               validated_at=? WHERE id=?""",
            (username, req.reason.strip(), validated_at, order_id)
        )

        from models import log_event
        log_event(conn, "order_rejected", "order", order_id, {
            "validated_by": username,
            "reason": req.reason.strip(),
        }, agent="UserAction")
        conn.commit()

        return {
            "success": True,
            "order_id": order_id,
            "validated_by": username,
            "validated_at": validated_at,
            "reason": req.reason.strip(),
        }
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        conn.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))
    finally:
        conn.close()


@app.post("/api/orders/approve-all")
def approve_all_orders(user: dict = Depends(require_manager)):
    """Approve ALL pending_validation orders and execute each via PaperBroker."""
    from execution_engine import DEFAULT_BROKER
    conn = db()
    try:
        rows = conn.execute(
            """
            SELECT o.*, i.ticker
            FROM orders o
            JOIN instruments i ON i.id = o.instrument_id
            WHERE o.status = 'pending_validation'
            ORDER BY o.created_at ASC
            """
        ).fetchall()
        orders = [dict(r) for r in rows]

        username = user.get("username", "unknown")
        results = []
        for order in orders:
            try:
                price_row = conn.execute(
                    "SELECT close FROM prices WHERE instrument_id = ? ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1",
                    (order["instrument_id"],)
                ).fetchone()
                if not price_row:
                    results.append({"order_id": order["id"], "success": False, "reason": "No price data"})
                    continue
                current_price = price_row[0]
                validated_at = datetime.utcnow().isoformat()

                conn.execute(
                    """UPDATE orders SET status='approved', validated_by=?, validated_at=? WHERE id=?""",
                    (username, validated_at, order["id"])
                )
                fill_result = DEFAULT_BROKER.execute_order(
                    conn, order["id"], order["instrument_id"], order["side"],
                    order["quantity"], order["order_type"], order["limit_price"], current_price
                )
                from models import log_event
                log_event(conn, "order_approved", "order", order["id"], {
                    "validated_by": username,
                    "ticker": order["ticker"],
                    "bulk": True,
                }, agent="UserAction")
                results.append({"order_id": order["id"], "ticker": order["ticker"], "success": True, "fill": fill_result})
            except Exception as ex:
                results.append({"order_id": order["id"], "success": False, "reason": str(ex)})

        conn.commit()
        return {"success": True, "results": results, "total_approved": len([r for r in results if r["success"]])}
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        conn.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))
    finally:
        conn.close()


@app.post("/api/orders/reject-all")
def reject_all_orders(req: BulkRejectRequest, user: dict = Depends(require_manager)):

@app.get("/api/memos")
def list_memos(
    start_date: str = Query(None),
    end_date: str = Query(None),
    ticker: str = Query(None),
    agent: str = Query(None),
    limit: int = Query(20),
):
    """List IC memos with optional filters."""
    conn = db()
    try:
        query = """
            SELECT id, date, title, macro_summary, factor_tilts,
                   thesis_summaries, proposed_changes, created_at
            FROM ic_memos WHERE 1=1
        """
        params = []
        if start_date:
            query += " AND date >= ?"
            params.append(start_date)
        if end_date:
            query += " AND date <= ?"
            params.append(end_date)
        if ticker:
            # Search in thesis_summaries JSON field
            query += " AND thesis_summaries LIKE ?"
            params.append(f'%"{ticker.upper()}"%')
        if agent:
            query += " AND thesis_summaries LIKE ?"
            params.append(f'%"{agent}"%')
        query += " ORDER BY date DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT ?"
        params.append(limit)

        rows = conn.execute(query, params).fetchall()
        memos = []
        for row in rows:
            d = dict(row)
            for field in ("factor_tilts", "thesis_summaries", "proposed_changes"):
                if isinstance(d.get(field), str):
                    try:
                        d[field] = json.loads(d[field])
                    except Exception:
                        pass
            memos.append(d)

        return {"memos": memos, "total": len(memos)}
    finally:
        conn.close()

@app.get("/api/memos/{memo_id}/pdf")
def get_memo_pdf(memo_id: int):
    """Generate and return a styled PDF export of an IC memo."""
    conn = db()
    try:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM ic_memos WHERE id = ?", (memo_id,)).fetchone()
        if not row:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Memo not found")
        memo = row_to_dict(row)
    finally:
        conn.close()

    import io
    import re
    from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import A4
    from reportlab.lib.units import mm, cm
    from reportlab.lib.colors import HexColor, white, black
    from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet, ParagraphStyle
    from reportlab.lib.enums import TA_LEFT, TA_CENTER, TA_RIGHT
    from reportlab.platypus import (
        SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, Table, TableStyle,
        HRFlowable, KeepTogether,
    )
    from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics
    from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont

    # -- Brand colors --
    DARK_NAVY   = HexColor("#091717")
    OFFBLACK    = HexColor("#13343B")
    DEEP_TEAL   = HexColor("#115058")
    MUTED_TEAL  = HexColor("#20808D")
    LIGHT_TEAL  = HexColor("#D6F5FA")
    OFF_WHITE   = HexColor("#FCFAF6")
    PAPER_WHITE = HexColor("#F3F3EE")
    WARM_BEIGE  = HexColor("#E5E3D4")
    TERRA       = HexColor("#A84B2F")
    GOLD        = HexColor("#FFC553")
    GREEN_OK    = HexColor("#70AD47")
    RED_RISK    = HexColor("#C00000")

    W, H = A4
    buf = io.BytesIO()

    def header_footer(canvas, doc):
        canvas.saveState()
        # Header bar
        canvas.setFillColor(DARK_NAVY)
        canvas.rect(0, H - 22*mm, W, 22*mm, fill=1, stroke=0)
        canvas.setFillColor(MUTED_TEAL)
        canvas.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 11)
        canvas.drawString(15*mm, H - 14*mm, "NEXTONES.FINANCE")
        canvas.setFillColor(white)
        canvas.setFont("Helvetica", 8)
        canvas.drawRightString(W - 15*mm, H - 10*mm, f"IC Memo — {memo.get('date', '')}")
        canvas.drawRightString(W - 15*mm, H - 15*mm, "Paper Trading | Not Investment Advice")
        # Accent line below header
        canvas.setStrokeColor(MUTED_TEAL)
        canvas.setLineWidth(1.5)
        canvas.line(15*mm, H - 22*mm, W - 15*mm, H - 22*mm)
        # Footer
        canvas.setFillColor(OFFBLACK)
        canvas.setFont("Helvetica", 7)
        canvas.drawString(15*mm, 10*mm, "Nextones Desk — AI-native fund operating system")
        canvas.drawRightString(W - 15*mm, 10*mm, f"Page {doc.page}")
        canvas.restoreState()

    doc = SimpleDocTemplate(
        buf, pagesize=A4,
        title=memo.get("title", "IC Memo"),
        author="Perplexity Computer",
        topMargin=28*mm,
        bottomMargin=20*mm,
        leftMargin=15*mm,
        rightMargin=15*mm,
    )

    # -- Styles --
    styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
    sH1 = ParagraphStyle("MemoH1", parent=styles["Heading1"],
        fontSize=16, leading=20, textColor=OFFBLACK,
        spaceAfter=6, spaceBefore=12, fontName="Helvetica-Bold")
    sH2 = ParagraphStyle("MemoH2", parent=styles["Heading2"],
        fontSize=12, leading=15, textColor=DEEP_TEAL,
        spaceAfter=4, spaceBefore=10, fontName="Helvetica-Bold")
    sBody = ParagraphStyle("MemoBody", parent=styles["Normal"],
        fontSize=9.5, leading=13, textColor=OFFBLACK,
        spaceAfter=4, fontName="Helvetica")
    sBold = ParagraphStyle("MemoBold", parent=sBody,
        fontName="Helvetica-Bold")
    sBullet = ParagraphStyle("MemoBullet", parent=sBody,
        leftIndent=12, bulletIndent=4, spaceBefore=1, spaceAfter=1)
    sSmall = ParagraphStyle("MemoSmall", parent=sBody,
        fontSize=8, leading=10, textColor=HexColor("#5a7a7e"))
    sLabel = ParagraphStyle("MemoLabel", parent=sBody,
        fontSize=8, leading=10, textColor=MUTED_TEAL,
        fontName="Helvetica-Bold", spaceAfter=2)

    story = []

    # -- Parse markdown --
    md = memo.get("full_markdown") or f"# {memo.get('title', 'IC Memo')}\n\nNo content."
    lines = md.split("\n")

    # -- Helper: flush accumulated markdown table rows into a ReportLab Table --
    def flush_md_table(table_rows, separator_idx):
        if not table_rows:
            return []
        elements = []
        header = [c.strip() for c in table_rows[0].strip('|').split('|')]
        body_rows = []
        # separator_idx = len(pending_table_rows) at time separator was seen
        # Since separator line is NOT stored in pending_table_rows,
        # body rows start at separator_idx (not +1)
        start = separator_idx if separator_idx is not None else 1
        for row_str in table_rows[start:]:
            cells = [c.strip() for c in row_str.strip('|').split('|')]
            body_rows.append(cells)

        col_count = len(header)
        if col_count == 0:
            return []
        available_width = W - 30*mm
        col_w = available_width / col_count
        col_widths = [col_w] * col_count

        sTableHead = ParagraphStyle("TH", parent=sBody, fontSize=7.5, leading=9.5,
            textColor=white, fontName="Helvetica-Bold")
        sTableCell = ParagraphStyle("TC", parent=sBody, fontSize=7.5, leading=9.5,
            fontName="Helvetica")

        data = [[Paragraph(re.sub(r'\*\*(.+?)\*\*', r'<b>\1</b>', h), sTableHead) for h in header]]
        for r in body_rows:
            row = []
            for c in r:
                c = re.sub(r'\*\*(.+?)\*\*', r'<b>\1</b>', c)
                row.append(Paragraph(c, sTableCell))
            data.append(row)

        # Pad short rows
        for row in data:
            while len(row) < col_count:
                row.append(Paragraph("", sTableCell))

        t = Table(data, colWidths=col_widths, repeatRows=1)
        t.setStyle(TableStyle([
            ('BACKGROUND', (0, 0), (-1, 0), DEEP_TEAL),
            ('TEXTCOLOR', (0, 0), (-1, 0), white),
            ('FONTNAME', (0, 0), (-1, 0), 'Helvetica-Bold'),
            ('FONTSIZE', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 7.5),
            ('LEADING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 9.5),
            ('ROWBACKGROUNDS', (0, 1), (-1, -1), [PAPER_WHITE, OFF_WHITE]),
            ('GRID', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.4, WARM_BEIGE),
            ('VALIGN', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 'MIDDLE'),
            ('TOPPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 3),
            ('BOTTOMPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 3),
            ('LEFTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 5),
            ('RIGHTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 5),
        ]))
        elements.append(KeepTogether([t]))
        return elements

    # -- Table accumulation state --
    pending_table_rows = []
    pending_table_sep = None

    for line in lines:
        stripped = line.strip()

        # -- Table row detection --
        if stripped.startswith('|'):
            # Check if this is a separator row like |---|---|---|
            if re.match(r'^\|[\s\-:]+\|', stripped) and '---' in stripped:
                pending_table_sep = len(pending_table_rows)  # index where separator would be
            else:
                pending_table_rows.append(stripped)
            continue
        else:
            # Flush any accumulated table
            if pending_table_rows:
                story.extend(flush_md_table(pending_table_rows, pending_table_sep))
                pending_table_rows = []
                pending_table_sep = None

        if not stripped:
            story.append(Spacer(1, 3))
            continue

        # Headings
        if stripped.startswith("# "):
            txt = stripped[2:].strip()
            story.append(Paragraph(txt, sH1))
            continue
        if stripped.startswith("## "):
            txt = stripped[3:].strip()
            story.append(Paragraph(txt, sH2))
            continue
        if stripped.startswith("### "):
            txt = stripped[4:].strip()
            txt = re.sub(r'\*\*(.+?)\*\*', r'\1', txt)  # Remove ** bold markers (already bold)
            story.append(Paragraph(f"<b>{txt}</b>", sBody))
            continue

        # Horizontal rule
        if stripped.startswith("---"):
            story.append(Spacer(1, 4))
            story.append(HRFlowable(width="100%", thickness=0.8,
                                     color=WARM_BEIGE, spaceAfter=4, spaceBefore=4))
            continue

        # Bullet points
        if stripped.startswith("- ") or stripped.startswith("* "):
            txt = stripped[2:].strip()
            # Bold **text** rendering
            txt = re.sub(r'\*\*(.+?)\*\*', r'<b>\1</b>', txt)
            story.append(Paragraph(f"\u2022  {txt}", sBullet))
            continue

        # Bold whole lines
        bold_match = re.match(r'^\*\*(.+?)\*\*(.*)$', stripped)
        if bold_match:
            btxt = bold_match.group(1)
            rest = bold_match.group(2).strip()
            txt = f"<b>{btxt}</b>"
            if rest:
                # Also convert any remaining inline **bold** in the rest
                rest = re.sub(r'\*\*(.+?)\*\*', r'<b>\1</b>', rest)
                txt += f" {rest}"
            story.append(Paragraph(txt, sBody))
            continue

        # Italic / small
        if stripped.startswith("*") and stripped.endswith("*") and not stripped.startswith("**"):
            txt = stripped.strip("*")
            story.append(Paragraph(txt, sSmall))
            continue

        # Normal paragraph — convert inline bold
        txt = re.sub(r'\*\*(.+?)\*\*', r'<b>\1</b>', stripped)
        story.append(Paragraph(txt, sBody))

    # Flush any remaining table at end of loop
    if pending_table_rows:
        story.extend(flush_md_table(pending_table_rows, pending_table_sep))

    # -- Add structured data sections if available --
    factor_tilts = memo.get("factor_tilts")
    thesis_summaries = memo.get("thesis_summaries")
    proposed_changes = memo.get("proposed_changes")

    if factor_tilts and isinstance(factor_tilts, str):
        try:
            factor_tilts = json.loads(factor_tilts)
        except Exception:
            factor_tilts = None

    if thesis_summaries and isinstance(thesis_summaries, str):
        try:
            thesis_summaries = json.loads(thesis_summaries)
        except Exception:
            thesis_summaries = None

    if proposed_changes and isinstance(proposed_changes, str):
        try:
            proposed_changes = json.loads(proposed_changes)
        except Exception:
            proposed_changes = None

    # Thesis summary table
    if thesis_summaries and isinstance(thesis_summaries, list) and len(thesis_summaries) > 0:
        story.append(Spacer(1, 8))
        story.append(Paragraph("Thesis Summaries", sH2))
        table_data = [["Ticker", "Agent", "Conviction", "Action"]]
        for ts in thesis_summaries:
            table_data.append([
                Paragraph(f"<b>{ts.get('ticker', '—')}</b>", sBody),
                Paragraph(str(ts.get('agent', '—')), sSmall),
                Paragraph(f"{ts.get('conviction', '—')}/10", sBody),
                Paragraph(str(ts.get('action', '—')), sBody),
            ])

        t = Table(table_data, colWidths=[55, 85, 55, None])
        t.setStyle(TableStyle([
            ('BACKGROUND', (0, 0), (-1, 0), DEEP_TEAL),
            ('TEXTCOLOR', (0, 0), (-1, 0), white),
            ('FONTNAME', (0, 0), (-1, 0), 'Helvetica-Bold'),
            ('FONTSIZE', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 8.5),
            ('LEADING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 11),
            ('BACKGROUND', (0, 1), (-1, -1), PAPER_WHITE),
            ('ROWBACKGROUNDS', (0, 1), (-1, -1), [PAPER_WHITE, OFF_WHITE]),
            ('GRID', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.4, WARM_BEIGE),
            ('VALIGN', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 'TOP'),
            ('TOPPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 4),
            ('BOTTOMPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 4),
            ('LEFTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 6),
        ]))
        story.append(t)

    # Proposed changes table
    if proposed_changes and isinstance(proposed_changes, list) and len(proposed_changes) > 0:
        story.append(Spacer(1, 8))
        story.append(Paragraph("Proposed Changes", sH2))
        table_data = [["Ticker", "Side", "Qty", "Status"]]
        for pc in proposed_changes:
            side_str = str(pc.get('side', '—')).upper()
            side_color = GREEN_OK if side_str == 'BUY' else TERRA
            table_data.append([
                Paragraph(f"<b>{pc.get('ticker', '—')}</b>", sBody),
                Paragraph(f'<font color="{side_color}">{side_str}</font>', sBody),
                Paragraph(str(pc.get('quantity', '—')), sBody),
                Paragraph(str(pc.get('status', '—')).upper(), sSmall),
            ])

        t = Table(table_data, colWidths=[70, 60, 60, None])
        t.setStyle(TableStyle([
            ('BACKGROUND', (0, 0), (-1, 0), DEEP_TEAL),
            ('TEXTCOLOR', (0, 0), (-1, 0), white),
            ('FONTNAME', (0, 0), (-1, 0), 'Helvetica-Bold'),
            ('FONTSIZE', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 8.5),
            ('LEADING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 11),
            ('BACKGROUND', (0, 1), (-1, -1), PAPER_WHITE),
            ('ROWBACKGROUNDS', (0, 1), (-1, -1), [PAPER_WHITE, OFF_WHITE]),
            ('GRID', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.4, WARM_BEIGE),
            ('VALIGN', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 'MIDDLE'),
            ('TOPPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 4),
            ('BOTTOMPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 4),
            ('LEFTPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 6),
        ]))
        story.append(t)

    doc.build(story, onFirstPage=header_footer, onLaterPages=header_footer)
    buf.seek(0)

    from starlette.responses import Response
    safe_date = memo.get("date", "unknown").replace("/", "-")
    return Response(
        content=buf.read(),
        media_type="application/pdf",
        headers={
            "Content-Disposition": f'attachment; filename="IC-Memo-{safe_date}.pdf"',
        },
    )

@app.get("/api/finviz/sectors")
def get_finviz_sectors():
    """Sector performance + overview merged by sector name."""
    perf = data_finviz.fetch_sector_performance()
    overview = data_finviz.fetch_sector_overview()

    # Index overview by name for fast lookup
    ov_index = {item["name"]: item for item in overview}

    merged: list[dict] = []
    for p in perf:
        name = p["name"]
        ov = ov_index.get(name, {})
        merged.append({
            "name":       name,
            "change":     p.get("change"),
            "perf_week":  p.get("perf_week"),
            "perf_month": p.get("perf_month"),
            "perf_quart": p.get("perf_quart"),
            "perf_ytd":   p.get("perf_ytd"),
            "pe":         ov.get("pe"),
            "fwd_pe":     ov.get("fwd_pe"),
            "dividend":   ov.get("dividend"),
        })

    # Sort by perf_week descending (None values last)
    merged.sort(key=lambda x: (x["perf_week"] is None, -(x["perf_week"] or 0)))

    return {"sectors": merged, "total": len(merged)}

import numpy as np


def _sanitize_for_json(obj):
    """Recursively replace inf/NaN/numpy types with JSON-safe values."""
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        return {k: _sanitize_for_json(v) for k, v in obj.items()}
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        return [_sanitize_for_json(v) for v in obj]
    elif isinstance(obj, (np.floating, np.float64, np.float32)):
        f = float(obj)
        return None if (math.isinf(f) or math.isnan(f)) else f
    elif isinstance(obj, (np.integer, np.int64, np.int32)):
        return int(obj)
    elif isinstance(obj, float):
        return None if (math.isinf(obj) or math.isnan(obj)) else obj
    elif isinstance(obj, np.bool_):
        return bool(obj)
    return obj

# In-memory cache for geo data (survives across requests, avoids GDELT timeouts)
# [GEO_CACHE_PERSIST_V2]  Cache persiste sur disque
_GEO_CACHE_FILE = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), ".geo_cache.json")

def _load_geo_cache():
    try:
        if os.path.exists(_GEO_CACHE_FILE):
            with open(_GEO_CACHE_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as _f:
                _c = json.load(_f)
            if isinstance(_c, dict) and "data" in _c and "ts" in _c:
                print("[GEO-CACHE] Charge depuis disque, age=" + str(int(__import__("time").time() - _c.get("ts", 0))) + "s")
                return _c
    except Exception as _e:
        print("[GEO-CACHE] Lecture disque echouee: " + str(_e))
    return {"data": None, "ts": 0}

def _save_geo_cache(_c):
    try:
        with open(_GEO_CACHE_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as _f:
            json.dump(_c, _f, ensure_ascii=False)
    except Exception as _e:
        print("[GEO-CACHE] Ecriture disque echouee: " + str(_e))

_geo_cache = _load_geo_cache()
_GEO_CACHE_TTL = 1800  # 30 minutes
_geo_fetch_lock = __import__('threading').Lock()
_geo_fetching = False

def _enrich_geo_data(data):
    """Add score_history to geo data for the frontend chart."""
    import random
    from datetime import date, timedelta
    sub = data.get("sub_scores", [])
    current = {
        "composite": data.get("composite_score", 50),
        "conflicts": next((s["score"] for s in sub if "confl" in s.get("name","").lower()), 60),
        "supply_chain": next((s["score"] for s in sub if "supply" in s.get("name","").lower()), 40),
        "theaters": next((s["score"] for s in sub if "th" in s.get("name","").lower() and "infra" not in s.get("name","").lower()), 50),
        "infrastructure": next((s["score"] for s in sub if "infra" in s.get("name","").lower()), 30),
    }
    today = date.today()
    score_history = []
    random.seed(42)
    for i in range(11, -1, -1):
        m = today - timedelta(days=30*i)
        pt = {"date": m.strftime("%Y-%m")}
        for key, val in current.items():
            drift = (11 - i) * 0.3
            noise = random.uniform(-4, 4)
            pt[key] = round(max(0, min(100, val - drift + noise)), 1)
        score_history.append(pt)
    score_history[-1] = {"date": today.strftime("%Y-%m"), **{k: round(v, 1) for k, v in current.items()}}
    data["score_history"] = score_history
    return data


def _geo_background_fetch():
    """Background thread that fetches geo data and writes to _geo_cache.
    Retries up to 3 times (with 45s cooldown) until all theaters have data."""
    global _geo_fetching
    import time as _t
    MAX_RETRIES = 3
    try:
        print("[GEO-BG] Starting background fetch...")
        data = data_geopolitical.fetch_geopolitical_risk()
        if not data:
            print("[GEO-BG] No data returned.")
            return

        # Write initial result to cache (may be partial)
        enriched = _enrich_geo_data(data)
        clean = _sanitize_for_json(enriched)
        _geo_cache["data"] = clean
        _geo_cache["ts"] = _t.time()
        _save_geo_cache(_geo_cache)
        print(f"[GEO-BG] Initial cache set, score={data.get('composite_score')}")

        # Check for missing theaters and retry
        for attempt in range(1, MAX_RETRIES + 1):
            missing = [t["name"] for t in data.get("theaters", []) if t.get("article_count", 0) == 0]
            if not missing:
                print("[GEO-BG] All theaters complete!")
                return
            print(f"[GEO-BG] Missing theaters: {', '.join(missing)} — retry {attempt}/{MAX_RETRIES} in 45s...")
            _t.sleep(45)
            data = data_geopolitical.fetch_geopolitical_risk()
            if data:
                enriched = _enrich_geo_data(data)
                clean = _sanitize_for_json(enriched)
                _geo_cache["data"] = clean
                _geo_cache["ts"] = _t.time()
                _save_geo_cache(_geo_cache)
                print(f"[GEO-BG] Cache updated (retry {attempt}), score={data.get('composite_score')}")

        # Final check
        still_missing = [t["name"] for t in data.get("theaters", []) if t.get("article_count", 0) == 0]
        if still_missing:
            print(f"[GEO-BG] Still missing after {MAX_RETRIES} retries: {', '.join(still_missing)}")
        else:
            print("[GEO-BG] All theaters complete after retries!")
    except Exception:
        import traceback; traceback.print_exc()
    finally:
        _geo_fetching = False

@app.get("/api/geopolitical/risk")
def get_geopolitical_risk():
    """Geopolitical Risk Dashboard. [GEO_DEDUP_V1]
    Appelle directement data_geopolitical.fetch_geopolitical_risk() qui gere
    son propre cache module et l'attente du background pre-fetch.
    Le _geo_cache disque sert de fallback si l'appel direct echoue."""
    import time as _t, threading
    try:
        data = data_geopolitical.fetch_geopolitical_risk()
        if data:
            enriched = _enrich_geo_data(data)
            clean = _sanitize_for_json(enriched)
            _geo_cache["data"] = clean
            _geo_cache["ts"] = _t.time()
            _save_geo_cache(_geo_cache)
            return JSONResponse(content=clean)
    except Exception as _e:
        print(f"[GEO-API] fetch direct echoue: {_e}; bascule sur cache disque")

    # Fallback: cache disque persiste
    if _geo_cache.get("data"):
        print("[GEO-API] Sert cache disque (age=" + str(int(_t.time() - _geo_cache.get("ts", 0))) + "s)")
        return JSONResponse(content=_geo_cache["data"])

    raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="Donnees geopolitiques en cours de chargement. Rechargez dans 30s.")
