/* =====================================================
   UTILITIES
   ===================================================== */

/** Format a number as USD currency */
function fmtUSD(n) {
  if (n == null || isNaN(n)) return '—';
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
    style: 'currency',
    currency: 'USD',
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  }).format(n);
}

/** Format a large USD number with K/M/B suffix */
function fmtUSDCompact(n) {
  if (n == null || isNaN(n)) return '—';
  const abs = Math.abs(n);
  const sign = n < 0 ? '-' : '';
  if (abs >= 1e9) return sign + '$' + (abs / 1e9).toFixed(2) + 'B';
  if (abs >= 1e6) return sign + '$' + (abs / 1e6).toFixed(2) + 'M';
  if (abs >= 1e3) return sign + '$' + (abs / 1e3).toFixed(1) + 'K';
  return fmtUSD(n);
}

/** Format a percentage */
function fmtPct(n, decimals = 2) {
  if (n == null || isNaN(n)) return '—';
  const sign = n > 0 ? '+' : '';
  return sign + Number(n).toFixed(decimals) + '%';
}

/** Format a number with commas */
function fmtNum(n, decimals = 0) {
  if (n == null || isNaN(n)) return '—';
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
    minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
    maximumFractionDigits: decimals,
  }).format(n);
}

/** Smart quantity format: uses up to 4 decimals for fractional quantities (crypto) */
function fmtQty(n) {
  if (n == null || isNaN(n)) return '—';
  const abs = Math.abs(n);
  const dec = abs < 1 ? 4 : abs < 100 ? 2 : 0;
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
    minimumFractionDigits: dec,
    maximumFractionDigits: dec,
  }).format(n);
}

/** Format a date string to readable format */
function fmtDate(dateStr) {
  if (!dateStr) return '—';
  const d = new Date(dateStr);
  if (isNaN(d)) return dateStr;
  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' });
}

/** Format datetime for activity feed */
function fmtDatetime(dateStr) {
  if (!dateStr) return '—';
  const d = new Date(dateStr);
  if (isNaN(d)) return dateStr;
  const now = new Date();
  const diffMs = now - d;
  const diffMin = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
  const diffHr = Math.floor(diffMs / 3600000);
  if (diffMin < 1) return 'just now';
  if (diffMin < 60) return diffMin + 'm ago';
  if (diffHr < 24) return diffHr + 'h ago';
  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
}

/** Determine color class for a value */
function colorClass(val) {
  if (!val && val !== 0) return '';
  if (val > 0) return 'text-positive';
  if (val < 0) return 'text-negative';
  return 'text-muted';
}

/** Escape HTML */
function esc(str) {
  if (!str) return '';
  return String(str)
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

/** Minimal Markdown → HTML renderer */
function renderMarkdown(md) {
  if (!md) return '<div class="empty-state">No content.</div>';

  // --- Phase 1: Extract and convert Markdown tables before other processing ---
  const tableBlocks = [];
  const TABLE_PLACEHOLDER = '%%TABLE_BLOCK_';

  // Match table blocks: header row, separator row, then data rows
  md = md.replace(
    /^(\|.+\|)\r?\n(\|[\s:|-]+\|)\r?\n((?:\|.+\|(?:\r?\n|$))*)/gm,
    (match, headerLine, separatorLine, bodyBlock) => {
      const parseRow = (line) =>
        line.trim().replace(/^\|/, '').replace(/\|$/, '').split('|').map(c => c.trim());

      // Parse alignment from separator
      const aligns = parseRow(separatorLine).map(seg => {
        const s = seg.trim();
        if (s.startsWith(':') && s.endsWith(':')) return 'center';
        if (s.endsWith(':')) return 'right';
        return 'left';
      });

      // Inline markdown for cell content
      const inlineMd = (t) => t
        .replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>')
        .replace(/\*(.+?)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>')
        .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>');

      const headerCells = parseRow(headerLine);
      let tableHtml = '<div class="table-scroll-wrapper"><table class="memo-table"><thead><tr>';
      headerCells.forEach((cell, i) => {
        const align = aligns[i] || 'left';
        tableHtml += `<th style="text-align:${align}">${inlineMd(cell)}</th>`;
      });
      tableHtml += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

      const bodyLines = bodyBlock.trim().split('\n').filter(l => l.trim());
      bodyLines.forEach((line, rowIdx) => {
        const cells = parseRow(line);
        const rowClass = rowIdx % 2 === 0 ? 'even' : 'odd';
        tableHtml += `<tr class="${rowClass}">`;
        cells.forEach((cell, i) => {
          const align = aligns[i] || 'left';
          tableHtml += `<td style="text-align:${align}">${inlineMd(cell)}</td>`;
        });
        tableHtml += '</tr>';
      });

      tableHtml += '</tbody></table></div>';
      const idx = tableBlocks.length;
      tableBlocks.push(tableHtml);
      return `${TABLE_PLACEHOLDER}${idx}%%`;
    }
  );

  // --- Phase 2: Standard markdown transforms ---
  let html = md
    // Headings
    .replace(/^### (.+)$/gm, '<h3>$1</h3>')
    .replace(/^## (.+)$/gm, '<h2>$1</h2>')
    .replace(/^# (.+)$/gm, '<h1>$1</h1>')
    // Horizontal rule
    .replace(/^---+$/gm, '<hr>')
    // Blockquote
    .replace(/^> (.+)$/gm, '<blockquote>$1</blockquote>')
    // Bold
    .replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>')
    // Italic
    .replace(/\*(.+?)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>')
    // Inline code
    .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>')
    // Unordered list items
    .replace(/^\s*[-*] (.+)$/gm, '<li>$1</li>')
    // Ordered list items
    .replace(/^\s*\d+\. (.+)$/gm, '<li>$1</li>')
    // Wrap consecutive <li> in <ul>
    .replace(/(<li>[\s\S]*?<\/li>)(\s*<li>[\s\S]*?<\/li>)*/g, (m) => `<ul>${m}</ul>`)
    // Paragraphs (lines with content not yet wrapped)
    .replace(/^(?!<[a-z])(.*\S.*)$/gm, '<p>$1</p>')
    // Clean empty paragraphs
    .replace(/<p>\s*<\/p>/g, '');

  // --- Phase 3: Restore table blocks ---
  tableBlocks.forEach((tbl, i) => {
    html = html.replace(`<p>${TABLE_PLACEHOLDER}${i}%%</p>`, tbl);
    html = html.replace(`${TABLE_PLACEHOLDER}${i}%%`, tbl);
  });

  return html;
}

/* =====================================================
   API LAYER
   ===================================================== */

async function apiFetch(path, opts = {}) {
  const url = `${API_BASE}${path}`;
  const headers = { ...opts.headers };
  // Add auth token if available
  if (state.token) {
    headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${state.token}`;
  }
  // Always set Content-Type for POST/PUT/PATCH
  if (opts.method && opts.method !== 'GET') {
    headers['Content-Type'] = headers['Content-Type'] || 'application/json';
  }
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    ...opts,
    headers,
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
  }
  return res.json();
}

async function apiPost(path, body = {}) {
  return apiFetch(path, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
}

/* =====================================================
   TOAST NOTIFICATIONS
   ===================================================== */

function showToast(message, type = 'info', duration = 4000) {
  const container = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
  const toast = document.createElement('div');
  toast.className = `toast ${type}`;

  const iconMap = {
    success: '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"/></svg>',
    error:   '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><line x1="15" y1="9" x2="9" y2="15"/><line x1="9" y1="9" x2="15" y2="15"/></svg>',
    info:    '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="12"/><line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16"/></svg>',
  };

  toast.innerHTML = `${iconMap[type] || iconMap.info}<span>${esc(message)}</span>`;
  container.appendChild(toast);

  setTimeout(() => {
    toast.style.opacity = '0';
    toast.style.transform = 'translateY(8px)';
    toast.style.transition = 'all 0.2s ease';
    setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 200);
  }, duration);
}

/* =====================================================
   THEME TOGGLE
   ===================================================== */

function initTheme() {
  const toggle = document.getElementById('themeToggle');
  const root = document.documentElement;

  // Default to dark for finance professionals
  let theme = 'dark';
  root.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);

  if (toggle) {
    toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      theme = theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
      root.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', `Switch to ${theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'} mode`);
      toggle.innerHTML = theme === 'dark'
        ? `<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"/></svg>`
        : `<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5"/><path d="M12 1v2M12 21v2M4.22 4.22l1.42 1.42M18.36 18.36l1.42 1.42M1 12h2M21 12h2M4.22 19.78l1.42-1.42M18.36 5.64l1.42-1.42"/></svg>`;

      // Re-render chart in new theme colors
      if (state.portfolioChart) {
        updateChartTheme();
      }
    });
  }
}

/* =====================================================
   CLOCK
   ===================================================== */

function initClock() {
  const el = document.getElementById('headerDatetime');
  function tick() {
    const now = new Date();
    el.textContent = now.toLocaleString('en-US', {
      weekday: 'short',
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
      year: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      second: '2-digit',
      hour12: false,
    });
  }
  tick();
  setInterval(tick, 1000);
}

/* =====================================================
   SIDEBAR COLLAPSE
   ===================================================== */

function initSidebar() {
  const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('sidebarToggle');
  const dashboard = document.getElementById('dashboard');
  const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');

  toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const collapsed = dashboard.classList.toggle('sidebar-collapsed');
    sidebar.classList.toggle('sidebar-collapsed', collapsed);
    toggleBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', collapsed ? 'Expand sidebar' : 'Collapse sidebar');
  });
}

/* =====================================================
   TAB ROUTING
   ===================================================== */

const TAB_TITLES = {
  today:    'Today',
  theses:   'Theses',
  orders:   'Orders & Executions',
  market:   'Market Intel',
  macro:    'Macro US',
  memos:    'IC Memos',
  backtest: 'Backtest',
  admin:    'Administration',
};

function navigateToTab(tabId) {
  if (!TAB_TITLES[tabId]) tabId = 'today';

  // Update nav items
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(item => {
    item.classList.toggle('active', item.dataset.tab === tabId);
  });

  // Update tab content
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(section => {
    section.classList.toggle('active', section.id === `tab-${tabId}`);
  });

  // Update header title
  document.getElementById('headerTitle').textContent = TAB_TITLES[tabId];

  // Update hash without scroll
  history.replaceState(null, '', '#' + tabId);

  state.activeTab = tabId;

  // Load data for the tab if not yet loaded
  loadTabData(tabId);
}

function initRouter() {
  // Nav item clicks
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      navigateToTab(item.dataset.tab);
    });
    item.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        navigateToTab(item.dataset.tab);
      }
    });
  });

  // Hash-based routing on load
  const hash = window.location.hash.replace('#', '');
  navigateToTab(hash || 'today');
}

/* =====================================================
   DATA LOADING PER TAB
   ===================================================== */

async function loadTabData(tabId) {
  switch (tabId) {
    case 'today':
      await Promise.all([loadDashboard(), loadPortfolioHistory()]);
      break;
    case 'theses':
      await loadTheses();
      break;
    case 'orders':
      await Promise.all([loadOrders(), loadFills()]);
      break;
    case 'market':
      await loadMarketIntel();
      break;
    case 'macro':
      await Promise.all([loadMacroData(), loadGeoRiskData(), loadSentiment()]);
      break;
    case 'memos':
      await loadMemos();
      break;
    case 'admin':
      await Promise.all([loadAdminUsers(), loadSchedulerStatus()]);
      break;
  }
}

async function refreshAll() {
  if (state.isRefreshing) return;
  state.isRefreshing = true;
  const icon = document.getElementById('refreshIcon');
  icon.classList.add('spin');

  try {
    await loadTabData(state.activeTab);
    showToast('Data refreshed', 'success', 2000);
  } catch (err) {
    showToast('Refresh failed: ' + err.message, 'error');
  } finally {
    state.isRefreshing = false;
    icon.classList.remove('spin');
  }
}

function renderKPIs(data) {
  const p = data.portfolio || {};
  const pv = p.total_value ?? data.portfolio_value ?? data.nav ?? null;
  const cash = p.cash ?? data.cash ?? data.cash_available ?? null;
  const pnl = p.daily_pnl ?? data.daily_pnl ?? data.pnl_today ?? null;
  const var95 = p.var_95 ?? data.var_95 ?? data.var ?? null;
  const totalPnl = p.total_pnl ?? data.total_pnl ?? null;
  const totalPnlPct = p.total_pnl_pct ?? data.portfolio_change_pct ?? data.nav_change_pct ?? null;
  // [FIX_UI_PNL_2FIELDS_AND_FLOWS_V2] 2 champs P&L
  const unrealizedPnl = p.unrealized_pnl ?? totalPnl;
  const unrealizedPnlPct = p.unrealized_pnl_pct ?? totalPnlPct;
  const totalReturn = p.total_return ?? p.total_pnl ?? null;
  const totalReturnPct = p.total_return_pct ?? p.total_pnl_pct ?? null;

  const kpiGrid = document.getElementById('kpiGrid');
  // [FIX_UI_PNL_6_CARDS_V4]
  kpiGrid.innerHTML = `
    <div class="kpi-card">
      <div class="kpi-label">Portfolio Value</div>
      <div class="kpi-value mono">${fmtUSDCompact(pv)}</div>
      <div class="kpi-delta neutral">AUM</div>
    </div>
    <div class="kpi-card">
      <div class="kpi-label">Unrealized P&amp;L</div>
      <div class="kpi-value mono ${colorClass(unrealizedPnl)}">${fmtUSD(unrealizedPnl)}</div>
      <div class="kpi-delta ${unrealizedPnlPct > 0 ? 'positive' : unrealizedPnlPct < 0 ? 'negative' : 'neutral'}">
        ${unrealizedPnlPct > 0 ? '\u25B2' : unrealizedPnlPct < 0 ? '\u25BC' : ''}
        ${fmtPct(unrealizedPnlPct)}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="kpi-card">
      <div class="kpi-label">Total Return</div>
      <div class="kpi-value mono ${colorClass(totalReturn)}">${fmtUSD(totalReturn)}</div>
      <div class="kpi-delta ${totalReturnPct > 0 ? 'positive' : totalReturnPct < 0 ? 'negative' : 'neutral'}">
        ${totalReturnPct > 0 ? '\u25B2' : totalReturnPct < 0 ? '\u25BC' : ''}
        ${fmtPct(totalReturnPct)}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="kpi-card">
      <div class="kpi-label">Cash Available</div>
      <div class="kpi-value mono">${fmtUSDCompact(cash)}</div>
      <div class="kpi-delta neutral">
        ${cash != null && pv != null ? fmtPct((cash / pv) * 100) + ' of NAV' : ''}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="kpi-card">
      <div class="kpi-label">Daily P&amp;L</div>
      <div class="kpi-value mono ${colorClass(pnl)}">${fmtUSD(pnl)}</div>
      <div class="kpi-delta ${pnl > 0 ? 'positive' : pnl < 0 ? 'negative' : 'neutral'}">
        ${pnl > 0 ? '\u25B2' : pnl < 0 ? '\u25BC' : ''}
        ${pnl != null && pv != null ? fmtPct((pnl / pv) * 100) : ''}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="kpi-card">
      <div class="kpi-label">VaR (95%)</div>
      <div class="kpi-value mono text-negative">${fmtPct(var95)}</div>
      <div class="kpi-delta neutral">${var95 != null && pv != null ? fmtUSDCompact(pv * var95 / 100) + ' at risk' : ''}</div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function renderPositions(positions) {
  const tbody = document.getElementById('positionsBody');
  if (!positions.length) {
    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7" class="empty-state">No positions</td></tr>';
    return;
  }

  tbody.innerHTML = positions.map(p => {
    const pnl = p.unrealized_pnl ?? p.pnl ?? null;
    const pnlPct = p.pnl_pct ?? (p.avg_cost && p.current_price
      ? ((p.current_price - p.avg_cost) / p.avg_cost) * 100
      : null);
    const weight = p.weight_pct ?? p.weight ?? null;

    return `
      <tr>
        <td><a href="#" class="ticker-link" onclick="openTickerDetail('${esc(p.ticker || p.symbol)}');return false" style="color:var(--color-accent,#3b82f6);text-decoration:none;font-weight:700">${esc(p.ticker || p.symbol)}</a></td>
        <td class="mono">${fmtQty(p.quantity ?? p.qty)}</td>
        <td class="num mono">${fmtUSD(p.avg_cost)}</td>
        <td class="num mono">${fmtUSD(p.current_price)}</td>
        <td class="num mono ${colorClass(pnl)}">${fmtUSD(pnl)}</td>
        <td class="num mono ${colorClass(pnlPct)}">${fmtPct(pnlPct)}</td>
        <td class="num mono">${weight != null ? fmtPct(weight, 1) : '—'}</td>
      </tr>
    `;
  }).join('');
}

      <tr data-edit-idx="${i}">
        <td><strong>${esc(p.ticker || p.symbol)}</strong><br><span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--color-text-muted)">${esc(p.name || '')}</span></td>
        <td><input type="number" class="edit-qty" value="${p.quantity ?? p.qty ?? 0}" step="1" style="${inputStyle}" data-idx="${i}" /></td>
        <td class="num"><input type="number" class="edit-avg" value="${(p.avg_cost || 0).toFixed(2)}" step="0.01" style="${inputStyle}" data-idx="${i}" /></td>
        <td class="num mono" style="color:var(--color-text-muted)">${fmtUSD(p.current_price)}</td>
        <td class="num mono ${colorClass(pnl)}">${fmtUSD(pnl)}</td>
        <td class="num mono ${colorClass(pnlPct)}">${fmtPct(pnlPct)}</td>
        <td class="num">
          <button onclick="_removePosition(${i})" style="background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;color:#e74c3c;font-size:14px" title="Supprimer">&times;</button>
        </td>
      </tr>
    `;
  }).join('');

  // Add new position row
  html += `
    <tr id="addPositionRow" style="border-top:2px dashed var(--color-border)">
      <td>
        <input type="text" id="newTicker" placeholder="TICKER" list="tickerSuggestions" style="background:var(--color-surface-alt,rgba(255,255,255,0.04));color:var(--color-text);border:1px solid var(--color-border);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:3px 6px;font-size:var(--text-xs);font-family:var(--font-mono);width:80px;text-transform:uppercase" />
        <datalist id="tickerSuggestions">
          ${Object.keys(KNOWN_TICKERS).map(t => `<option value="${t}">${KNOWN_TICKERS[t].name}</option>`).join('')}
        </datalist>
      </td>
      <td><input type="number" id="newQty" placeholder="Qty" step="1" style="${inputStyle}" /></td>
      <td class="num"><input type="number" id="newAvg" placeholder="Avg Cost" step="0.01" style="${inputStyle}" /></td>
      <td colspan="3" style="font-size:var(--text-xs);color:var(--color-text-muted)">Ajouter une position</td>
      <td class="num">
        <button onclick="_addNewPosition()" style="background:#20808D;color:#fff;border:none;cursor:pointer;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:3px 10px;font-size:var(--text-xs)">+</button>
      </td>
    </tr>
  `;

  // Save button row
  html += `
    <tr>
      <td colspan="7" style="padding:var(--space-3);text-align:right;border-top:1px solid var(--color-divider)">
        <button onclick="savePortfolioEdits()" style="background:#20808D;color:#fff;border:none;cursor:pointer;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:6px 20px;font-size:var(--text-sm);font-weight:600">Sauvegarder</button>
      </td>
    </tr>
  `;

  // Update header to show "Ticker / Nom" and "Suppr" for the last col
  const thead = document.querySelector('#positionsTable thead');
  thead.innerHTML = `
    <tr>
      <th>Ticker / Nom</th>
      <th>Qty</th>
      <th class="num">Avg Cost</th>
      <th class="num">Price</th>
      <th class="num">P&amp;L</th>
      <th class="num">P&amp;L %</th>
      <th class="num"></th>
    </tr>
  `;

  tbody.innerHTML = html;
}

function _addNewPosition() {
  const tickerInput = document.getElementById('newTicker');
  const qtyInput = document.getElementById('newQty');
  const avgInput = document.getElementById('newAvg');

  const ticker = (tickerInput.value || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  const qty = parseFloat(qtyInput.value);
  const avg = parseFloat(avgInput.value);

  if (!ticker || isNaN(qty) || qty <= 0) {
    showToast('Veuillez saisir un ticker et une quantit\u00e9 valide.', 'error');
    return;
  }

  const known = KNOWN_TICKERS[ticker];
  const currentPrice = known ? known.price : (isNaN(avg) ? 0 : avg);
  const avgCost = isNaN(avg) ? currentPrice : avg;

  const newPos = {
    id: Date.now(),
    instrument_id: Date.now(),
    quantity: qty,
    avg_cost: avgCost,
    current_price: currentPrice,
    unrealized_pnl: (currentPrice - avgCost) * qty,
    weight_pct: 0, // will be recalculated on save
    ticker: ticker,
    name: known ? known.name : ticker,
    sector: known ? known.sector : 'Unknown',
    asset_class: known ? known.asset_class : 'equity',
    latest_close: currentPrice,
    price_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
    market_value: currentPrice * qty,
    unrealized_pnl_pct: avgCost > 0 ? ((currentPrice - avgCost) / avgCost) * 100 : 0,
  };

  const dashData = window.MOCK_API_DATA['/api/dashboard'];
  dashData.positions.push(newPos);
  _renderEditablePositions();
  showToast(`${ticker} ajout\u00e9 (${qty} parts)`, 'success');
}

function _removePosition(idx) {
  const dashData = window.MOCK_API_DATA['/api/dashboard'];
  const positions = dashData?.positions || [];
  if (idx >= 0 && idx < positions.length) {
    const removed = positions.splice(idx, 1)[0];
    _renderEditablePositions();
    showToast(`${removed.ticker} supprim\u00e9`, 'info');
  }
}

function savePortfolioEdits() {
  const dashData = window.MOCK_API_DATA['/api/dashboard'];
  const positions = dashData?.positions || [];

  // Read cash
  const cashInput = document.getElementById('cashInput');
  const newCash = parseFloat(cashInput.value);
  if (isNaN(newCash) || newCash < 0) {
    showToast('Valeur de cash invalide', 'error');
    return;
  }

  // Read edited qty and avg for each existing position
  const qtyInputs = document.querySelectorAll('.edit-qty');
  const avgInputs = document.querySelectorAll('.edit-avg');

  for (let i = 0; i < positions.length; i++) {
    const qtyEl = qtyInputs[i];
    const avgEl = avgInputs[i];
    if (qtyEl) {
      const newQty = parseFloat(qtyEl.value);
      if (!isNaN(newQty) && newQty >= 0) positions[i].quantity = newQty;
    }
    if (avgEl) {
      const newAvg = parseFloat(avgEl.value);
      if (!isNaN(newAvg) && newAvg >= 0) positions[i].avg_cost = newAvg;
    }
  }

  // Filter out zero-quantity positions
  dashData.positions = positions.filter(p => p.quantity > 0);

  // Recalculate derived fields
  let totalMarketValue = 0;
  dashData.positions.forEach(p => {
    p.market_value = p.current_price * p.quantity;
    p.unrealized_pnl = (p.current_price - p.avg_cost) * p.quantity;
    p.unrealized_pnl_pct = p.avg_cost > 0 ? ((p.current_price - p.avg_cost) / p.avg_cost) * 100 : 0;
    totalMarketValue += p.market_value;
  });

  const totalValue = totalMarketValue + newCash;

  // Recalculate weight_pct
  dashData.positions.forEach(p => {
    p.weight_pct = totalValue > 0 ? (p.market_value / totalValue) * 100 : 0;
  });

  // Update portfolio summary
  const totalCost = dashData.positions.reduce((s, p) => s + (p.avg_cost * p.quantity), 0);
  dashData.portfolio.cash = newCash;
  dashData.portfolio.total_value = totalValue;
  dashData.portfolio.total_pnl = totalMarketValue - totalCost;
  dashData.portfolio.total_pnl_pct = totalCost > 0 ? ((totalMarketValue - totalCost) / totalCost) * 100 : 0;

  // Exit edit mode
  _portfolioEditMode = false;
  const editBtn = document.getElementById('portfolioEditBtn');
  editBtn.innerHTML = '<svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" style="vertical-align:middle;margin-right:2px"><path d="M11 4H4a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-7"/><path d="M18.5 2.5a2.121 2.121 0 0 1 3 3L12 15l-4 1 1-4 9.5-9.5z"/></svg> Modifier';
  editBtn.style.color = 'var(--color-text-muted)';
  editBtn.style.borderColor = 'var(--color-border)';
  document.getElementById('portfolioCashRow').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('portfolioResetBtn').style.display = 'inline-flex';

  // Restore normal table header
  const thead = document.querySelector('#positionsTable thead');
  thead.innerHTML = `
    <tr>
      <th>Ticker</th>
      <th>Qty</th>
      <th class="num">Avg Cost</th>
      <th class="num">Price</th>
      <th class="num">P&amp;L</th>
      <th class="num">P&amp;L %</th>
      <th class="num">Weight</th>
    </tr>
  `;

  // Re-render dashboard
  renderKPIs(dashData);
  renderPositions(dashData.positions);

  _userPortfolio = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(dashData));
  showToast('Portefeuille mis \u00e0 jour', 'success');
}

function resetPortfolio() {
  if (!_originalDashboardData) return;

  // Restore original data
  window.MOCK_API_DATA['/api/dashboard'] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(_originalDashboardData));
  _userPortfolio = null;

  // Exit edit mode if active
  if (_portfolioEditMode) {
    _portfolioEditMode = false;
    const editBtn = document.getElementById('portfolioEditBtn');
    editBtn.innerHTML = '<svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" style="vertical-align:middle;margin-right:2px"><path d="M11 4H4a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-7"/><path d="M18.5 2.5a2.121 2.121 0 0 1 3 3L12 15l-4 1 1-4 9.5-9.5z"/></svg> Modifier';
    editBtn.style.color = 'var(--color-text-muted)';
    editBtn.style.borderColor = 'var(--color-border)';
    document.getElementById('portfolioCashRow').style.display = 'none';
  }

  document.getElementById('portfolioResetBtn').style.display = 'none';

  // Restore normal table header
  const thead = document.querySelector('#positionsTable thead');
  thead.innerHTML = `
    <tr>
      <th>Ticker</th>
      <th>Qty</th>
      <th class="num">Avg Cost</th>
      <th class="num">Price</th>
      <th class="num">P&amp;L</th>
      <th class="num">P&amp;L %</th>
      <th class="num">Weight</th>
    </tr>
  `;

  // Re-render dashboard
  const dashData = window.MOCK_API_DATA['/api/dashboard'];
  renderKPIs(dashData);
  renderPositions(dashData.positions || []);

  showToast('Portefeuille r\u00e9initialis\u00e9', 'info');
}

async function loadEvents() {
  try {
    const data = await apiFetch('/api/events');
    renderActivityFeed(data.events || data || []);
  } catch (err) {
    document.getElementById('activityList').innerHTML = `<div class="inline-error">Could not load activity: ${esc(err.message)}</div>`;
  }
}

function renderActivityFeed(events) {
  const list = document.getElementById('activityList');
  if (!events.length) {
    list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No recent activity</div>';
    return;
  }

  list.innerHTML = events.slice(0, 12).map(ev => {
    const type = (ev.event_type ?? ev.type ?? 'EVENT').replace(/_/g, ' ');
    let desc = '';
    if (typeof ev.details === 'object' && ev.details !== null) {
      // Extract meaningful info from details object
      const d = ev.details;
      if (d.ticker) desc = d.ticker;
      else if (d.instrument) desc = d.instrument;
      else if (d.stance) desc = 'Stance: ' + d.stance + (d.conviction ? ' (' + d.conviction + '/10)' : '');
      else if (d.decision) desc = d.decision;
      else if (d.notes) desc = d.notes;
      else {
        // Pick first meaningful string value
        const firstVal = Object.entries(d).find(([k, v]) => typeof v === 'string' && v.length < 60);
        desc = firstVal ? firstVal[1] : (d.agent_type || d.agent || '');
      }
    } else {
      desc = ev.description ?? ev.message ?? String(ev.details ?? '');
    }
    const agent = ev.agent ?? '';
    const ts = ev.created_at ?? ev.timestamp ?? ev.ts ?? '';
    return `
      <div class="activity-item">
        <div class="activity-item-header">
          <span class="activity-type">${esc(type)}</span>
          <span class="activity-time">${fmtDatetime(ts)}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="activity-desc">${esc(desc)}${agent ? ' <span class="text-muted">(' + esc(agent) + ')</span>' : ''}</div>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join('');
}

/* =====================================================
   TODAY TAB — Portfolio History Chart
   ===================================================== */

function getChartColors() {
  const isDark = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark';
  return {
    primary: isDark ? '#4db8bf' : '#01696f',
    primaryAlpha: isDark ? 'rgba(77,184,191,0.12)' : 'rgba(1,105,111,0.10)',
    grid: isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.06)',
    tick: isDark ? '#4a4947' : '#bab9b4',
  };
}

function updateChartTheme() {
  if (!state.portfolioChart) return;
  const colors = getChartColors();
  const chart = state.portfolioChart;

  chart.data.datasets[0].borderColor = colors.primary;
  chart.data.datasets[0].backgroundColor = colors.primaryAlpha;
  chart.data.datasets[0].pointBorderColor = colors.primary;

  chart.options.scales.x.ticks.color = colors.tick;
  chart.options.scales.x.grid.color = colors.grid;
  chart.options.scales.y.ticks.color = colors.tick;
  chart.options.scales.y.grid.color = colors.grid;

  chart.update('none');
}

// [UI_CHART_PERIOD_BENCHMARKS_V1]
if (typeof state !== 'undefined') {
  state.chartPeriod     = state.chartPeriod     || '30d';
  state.chartBenchmarks = state.chartBenchmarks || new Set();
}
const CHART_PERIOD_LABEL = { '30d': '30 jours', '6m': '6 mois', '1y': '1 an', 'all': 'depuis le debut' };

async function loadPortfolioHistory() {
  try {
    const period = (state && state.chartPeriod) || '30d';
    const benchSet = (state && state.chartBenchmarks) || new Set();
    const benchCsv = Array.from(benchSet).join(',');
    const qs = '?period=' + encodeURIComponent(period) + (benchCsv ? '&benchmarks=' + encodeURIComponent(benchCsv) : '');
    const data = await apiFetch('/api/portfolio/history' + qs);
    const portfolio = data.portfolio || data.history || data.data || data || [];
    const benchmarks = data.benchmarks || {};
    renderPortfolioChart(portfolio, benchmarks);

    const title = document.getElementById('chartTitle');
    if (title) title.textContent = 'Portfolio \u2014 ' + (CHART_PERIOD_LABEL[period] || period);
    const label = document.getElementById('chartUpdateLabel');
    if (label) label.textContent = 'Updated ' + fmtDatetime(new Date().toISOString());
  } catch (err) {
    renderPortfolioChart(generatePlaceholderHistory(), {});
    const lbl = document.getElementById('chartUpdateLabel');
    if (lbl) lbl.textContent = 'Live data unavailable';
  }
}

function _normalizeBase100(arr, valueKey) {
  if (!arr || !arr.length) return [];
  const base = arr[0][valueKey] || 1;
  return arr.map(d => ({ date: d.date, v: (d[valueKey] / base) * 100 }));
}

function _initChartControls() {
  if (window.__chartControlsInit) return;
  window.__chartControlsInit = true;
  document.querySelectorAll('.chart-period-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const p = btn.getAttribute('data-period');
      if (state) state.chartPeriod = p;
      document.querySelectorAll('.chart-period-btn').forEach(b => {
        const active = b === btn;
        b.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
        b.style.background = active ? 'var(--color-surface-alt,rgba(255,255,255,0.04))' : 'transparent';
        b.style.color = active ? 'var(--color-text)' : 'var(--color-text-muted)';
      });
      loadPortfolioHistory();
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.chart-bench-toggle').forEach(cb => {
    cb.addEventListener('change', () => {
      const t = cb.getAttribute('data-ticker');
      if (!state) return;
      if (!state.chartBenchmarks) state.chartBenchmarks = new Set();
      if (cb.checked) state.chartBenchmarks.add(t); else state.chartBenchmarks.delete(t);
      loadPortfolioHistory();
    });
  });
}

function generatePlaceholderHistory() {
  const now = Date.now();
  const points = [];
  let val = 1000000;
  for (let i = 29; i >= 0; i--) {
    val = val * (1 + (Math.random() - 0.48) * 0.012);
    points.push({
      date: new Date(now - i * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      value: val,
    });
  }
  return points;
}

function renderPortfolioChart(history, benchmarks) {
  const colors = getChartColors();
  const canvas = document.getElementById('portfolioChart');
  if (!canvas) return;
  benchmarks = benchmarks || {};

  // Master labels = portfolio dates
  const labels = history.map(d => {
    const dateStr = d.date || d.timestamp || d.ts || '';
    const dt = new Date(dateStr);
    return isNaN(dt) ? dateStr : dt.toLocaleDateString('fr-FR', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
  });

  // Portfolio in base 100
  const pfValues = history.map(d => {
    if (typeof d.perf_base100 === 'number') return d.perf_base100;
    return d.total_value || d.value || d.nav || 0;
  });
  // If raw values, normalize ourselves
  let pfNorm = pfValues;
  if (pfValues.length && pfValues[0] !== 100 && !history[0].perf_base100) {
    const base = pfValues[0] || 1;
    pfNorm = pfValues.map(v => (v / base) * 100);
  }

  const datasets = [{
    label: 'Portfolio',
    data: pfNorm,
    borderColor: colors.primary,
    backgroundColor: colors.primaryAlpha,
    borderWidth: 1.8,
    tension: 0.25,
    fill: true,
    pointRadius: 0,
    pointHoverRadius: 4,
  }];

  // Align benchmark series on the portfolio's date axis
  // (forward-fill missing dates via last-known value).
  const BENCH_COLORS = { SPY: '#3498db', QQQ: '#9b59b6' };
  Object.keys(benchmarks).forEach(tk => {
    const series = benchmarks[tk] || [];
    if (!series.length) return;
    const byDate = {};
    series.forEach(s => { byDate[s.date] = (typeof s.perf_base100 === 'number') ? s.perf_base100 : null; });
    let last = null;
    const aligned = history.map(d => {
      const k = d.date;
      if (byDate[k] != null) { last = byDate[k]; }
      return last;
    });
    datasets.push({
      label: tk,
      data: aligned,
      borderColor: BENCH_COLORS[tk] || '#888',
      backgroundColor: 'transparent',
      borderWidth: 1.4,
      borderDash: [4, 3],
      tension: 0.25,
      fill: false,
      pointRadius: 0,
      pointHoverRadius: 4,
    });
  });

  if (state.portfolioChart) {
    state.portfolioChart.destroy();
  }

  state.portfolioChart = new Chart(canvas, {
    type: 'line',
    data: { labels, datasets },
    options: {
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      animation: { duration: 400, easing: 'easeInOutQuart' },
      interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
      plugins: {
        legend: {
          display: datasets.length > 1,
          position: 'top',
          align: 'end',
          labels: { color: colors.tick, font: { family: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace", size: 10 }, boxWidth: 10 },
        },
        tooltip: {
          backgroundColor: '#1c1c1b',
          titleColor: '#706f6d',
          bodyColor: '#c8c7c5',
          borderColor: '#302f2d',
          borderWidth: 1,
          padding: 10,
          callbacks: {
            label: (ctx) => {
              const v = ctx.parsed.y;
              if (v == null) return ctx.dataset.label + ' : -';
              const perf = (v - 100).toFixed(2);
              const sign = perf >= 0 ? '+' : '';
              return ctx.dataset.label + ' : ' + v.toFixed(2) + '  (' + sign + perf + '%)';
            },
          },
        },
      },
      scales: {
        x: {
          grid: { color: colors.grid, drawBorder: false },
          ticks: {
            color: colors.tick,
            font: { family: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace", size: 10 },
            maxTicksLimit: 8,
            maxRotation: 0,
          },
        },
        y: {
          position: 'right',
          grid: { color: colors.grid, drawBorder: false },
          ticks: {
            color: colors.tick,
            font: { family: "'JetBrains Mono', monospace", size: 10 },
            callback: (val) => Number(val).toFixed(0),
          },
        },
      },
    },
  });

  _initChartControls();
}

/* =====================================================
   THESES TAB
   ===================================================== */

async function loadTheses() {
  try {
    const data = await apiFetch('/api/theses');
    state.theses = data.theses ?? data ?? [];
    renderTheses(state.theses);
  } catch (err) {
    document.getElementById('thesesBody').innerHTML = `
      <tr><td colspan="8" class="inline-error">Failed to load theses: ${esc(err.message)}</td></tr>
    `;
  }
}

function agentBadge(agent) {
  if (!agent) return '<span class="badge badge-gray">—</span>';
  const lower = agent.toLowerCase();
  let cls = 'badge-gray';
  if (lower.includes('macro')) cls = 'badge-blue';
  else if (lower.includes('factor')) cls = 'badge-purple';
  else if (lower.includes('micro')) cls = 'badge-orange';
  else if (lower.includes('alt')) cls = 'badge-teal';
  else if (lower.includes('crypto')) cls = 'badge-crypto';
  return `<span class="badge ${cls}">${esc(agent)}</span>`;
}

function horizonBadge(horizon) {
  if (!horizon) return '';
  const lower = horizon.toLowerCase();
  const cls = lower === 'short' ? 'badge-red' : lower === 'long' ? 'badge-green' : 'badge-gold';
  return `<span class="badge ${cls}">${esc(horizon)}</span>`;
}

function statusBadge(status) {
  if (!status) return '';
  const lower = status.toLowerCase();
  const cls = lower === 'active' ? 'badge-green'
    : lower === 'paused'   ? 'badge-gold'
    : lower === 'closed'   ? 'badge-gray'
    : 'badge-gray';
  return `<span class="badge ${cls}">${esc(status)}</span>`;
}

function convictionBar(score) {
  const pct = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (score / 10) * 100));
  return `
    <div class="conviction-bar-wrap">
      <div class="conviction-bar-track">
        <div class="conviction-bar-fill" style="width:${pct}%"></div>
      </div>
      <span class="conviction-number mono">${score ?? '—'}</span>
    </div>
  `;
}

function renderTheses(theses) {
  const horizon = document.getElementById('thesisHorizonFilter').value;
  const agent = document.getElementById('thesisAgentFilter').value;
  const assetClass = document.getElementById('thesisAssetFilter').value;

  let filtered = theses;
  if (horizon) filtered = filtered.filter(t => (t.horizon ?? '').toLowerCase() === horizon);
  if (agent)   filtered = filtered.filter(t => (t.agent_type ?? t.agent ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(agent));
  if (assetClass) filtered = filtered.filter(t => (t.asset_class ?? '').toLowerCase() === assetClass);

  const tbody = document.getElementById('thesesBody');
  if (!filtered.length) {
    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" class="empty-state">No theses match the filter</td></tr>';
    return;
  }

  tbody.innerHTML = filtered.map(t => {
    const summary = t.thesis_text ?? t.thesis_summary ?? t.summary ?? t.thesis ?? '';
    const action = t.proposed_action ?? t.action ?? '';
    const updated = t.updated_at ?? t.last_updated ?? '';
    const conviction = t.conviction_score ?? t.conviction ?? 0;
    const agentType = t.agent_type ?? t.agent ?? '';
    return `
      <tr class="clickable" data-thesis-id="${esc(t.id ?? '')}" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="View thesis for ${esc(t.ticker ?? '')}">
        <td>
          <strong>${(t.asset_class === 'crypto' ? '₿ ' : '')}${esc(t.ticker ?? t.symbol ?? '')}</strong>
          ${t.name ? `<div class="text-muted" style="font-size:var(--text-xs)">${esc(t.name)}</div>` : ''}
        </td>
        <td>${agentBadge(agentType)}</td>
        <td>${convictionBar(conviction)}</td>
        <td>${horizonBadge(t.horizon)}</td>
        <td><span class="truncate" title="${esc(summary)}">${esc(summary.substring(0, 100))}</span></td>
        <td class="text-muted">${esc(action)}</td>
        <td class="text-muted mono" style="font-size:var(--text-xs)">${fmtDate(updated)}</td>
        <td>${statusBadge(t.status)}</td>
      </tr>
    `;
  }).join('');

  // Attach click handlers for detail panel
  tbody.querySelectorAll('tr[data-thesis-id]').forEach(row => {
    row.addEventListener('click', () => openThesisDetail(row.dataset.thesisId));
    row.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        openThesisDetail(row.dataset.thesisId);
      }
    });
  });
}

/* =====================================================
   THESIS DETAIL PANEL
   ===================================================== */

async function openThesisDetail(id) {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('detailOverlay');
  const panel = document.getElementById('detailPanel');
  const body = document.getElementById('detailBody');
  const title = document.getElementById('detailTitle');

  overlay.classList.add('open');
  panel.classList.add('open');
  body.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">Loading…</div>';
  title.textContent = 'Thesis Detail';

  try {
    const thesis = await apiFetch(`/api/theses/${id}`);
    renderThesisDetail(thesis);
  } catch (err) {
    body.innerHTML = `<div class="inline-error">Failed to load thesis: ${esc(err.message)}</div>`;
  }
}

function renderThesisDetail(t) {
  const title = document.getElementById('detailTitle');
  const body = document.getElementById('detailBody');

  title.textContent = `${t.ticker ?? t.symbol ?? ''} — Thesis`;

  const drivers = t.key_drivers ?? t.drivers ?? [];
  const orders = t.linked_orders ?? t.orders ?? [];
  const timeline = t.timeline ?? t.changes ?? [];
  const conviction = t.conviction_score ?? t.conviction ?? '—';
  const agentType = t.agent_type ?? t.agent ?? '';

  body.innerHTML = `
    <div>
      <div class="detail-section-title">Thesis</div>
      <div class="detail-text">${esc(t.thesis_text ?? t.thesis ?? t.thesis_summary ?? 'No thesis text available.')}</div>
    </div>

    <div>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:var(--space-3);flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:var(--space-3)">
        ${agentBadge(agentType)}
        ${horizonBadge(t.horizon)}
        ${statusBadge(t.status)}
        <span class="badge badge-gray">Conviction: ${conviction}/10</span>
      </div>
      <div class="meta-row"><span class="meta-key">Instrument</span><span class="meta-val mono">${esc(t.ticker ?? t.symbol ?? '—')}</span></div>
      <div class="meta-row" style="margin-top:var(--space-2)"><span class="meta-key">Proposed Action</span><span class="meta-val">${esc(t.proposed_action ?? t.action ?? '—')}</span></div>
      <div class="meta-row" style="margin-top:var(--space-2)"><span class="meta-key">Last Updated</span><span class="meta-val mono">${fmtDate(t.updated_at ?? t.last_updated)}</span></div>
    </div>

    ${drivers.length ? `
    <div>
      <div class="detail-section-title">Key Drivers</div>
      <ul class="detail-drivers">
        ${drivers.map(d => `<li>${esc(d)}</li>`).join('')}
      </ul>
    </div>
    ` : ''}

    ${orders.length ? `
    <div>
      <div class="detail-section-title">Linked Orders</div>
      <div class="table-scroll">
        <table>
          <thead><tr><th>Side</th><th>Qty</th><th>Status</th><th>Created</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            ${orders.map(o => `
              <tr>
                <td>${o.side === 'BUY' ? '<span class="badge badge-green">BUY</span>' : '<span class="badge badge-red">SELL</span>'}</td>
                <td class="mono">${fmtQty(o.quantity ?? o.qty)}</td>
                <td>${statusBadge(o.status)}</td>
                <td class="mono text-muted" style="font-size:var(--text-xs)">${fmtDate(o.created_at)}</td>
              </tr>
            `).join('')}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
    ` : ''}

    ${timeline.length ? `
    <div>
      <div class="detail-section-title">Timeline</div>
      <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:var(--space-2)">
        ${timeline.map(ev => `
          <div style="display:flex;gap:var(--space-3);align-items:flex-start">
            <span class="mono text-muted" style="font-size:var(--text-xs);min-width:80px;flex-shrink:0">${fmtDate(ev.date ?? ev.timestamp)}</span>
            <span style="font-size:var(--text-xs);color:var(--color-text-muted)">${esc(ev.description ?? ev.event ?? ev.change ?? '')}</span>
          </div>
        `).join('')}
      </div>
    </div>
    ` : ''}
  `;
}

function closeDetailPanel() {
  const body = document.getElementById('detailBody');
  if (body) { body.querySelectorAll('iframe').forEach(f => { f.src = 'about:blank'; f.remove(); }); body.innerHTML = ''; }
  document.getElementById('detailOverlay').classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('detailPanel').classList.remove('open');
}

// Generic fallback for unknown tickers
function _getTickerFinancials(ticker) {
  if (_mockFinancials[ticker]) return _mockFinancials[ticker];
  // Generate plausible mock for unknown tickers
  const seed = ticker.charCodeAt(0) * 137 + (ticker.charCodeAt(1)||0) * 31;
  const basePrice = 50 + (seed % 200);
  const chart = [];
  let p = basePrice;
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { p += (Math.sin(seed + i) * 3); chart.push(Math.round(p*100)/100); }
  return { name: ticker, price: basePrice, change: '+0.50%', cap: '—', pe: 18.5, eps: (basePrice/18.5).toFixed(2), div: '1.0%', rev:'—', net:'—', margin:'—', debt:'—', cash:'—', beta: 1.0,
    sector:'—', industry:'—', employees:'—', country:'—', ceo:'—', founded:'—', hq:'—', description:'',
    quarterly: [{q:'Q1 2026',rev:'—',eps:'—',surp:'—'},{q:'Q4 2025',rev:'—',eps:'—',surp:'—'}],
    chart: chart };
}

/** Render a custom mini price chart on a canvas element */
function _renderMiniChart(canvasId, data, ticker) {
  const canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  const w = canvas.clientWidth;
  const h = canvas.clientHeight;
  canvas.width = w * dpr;
  canvas.height = h * dpr;
  ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

  const isDark = (document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') || 'dark') !== 'light';
  const pts = data || [];
  if (pts.length < 2) return;

  const min = Math.min(...pts) * 0.998;
  const max = Math.max(...pts) * 1.002;
  const range = max - min || 1;
  const padL = 10, padR = 10, padT = 15, padB = 25;
  const cw = w - padL - padR;
  const ch = h - padT - padB;

  const toX = (i) => padL + (i / (pts.length - 1)) * cw;
  const toY = (v) => padT + (1 - (v - min) / range) * ch;

  // Grid lines
  ctx.strokeStyle = isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.06)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
  for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
    const y = padT + (ch / 4) * i;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(padL, y); ctx.lineTo(w - padR, y); ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Gradient fill
  const isUp = pts[pts.length-1] >= pts[0];
  const lineColor = isUp ? '#22c55e' : '#ef4444';
  const gradTop = isUp ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.25)' : 'rgba(239,68,68,0.25)';
  const gradBot = isUp ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.0)' : 'rgba(239,68,68,0.0)';

  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, padT, 0, h - padB);
  grad.addColorStop(0, gradTop);
  grad.addColorStop(1, gradBot);

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(toX(0), toY(pts[0]));
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(toX(i), toY(pts[i]));
  ctx.lineTo(toX(pts.length-1), h - padB);
  ctx.lineTo(toX(0), h - padB);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fill();

  // Line
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(toX(0), toY(pts[0]));
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) ctx.lineTo(toX(i), toY(pts[i]));
  ctx.strokeStyle = lineColor;
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  ctx.stroke();

  // Price labels on Y axis
  ctx.fillStyle = isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
  ctx.font = '10px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
    const val = min + (range / 4) * (4 - i);
    const y = padT + (ch / 4) * i;
    ctx.fillText('$' + val.toFixed(0), w - padR + 1, y + 3);
  }

  // X labels (simplified: first, mid, last)
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('-30j', toX(0), h - 5);
  ctx.fillText('-15j', toX(Math.floor(pts.length/2)), h - 5);
  ctx.fillText('Auj.', toX(pts.length - 1), h - 5);
}

/** Render custom financials table for a ticker */
function _renderCustomFinancials(containerId, ticker) {
  const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
  if (!container) return;
  const d = _getTickerFinancials(ticker);
  // Use CSS variables so theme changes work without re-render
  const txtMuted = 'var(--color-text-muted)';
  const txtMain = 'var(--color-text)';
  const bgAlt = 'var(--color-surface-offset,rgba(0,0,0,0.03))';
  const accent = '#3b82f6';

  container.innerHTML = `
    <div style="padding:var(--space-4);overflow-y:auto;height:100%;font-size:var(--text-xs)">
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:var(--space-3);margin-bottom:var(--space-4)">
        <div style="background:${bgAlt};border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:var(--space-3)">
          <div style="color:${txtMuted};margin-bottom:2px">P/E Ratio</div>
          <div style="font-size:var(--text-base);font-weight:700;color:${txtMain}">${d.pe}</div>
        </div>
        <div style="background:${bgAlt};border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:var(--space-3)">
          <div style="color:${txtMuted};margin-bottom:2px">EPS (TTM)</div>
          <div style="font-size:var(--text-base);font-weight:700;color:${txtMain}">$${d.eps}</div>
        </div>
        <div style="background:${bgAlt};border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:var(--space-3)">
          <div style="color:${txtMuted};margin-bottom:2px">Dividende</div>
          <div style="font-size:var(--text-base);font-weight:700;color:${txtMain}">${d.div}</div>
        </div>
        <div style="background:${bgAlt};border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:var(--space-3)">
          <div style="color:${txtMuted};margin-bottom:2px">Beta</div>
          <div style="font-size:var(--text-base);font-weight:700;color:${txtMain}">${d.beta}</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-bottom:var(--space-4)">
        <thead>
          <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border)">
            <th style="text-align:left;padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMuted};font-weight:500">Métrique</th>
            <th style="text-align:right;padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMuted};font-weight:500">Valeur</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr><td style="padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMain}">Capitalisation</td><td style="text-align:right;padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMain};font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums">${d.cap}</td></tr>
          <tr style="background:${bgAlt}"><td style="padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMain}">Chiffre d'affaires (TTM)</td><td style="text-align:right;padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMain};font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums">${d.rev}</td></tr>
          <tr><td style="padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMain}">Résultat net (TTM)</td><td style="text-align:right;padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMain};font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums">${d.net}</td></tr>
          <tr style="background:${bgAlt}"><td style="padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMain}">Marge nette</td><td style="text-align:right;padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMain};font-weight:600">${d.margin}</td></tr>
          <tr><td style="padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMain}">Dette totale</td><td style="text-align:right;padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMain};font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums">${d.debt}</td></tr>
          <tr style="background:${bgAlt}"><td style="padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMain}">Trésorerie</td><td style="text-align:right;padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMain};font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums">${d.cash}</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>

      <div style="font-size:var(--text-sm);font-weight:600;color:${txtMain};margin-bottom:var(--space-2)">Résultats trimestriels</div>
      <table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse">
        <thead>
          <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border)">
            <th style="text-align:left;padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMuted};font-weight:500">Trimestre</th>
            <th style="text-align:right;padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMuted};font-weight:500">CA</th>
            <th style="text-align:right;padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMuted};font-weight:500">BPA</th>
            <th style="text-align:right;padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMuted};font-weight:500">Surprise</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          ${d.quarterly.map((q, i) => {
            const surpriseColor = q.surp.startsWith('+') ? '#22c55e' : q.surp.startsWith('-') ? '#ef4444' : txtMuted;
            return `<tr ${i%2?`style="background:${bgAlt}"`:''}>` +
              `<td style="padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMain}">${q.q}</td>` +
              `<td style="text-align:right;padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMain};font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums">${q.rev}</td>` +
              `<td style="text-align:right;padding:var(--space-2);color:${txtMain};font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums">$${q.eps}</td>` +
              `<td style="text-align:right;padding:var(--space-2);color:${surpriseColor};font-weight:600">${q.surp}</td></tr>`;
          }).join('')}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <div style="text-align:center;margin-top:var(--space-3);color:${txtMuted};font-size:10px">Données simulées — à titre indicatif</div>
    </div>
  `;
}

/** Render custom chart section with canvas for a ticker */
function _renderCustomChart(containerId, ticker) {
  const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
  if (!container) return;
  const d = _getTickerFinancials(ticker);
  const canvasId = containerId + '-canvas';
  const isDark = (document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') || 'dark') !== 'light';
  const txtMuted = 'var(--color-text-muted)';
  const txtMain = 'var(--color-text)';
  const bgSurface = 'var(--color-surface-offset,rgba(0,0,0,0.02))';

  const pts = d.chart || [];
  const last = pts[pts.length-1] || d.price;
  const first = pts[0] || d.price;
  const chg = first ? (((last - first)/first)*100).toFixed(2) : '0.00';
  const chgColor = chg >= 0 ? '#22c55e' : '#ef4444';
  const chgSign = chg >= 0 ? '+' : '';

  container.innerHTML = `
    <div style="padding:var(--space-4);height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column">
      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:var(--space-3)">
        <div>
          <span style="font-size:var(--text-lg);font-weight:700;color:${txtMain}">$${last.toFixed(2)}</span>
          <span style="font-size:var(--text-sm);color:${chgColor};margin-left:var(--space-2);font-weight:600">${chgSign}${chg}%</span>
        </div>
        <span style="font-size:10px;color:${txtMuted}">30 derniers jours (simulé)</span>
      </div>
      <div style="flex:1;min-height:0;background:${bgSurface};border-radius:var(--radius-sm);position:relative">
        <canvas id="${canvasId}" style="width:100%;height:100%;display:block"></canvas>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align:center;margin-top:var(--space-2);color:${txtMuted};font-size:10px">Données simulées — <a href="https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/${ticker}/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color:var(--color-accent,#3b82f6);text-decoration:none">Voir sur TradingView</a></div>
    </div>
  `;

  // Defer canvas rendering — use double rAF to ensure accordion transition
  // has started and the container has non-zero dimensions
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const cvs = document.getElementById(canvasId);
      if (cvs && (cvs.clientWidth === 0 || cvs.clientHeight === 0)) {
        // Accordion not yet expanded — retry after transition completes
        setTimeout(() => _renderMiniChart(canvasId, pts, ticker), 350);
      } else {
        _renderMiniChart(canvasId, pts, ticker);
      }
    });
  });
}

/** Render custom company profile for a ticker */
function _renderCustomProfile(containerId, ticker) {
  const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
  if (!container) return;
  const d = _getTickerFinancials(ticker);
  const isDark = (document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') || 'dark') !== 'light';
  const txtMuted = 'var(--color-text-muted)';
  const txtMain = 'var(--color-text)';
  const bgAlt = 'var(--color-surface-offset,rgba(0,0,0,0.03))';
  const accent = '#3b82f6';
  const borderColor = 'var(--color-border)';

  const infoRows = [
    { label: 'Secteur', value: d.sector || '—' },
    { label: 'Industrie', value: d.industry || '—' },
    { label: 'PDG', value: d.ceo || '—' },
    { label: 'Employés', value: d.employees || '—' },
    { label: 'Siège social', value: d.hq || '—' },
    { label: 'Pays', value: d.country || '—' },
    { label: 'Fondation', value: d.founded || '—' },
  ];

  container.innerHTML = `
    <div style="padding:var(--space-4);overflow-y:auto;height:100%;font-size:var(--text-xs)">
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--space-3);margin-bottom:var(--space-4)">
        <div style="width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);background:${accent};display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:var(--text-base)">${ticker.charAt(0)}</div>
        <div>
          <div style="font-size:var(--text-base);font-weight:700;color:${txtMain}">${d.name || ticker}</div>
          <div style="color:${txtMuted};font-size:var(--text-xs)">${ticker} · ${d.sector || 'N/A'}</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1px;background:${borderColor};border:1px solid ${borderColor};border-radius:var(--radius-sm);overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:var(--space-4)">
        ${infoRows.map((r, i) => `
          <div style="padding:var(--space-2) var(--space-3);background:${i % 2 === 0 ? 'var(--color-surface-alt,#1e222d)' : bgAlt}">
            <div style="color:${txtMuted};font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px;margin-bottom:1px">${r.label}</div>
            <div style="color:${txtMain};font-weight:600;font-size:var(--text-xs)">${r.value}</div>
          </div>
        `).join('')}
      </div>

      ${d.description ? `
        <div style="font-size:var(--text-sm);font-weight:600;color:${txtMain};margin-bottom:var(--space-2)">Description</div>
        <p style="color:${txtMuted};font-size:var(--text-xs);line-height:1.6;margin:0">${d.description}</p>
      ` : ''}
    </div>
  `;
}

/** Load a section on demand when the user clicks an expand button */
function _tvLoadSection(btn, containerId, widgetType, tvSymbol) {
  const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
  if (!container) return;
  const isOpen = container.style.height !== '0px' && container.style.height !== '0';

  if (isOpen) {
    // Collapse
    container.style.height = '0';
    container.style.borderWidth = '0';
    btn.style.borderRadius = 'var(--radius-md)';
    btn.querySelector('.tv-chevron').style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)';
    return;
  }

  // Expand
  const heights = { 'advanced-chart': '380px', 'financials': '500px', 'symbol-profile': '400px' };
  container.style.height = heights[widgetType] || '350px';
  container.style.borderWidth = '0 1px 1px 1px';
  btn.style.borderRadius = 'var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0 0';
  btn.querySelector('.tv-chevron').style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';

  // Load content only on first expand
  if (container.dataset.loaded) return;
  container.dataset.loaded = '1';

  // Extract raw ticker from tvSymbol (e.g. "NASDAQ:AAPL" → "AAPL")
  const rawTicker = tvSymbol.includes(':') ? tvSymbol.split(':')[1] : tvSymbol;

  // For chart and financials, use custom built-in display (TV iframe doesn't render in sandboxed context)
  if (widgetType === 'advanced-chart') {
    _renderCustomChart(containerId, rawTicker);
    return;
  }
  if (widgetType === 'financials') {
    _renderCustomFinancials(containerId, rawTicker);
    return;
  }
  if (widgetType === 'symbol-profile') {
    _renderCustomProfile(containerId, rawTicker);
    return;
  }
}

/**
 * Inject a TradingView widget using direct iframe embed URLs.
 * This approach works reliably across all hosting environments including
 * sandboxed iframes and proxy contexts.
 */
function _injectTVWidget(containerId, widgetType, config) {
  const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
  if (!container) return;

  // Detect current app theme and adapt TradingView colorTheme accordingly
  const appTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') || 'dark';
  config.colorTheme = appTheme === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark';

  // Build the embed URL with config as a URI-encoded JSON hash
  const configStr = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(config));
  const cacheBust = Date.now();
  const embedUrl = `https://s.tradingview.com/embed-widget/${widgetType}/?locale=${config.locale || 'fr'}&_cb=${cacheBust}#${configStr}`;

  const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
  iframe.src = embedUrl;
  iframe.style.width = '100%';
  iframe.style.height = '100%';
  iframe.style.border = 'none';
  iframe.style.display = 'block';
  iframe.setAttribute('allowtransparency', 'true');
  iframe.setAttribute('frameborder', '0');
  iframe.setAttribute('scrolling', 'no');
  iframe.allow = 'clipboard-write';
  // Do NOT add sandbox attribute — TradingView needs full access to render

  container.innerHTML = '';
  container.appendChild(iframe);
}

   ORDERS TAB
   ===================================================== */

async function loadOrders() {
  try {
    const data = await apiFetch('/api/orders');
    state.orders = data.orders ?? data ?? [];
    renderOrders(state.orders);
    // Load pending validation panel
    await loadPendingValidation();
  } catch (err) {
    document.getElementById('ordersBody').innerHTML = `
      <tr><td colspan="8" class="inline-error">Failed to load orders: ${esc(err.message)}</td></tr>
    `;
  }
}

async function loadPendingValidation() {
  const panel = document.getElementById('pendingValidationPanel');
  if (!panel) return;
  try {
    const data = await apiFetch('/api/orders/pending-validation');
    const pendingOrders = data.orders ?? [];
    updateOrdersBadge(pendingOrders.length);
    renderPendingValidationPanel(pendingOrders);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[loadPendingValidation] Error:', err.message);
    // Fallback: try to extract pending orders from already-loaded orders list
    if (state.orders && state.orders.length) {
      const pending = state.orders.filter(o => o.status === 'pending_validation');
      if (pending.length > 0) {
        updateOrdersBadge(pending.length);
        renderPendingValidationPanel(pending);
        return;
      }
    }
    panel.innerHTML = '';
    updateOrdersBadge(0);
  }
}

function updateOrdersBadge(count) {
  const badge = document.getElementById('ordersBadge');
  if (!badge) return;
  if (count > 0) {
    badge.textContent = count;
    badge.style.display = 'inline-block';
  } else {
    badge.style.display = 'none';
  }
}

function renderPendingValidationPanel(orders) {
  // [FIX_OPTION_2_UNIFIED_QUEUE_V1] : disabled, replaced by Pending Approvals card
  const panel = document.getElementById('pendingValidationPanel');
  if (!panel) return;
  panel.innerHTML = '';
  return;

  // Legacy code below (dead, kept for reference)
  if (!orders.length) {
    panel.innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }

  const rows = orders.map(o => {
    const riskResult = o.risk_check_result;
    const riskOk = riskResult && typeof riskResult === 'object' ? riskResult.approved : null;
    const riskBadge = riskOk === true
      ? '<span class="badge badge-green">PASS</span>'
      : riskOk === false
        ? '<span class="badge badge-red">FAIL</span>'
        : '<span class="badge badge-gray">—</span>';
    const side = (o.side ?? '').toUpperCase();
    return `
      <tr id="pv-row-${o.id}">
        <td><a href="#" class="ticker-link" onclick="openTickerDetail('${esc(o.ticker ?? '')}');return false" style="color:var(--color-accent,#3b82f6);text-decoration:none;font-weight:700">${esc(o.ticker ?? '')}</a></td>
        <td>${side === 'BUY' ? '<span class="badge badge-green">BUY</span>' : '<span class="badge badge-red">SELL</span>'}</td>
        <td class="num mono">${fmtQty(o.quantity)}</td>
        <td class="text-muted">${esc(o.order_type ?? 'market')}</td>
        <td>${riskBadge}</td>
        <td class="text-muted" style="font-size:var(--text-xs)">${o.thesis_id ? '#' + o.thesis_id : '—'}</td>
        <td class="mono text-muted" style="font-size:var(--text-xs)">${fmtDate(o.created_at)}</td>
        <td style="white-space:nowrap">
          <button class="btn-pass" onclick="approveOrder(${o.id})">✓ PASS</button>
          <button class="btn-reject" onclick="showRejectForm(${o.id})">✗ REJETER</button>
        </td>
      </tr>
      <tr id="pv-reject-form-${o.id}" style="display:none">
        <td colspan="8">
          <div class="reject-form">
            <textarea id="pv-reason-${o.id}" placeholder="Motif de rejet obligatoire…"></textarea>
            <div class="reject-actions">
              <button class="btn btn-ghost" style="font-size:12px" onclick="hideRejectForm(${o.id})">Annuler</button>
              <button class="btn-reject" onclick="confirmRejectOrder(${o.id})">Confirmer le rejet</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </td>
      </tr>
    `;
  }).join('');

  panel.innerHTML = `
    <div class="pending-validation-panel">
      <div class="panel-header">
        <span class="panel-title">
          ⏳ Ordres en attente de validation
          <span class="pending-count-badge">${orders.length}</span>
        </span>
        <div class="bulk-actions">
          <button class="btn-approve-all" onclick="approveAllOrders()">✓ Tout valider</button>
          <button class="btn-reject-all" onclick="showBulkRejectForm()">✗ Tout rejeter</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div id="pvBulkRejectForm" style="display:none;margin-bottom:var(--space-3)">
        <div class="reject-form">
          <textarea id="pvBulkReason" placeholder="Motif de rejet groupé obligatoire…"></textarea>
          <div class="reject-actions">
            <button class="btn btn-ghost" style="font-size:12px" onclick="hideBulkRejectForm()">Annuler</button>
            <button class="btn-reject" onclick="confirmRejectAll()">Confirmer le rejet groupé</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="table-section">
        <div class="table-scroll">
          <table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Ticker</th>
                <th>Sens</th>
                <th class="num">Qté</th>
                <th>Type</th>
                <th>Risk Check</th>
                <th>Source (thèse)</th>
                <th>Créé</th>
                <th>Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
}

function showRejectForm(orderId) {
  document.getElementById(`pv-reject-form-${orderId}`).style.display = '';
}

function hideRejectForm(orderId) {
  document.getElementById(`pv-reject-form-${orderId}`).style.display = 'none';
}

function showBulkRejectForm() {
  const f = document.getElementById('pvBulkRejectForm');
  if (f) f.style.display = '';
}

function hideBulkRejectForm() {
  const f = document.getElementById('pvBulkRejectForm');
  if (f) f.style.display = 'none';
}

function showInlineRejectForm(orderId) {
  const el = document.getElementById(`inline-reject-${orderId}`);
  if (el) el.style.display = '';
}

async function confirmInlineReject(orderId) {
  const reasonEl = document.getElementById(`inline-reason-${orderId}`);
  const reason = reasonEl ? reasonEl.value.trim() : '';
  if (!reason) {
    showToast('Le motif de rejet est obligatoire', 'error');
    return;
  }
  try {
    await apiPost(`/api/orders/${orderId}/reject`, { reason });
    showToast('Ordre rejeté', 'info');
    await loadOrders();
  } catch (err) {
    showToast('Erreur rejet : ' + err.message, 'error');
  }
}

async function approveOrder(orderId) {
  try {
    await apiPost(`/api/orders/${orderId}/approve`, {});
    showToast('Ordre validé et exécuté', 'success');
    await Promise.all([loadOrders(), loadFills()]);
  } catch (err) {
    showToast('Erreur validation : ' + err.message, 'error');
  }
}

async function confirmRejectOrder(orderId) {
  const reasonEl = document.getElementById(`pv-reason-${orderId}`);

async function confirmRejectAll() {

function renderOrders(orders) {
  const tbody = document.getElementById('ordersBody');
  if (!orders.length) {
    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" class="empty-state">No open orders</td></tr>';
    return;
  }

  tbody.innerHTML = orders.map(o => {
    const side = (o.side ?? '').toUpperCase();
    const riskResult = o.risk_check_result ?? o.risk_check ?? o.risk_status ?? '';
    const riskClass = riskResult === 'PASS' || riskResult === 'pass' ? 'badge-green'
      : riskResult === 'FAIL' || riskResult === 'fail' ? 'badge-red' : 'badge-gray';
    const status = o.status ?? '';

    // Status badge with special handling for pending_validation, rejected with reason
    let statusDisplay;
    if (status === 'pending_validation') {
      statusDisplay = `<span class="badge" style="background:#f0a030;color:#fff">EN ATTENTE</span>
        <div style="margin-top:4px;display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap">
          <button class="btn-pass" style="font-size:11px;padding:2px 8px" onclick="approveOrder(${o.id})">✓ PASS</button>
          <button class="btn-reject" style="font-size:11px;padding:2px 8px" onclick="showInlineRejectForm(${o.id})">✗ REJETER</button>
        </div>
        <div id="inline-reject-${o.id}" style="display:none;margin-top:4px">
          <textarea id="inline-reason-${o.id}" placeholder="Motif…" style="width:100%;font-size:11px;padding:4px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid var(--color-border);background:var(--color-surface-2);color:var(--color-text);min-height:30px"></textarea>
          <div style="display:flex;gap:4px;margin-top:2px">
            <button class="btn-reject" style="font-size:10px;padding:2px 6px" onclick="confirmInlineReject(${o.id})">Confirmer</button>
            <button class="btn btn-ghost" style="font-size:10px;padding:2px 6px" onclick="document.getElementById('inline-reject-${o.id}').style.display='none'">Annuler</button>
          </div>
        </div>`;
    } else {
      statusDisplay = `<span class="status-dot ${status.toLowerCase()}"></span>${esc(status)}`;
    }

    // Rejection reason tooltip
    let rejectionNote = '';
    if (status === 'rejected' && o.rejection_reason) {
      rejectionNote = `<br><span class="text-muted" style="font-size:10px" title="${esc(o.rejection_reason)}">&#128683; ${esc(o.rejection_reason.length > 30 ? o.rejection_reason.slice(0, 30) + '…' : o.rejection_reason)}</span>`;
    }

    // Validated by info
    let validatedNote = '';
    if ((status === 'approved' || status === 'filled') && o.validated_by) {
      validatedNote = `<br><span class="text-muted" style="font-size:10px">&#10003; ${esc(o.validated_by)}</span>`;
    }

    return `
      <tr>
        <td><strong>${esc(o.ticker ?? o.instrument ?? o.symbol ?? '')}</strong></td>
        <td>
          ${side === 'BUY'
            ? '<span class="badge badge-green">BUY</span>'
            : '<span class="badge badge-red">SELL</span>'}
        </td>
        <td class="num mono">${fmtQty(o.quantity ?? o.qty)}</td>
        <td class="text-muted">${esc(o.order_type ?? o.type ?? '')}</td>
        <td class="num mono">${o.limit_price != null ? fmtUSD(o.limit_price) : '—'}</td>
        <td>${statusDisplay}${rejectionNote}${validatedNote}</td>
        <td>${typeof riskResult === 'object' && riskResult !== null ? `<span class="badge ${riskResult.approved ? 'badge-green' : 'badge-red'}">${riskResult.approved ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}</span>` : riskResult ? `<span class="badge ${riskClass}">${esc(String(riskResult))}</span>` : '—'}</td>
        <td class="mono text-muted" style="font-size:var(--text-xs)">${fmtDate(o.created_at)}</td>
      </tr>
    `;
  }).join('');
}

   IC MEMOS TAB

async function loadMemos() {
  try {
    const data = await apiFetch('/api/memos');
    state.memos = data.memos ?? data ?? [];
    renderMemoList(state.memos);
  } catch (err) {
    document.getElementById('memoList').innerHTML = `<div class="inline-error">Failed to load memos: ${esc(err.message)}</div>`;
  }
}

function renderMemoList(memos) {
  const dateFrom = document.getElementById('memoDateFrom').value;
  const dateTo = document.getElementById('memoDateTo').value;
  const agentFilter = document.getElementById('memoAgentFilter').value;

  let filtered = memos;
  if (dateFrom) filtered = filtered.filter(m => {
    const d = new Date(m.created_at ?? m.date ?? '');
    return !isNaN(d) && d >= new Date(dateFrom);
  });
  if (dateTo) filtered = filtered.filter(m => {
    const d = new Date(m.created_at ?? m.date ?? '');
    return !isNaN(d) && d <= new Date(dateTo + 'T23:59:59');
  });
  if (agentFilter) filtered = filtered.filter(m => (m.agent ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(agentFilter));

  const list = document.getElementById('memoList');
  if (!filtered.length) {
    list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">No memos match the filter</div>';
    return;
  }

  list.innerHTML = filtered.map(m => {
    const isActive = state.selectedMemoId === (m.id ?? m._id);
    return `
      <div class="memo-list-item ${isActive ? 'active' : ''}" data-memo-id="${esc(m.id ?? m._id ?? '')}" role="button" tabindex="0">
        <div class="memo-date">${fmtDate(m.created_at ?? m.date)}</div>
        <div class="memo-title">${esc(m.title ?? m.subject ?? 'Untitled')}</div>
        ${m.agent ? `<div class="memo-agent">${esc(m.agent)}</div>` : ''}
      </div>
    `;
  }).join('');

  list.querySelectorAll('.memo-list-item').forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener('click', () => selectMemo(item.dataset.memoId));
    item.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        selectMemo(item.dataset.memoId);
      }
    });
  });

  // Auto-select first memo
  if (filtered.length && !state.selectedMemoId) {
    selectMemo(filtered[0].id ?? filtered[0]._id);
  }
}

async function selectMemo(id) {
  state.selectedMemoId = id;

  // Update active state in list
  document.querySelectorAll('.memo-list-item').forEach(item => {
    item.classList.toggle('active', item.dataset.memoId === String(id));
  });

  // Show loading state in reader
  const header = document.getElementById('memoReaderHeader');
  const content = document.getElementById('memoContent');
  header.innerHTML = '<div class="skeleton skeleton-text w-3-4"></div>';
  content.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">Loading…</div>';

  try {
    // Always fetch full detail (list endpoint doesn't include full_markdown)
    let memo;
    try {
      memo = await apiFetch(`/api/memos/${id}`);
    } catch (_fetchErr) {
      // Fallback to in-memory state (covers freshly generated memos not yet in DB)
      memo = (state.memos || []).find(m => String(m.id ?? m._id) === String(id));
    }
    if (!memo) throw new Error('Memo introuvable');
    renderMemoReader(memo);
  } catch (err) {
    content.innerHTML = `<div class="inline-error">Failed to load memo: ${esc(err.message)}</div>`;
  }
}

async function viewMemoById(id) {
  navigateToTab('memos');
  // Wait for tab render
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100));
  selectMemo(id);
}

function renderMemoReader(memo) {
  const header = document.getElementById('memoReaderHeader');
  const content = document.getElementById('memoContent');

  header.innerHTML = `
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:var(--space-3)">
      <div>
        <div style="font-size:var(--text-base);font-weight:600;color:var(--color-text);margin-bottom:var(--space-1)">${esc(memo.title ?? memo.subject ?? 'Untitled')}</div>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:var(--space-3);align-items:center">
          <span class="mono text-muted" style="font-size:var(--text-xs)">${fmtDate(memo.created_at ?? memo.date)}</span>
          ${memo.agent ? agentBadge(memo.agent) : ''}
        </div>
      </div>
      <button class="btn btn-export-pdf" onclick="exportMemoPDF('${esc(memo.id ?? memo._id)}')" title="Exporter en PDF">
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
          <path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/>
          <polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/>
          <line x1="12" y1="18" x2="12" y2="12"/>
          <polyline points="9 15 12 18 15 15"/>
        </svg>
        Export PDF
      </button>
    </div>
  `;

  const rawContent = memo.full_markdown ?? memo.content ?? memo.body ?? memo.text ?? '';
  content.innerHTML = renderMarkdown(rawContent);
}

function openNewMemoModal() {

function onMemoTypeChange() {
  const t = document.getElementById('memoType').value;

function _genWeeklyMemo(conviction) {

'+' : ''}$${Math.abs(totalPnl).toLocaleString('en-US', {maximumFractionDigits:0})}** (${totalPnlPct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${totalPnlPct.toFixed(2)}%) |\n| PnL jour | ${dailyPnl >= 0 ?
