async function generateNewMemo() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('btnGenerateMemo');
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerHTML = '<svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" class="spin"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-6.219-8.56"/></svg> G\u00e9n\u00e9ration\u2026';

  try {
    const memoType = document.getElementById('memoType').value;
    const conviction = document.getElementById('memoConviction').value;
    const customTitle = document.getElementById('memoTitleInput').value.trim();
    const ticker = document.getElementById('memoTicker').value;
    const customTopic = document.getElementById('memoCustomTopic').value.trim();

    let generated;
    switch (memoType) {
      case 'weekly':   generated = _genWeeklyMemo(conviction); break;
      case 'position': generated = _genPositionMemo(ticker || 'AAPL', conviction); break;
      case 'macro':    generated = _genMacroMemo(conviction); break;
      case 'strategy': generated = _genStrategyMemo(conviction); break;
      case 'crypto':   generated = _genCryptoMemo(conviction); break;
      case 'custom':   generated = _genCustomMemo(customTopic || 'Analyse ad-hoc', conviction); break;
      default:         generated = _genWeeklyMemo(conviction);
    }

    if (customTitle) generated.title = `IC Memo \u2014 ${customTitle}`;

    const newMemo = {
      id: ++_memoIdCounter,
      title: generated.title,
      author: 'R. Gu\u00e9lin',
      date: _todayStr(),
      status: 'draft',
      summary: generated.summary,
      tags: generated.tags,
      body: generated.body
    };

    // Simulate async generation delay
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600));

    // Add to state and re-render
    state.memos.unshift(newMemo);
    state.selectedMemoId = null; // reset selection
    renderMemoList(state.memos);
    selectMemo(newMemo.id);

    closeNewMemoModal();
    showToast('IC Memo g\u00e9n\u00e9r\u00e9 : ' + generated.title, 'success');
  } catch (err) {
    showToast('Erreur g\u00e9n\u00e9ration memo : ' + err.message, 'error');
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.innerHTML = '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polygon points="13 2 3 14 12 14 11 22 21 10 12 10 13 2"/></svg> G\u00e9n\u00e9rer';
  }
}

// [ICMEMO_JS_REDIRECT_V1] - Redirection vers route serveur (patches v2/v3/v4)
async function exportMemoPDF(memoId) {
  const btn = document.querySelector('.btn-export-pdf');
  const origHTML = btn ? btn.innerHTML : null;
  if (btn) {
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.innerHTML = '<svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" class="spin"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-6.219-8.56"/></svg> Export...';
  }
  try {
    // Recupere le token JWT (cf. apiFetch)
    const token = (typeof getToken === 'function') ? getToken() : (localStorage.getItem('token') || '');
    const resp = await fetch('/api/memos/' + encodeURIComponent(memoId) + '/pdf', {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: token ? { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token } : {}
    });
    if (!resp.ok) {
      throw new Error('HTTP ' + resp.status + ' ' + resp.statusText);
    }
    const blob = await resp.blob();
    const cd = resp.headers.get('Content-Disposition') || '';
    let filename = 'IC-Memo-' + memoId + '.pdf';
    const m = /filename="?([^";]+)"?/i.exec(cd);
    if (m) filename = m[1];
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = filename;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    setTimeout(function() { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 1000);
    if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Export PDF OK : ' + filename, 'success');
  } catch (err) {
    if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Export PDF echoue: ' + err.message, 'error');
    else alert('Export PDF echoue: ' + err.message);
  } finally {
    if (btn) {
      btn.disabled = false;
      if (origHTML !== null) btn.innerHTML = origHTML;
    }
  }
}

/* =====================================================
   RUN DECISION CYCLE
   ===================================================== */

let _lastCycleDate = null;

async function runDecisionCycle() {
  // Daily guard: only allow one run per calendar day
  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  if (_lastCycleDate === todayStr) {
    showToast('Cycle déjà exécuté aujourd\'hui — 1 exécution par jour max.', 'warning');
    return;
  }
  const btn = document.getElementById('runCycleBtn');
  btn.disabled = true;
  const original = btn.innerHTML;
  btn.innerHTML = `
    <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" class="spin">
      <path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-6.219-8.56"/>
    </svg>
    Running…
  `;

  try {
    const result = await apiPost('/api/orders/execute-cycle');
    const cycleResult = result.cycle_result ?? {};
    const pending = cycleResult.orders_pending ?? 0;
    if (pending > 0) {
      showToast(`Cycle terminé — ${pending} ordre(s) en attente de validation`, 'info');
    } else {
      showToast(result.message ?? 'Cycle de décision terminé', 'success');
    }
    // Refresh all data after cycle
    await loadTabData(state.activeTab);
    // Also refresh today if not currently on it
    if (state.activeTab !== 'today') {
      await loadDashboard();
    }
    // Update the badge even if not on orders tab
    await loadPendingValidation();
    // Mark this day as done
    _lastCycleDate = todayStr;
  } catch (err) {
    showToast('Cycle failed: ' + err.message, 'error');
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.innerHTML = original;
  }
}

}

/** Return an analyst recommendation badge based on the 1-5 Finviz scale. */
function analystBadge(recom) {
  if (recom == null) return '<span class="badge badge-gray">—</span>';
  const r = parseFloat(recom);
  if (isNaN(r)) return '<span class="badge badge-gray">—</span>';
  if (r <= 1.5) return `<span class="badge badge-green" title="${r.toFixed(2)}">Strong Buy</span>`;
  if (r <= 2.5) return `<span class="badge badge-green" title="${r.toFixed(2)}" style="opacity:0.8">Buy</span>`;
  if (r <= 3.5) return `<span class="badge badge-gold" title="${r.toFixed(2)}">Hold</span>`;
  return `<span class="badge badge-red" title="${r.toFixed(2)}">Sell</span>`;
}

/** Format a Finviz percentage value with color span. */
function fmtPctColored(val) {
  if (val == null || isNaN(val)) return '<span class="text-muted">—</span>';
  const color = val > 0 ? '#2ecc71' : val < 0 ? '#e74c3c' : 'inherit';
  const sign = val > 0 ? '+' : '';
  return `<span style="color:${color}">${sign}${Number(val).toFixed(2)}%</span>`;
}

function renderStockSignals(signals) {
  const tbody = document.getElementById('signalsBody');
  if (!signals.length) {
    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="14" class="empty-state">Aucune donnée disponible</td></tr>';
    return;
  }

  tbody.innerHTML = signals.map(s => {
    // RSI coloring
    const rsi = s.rsi != null ? parseFloat(s.rsi) : null;
    let rsiColor = 'inherit';
    if (rsi != null) {
      if (rsi > 70) rsiColor = '#e74c3c';
      else if (rsi < 30) rsiColor = '#2ecc71';
    }
    const rsiCell = rsi != null
      ? `<span style="color:${rsiColor}">${rsi.toFixed(1)}</span>`
      : '<span class="text-muted">—</span>';

    // Target vs price coloring
    let targetCell = '<span class="text-muted">—</span>';
    if (s.target != null) {
      const tColor = (s.price != null && s.target > s.price) ? '#2ecc71'
                   : (s.price != null && s.target < s.price) ? '#e74c3c'
                   : 'inherit';
      targetCell = `<span style="color:${tColor}">${fmtUSD(s.target)}</span>`;
    }

    return `
      <tr>
        <td><a href="#" class="ticker-link" data-ticker="${esc(s.ticker)}" onclick="openTickerDetail('${esc(s.ticker)}');return false"><strong>${esc(s.ticker)}</strong></a></td>
        <td class="mono">${s.price != null ? fmtUSD(s.price) : '—'}</td>
        <td>${fmtPctColored(s.change)}</td>
        <td class="mono">${rsiCell}</td>
        <td>${fmtPctColored(s.sma20)}</td>
        <td>${fmtPctColored(s.sma50)}</td>
        <td>${fmtPctColored(s.sma200)}</td>
        <td>${analystBadge(s.recom)}</td>
        <td class="mono">${targetCell}</td>
        <td class="mono">${s.short_float != null ? fmtPct(s.short_float, 1) : '—'}</td>
        <td class="mono">${s.rel_volume != null ? Number(s.rel_volume).toFixed(2) + 'x' : '—'}</td>
        <td>${fmtPctColored(s.perf_week)}</td>
        <td>${fmtPctColored(s.perf_month)}</td>
        <td>${fmtPctColored(s.perf_ytd)}</td>
      </tr>
    `;
  }).join('');
}

/** Format a large crypto market cap with T/B/M suffix. */
function fmtCryptoMarketCap(n) {
  if (n == null || isNaN(n)) return '<span class="text-muted">—</span>';
  const abs = Math.abs(n);
  if (abs >= 1e12) return '$' + (abs / 1e12).toFixed(2) + 'T';
  if (abs >= 1e9)  return '$' + (abs / 1e9).toFixed(2) + 'B';
  if (abs >= 1e6)  return '$' + (abs / 1e6).toFixed(2) + 'M';
  return '$' + abs.toFixed(0);
}

function renderCryptoOverview(data) {
  const tbody = document.getElementById('cryptoBody');
  if (!data.length) {
    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="14" class="empty-state">Aucune donnée disponible</td></tr>';
    return;
  }

  tbody.innerHTML = data.map(c => {
    // Ticker label with ETF proxy
    const tickerLabel = c.etf_proxy
      ? `<strong>${esc(c.ticker)}</strong> <span class="text-muted" style="font-size:var(--text-xs)">(${esc(c.etf_proxy)})</span>`
      : `<strong>${esc(c.ticker)}</strong>`;

    // Price
    const priceCell = c.price != null
      ? `<span class="mono">${fmtUSD(c.price)}</span>`
      : '<span class="text-muted">—</span>';

    // 24h change
    const chg24h = c.change_24h != null ? parseFloat(c.change_24h) : null;
    const chg24hCell = chg24h != null
      ? fmtPctColored(chg24h)
      : '<span class="text-muted">—</span>';

    // Market cap
    const mcapCell = fmtCryptoMarketCap(c.market_cap);

    // Volume 24h
    const volCell = c.volume_24h != null
      ? fmtCryptoMarketCap(c.volume_24h)
      : '<span class="text-muted">—</span>';

    // RSI coloring: red >70, green <30
    const rsi = c.rsi != null ? parseFloat(c.rsi) : null;
    let rsiColor = 'inherit';
    if (rsi != null) {
      if (rsi > 70) rsiColor = '#e74c3c';
      else if (rsi < 30) rsiColor = '#2ecc71';
    }
    const rsiCell = rsi != null
      ? `<span class="mono" style="color:${rsiColor}">${rsi.toFixed(1)}</span>`
      : '<span class="text-muted">—</span>';

    // Volatility — pass through as string
    const volW = c.volatility_w != null ? `<span class="mono text-muted">${esc(String(c.volatility_w))}</span>` : '<span class="text-muted">—</span>';
    const volM = c.volatility_m != null ? `<span class="mono text-muted">${esc(String(c.volatility_m))}</span>` : '<span class="text-muted">—</span>';

    return `
      <tr>
        <td>${tickerLabel}</td>
        <td>${priceCell}</td>
        <td>${chg24hCell}</td>
        <td class="mono">${mcapCell}</td>
        <td class="mono">${volCell}</td>
        <td>${rsiCell}</td>
        <td>${fmtPctColored(c.sma20)}</td>
        <td>${fmtPctColored(c.sma50)}</td>
        <td>${fmtPctColored(c.sma200)}</td>
        <td>${fmtPctColored(c.perf_week)}</td>
        <td>${fmtPctColored(c.perf_month)}</td>
        <td>${fmtPctColored(c.perf_ytd)}</td>
        <td>${volW}</td>
        <td>${volM}</td>
      </tr>
    `;
  }).join('');
}

   MACRO US TAB

let macroData = null;
let macroHistChart = null;
let macroCorrChart = null;
let frontRunPriceChart = null;

async function loadMacroData() {
  try {
    macroData = await apiFetch('/api/macro/vulnerability');
    renderMacroHero(macroData);
    renderMacroSubscores(macroData.sub_scores || []);
    renderMacroHistory(macroData.history || []);
    renderMacroAlerts(macroData.alerts || []);
    renderMacroCorrelations(macroData.correlation_summary, macroData.correlation_history || []);
    renderMacroCalendar(macroData.calendar || []);
    renderMacroGauge(macroData.global_score);
    renderRiskRegime(macroData.risk_regime);
    renderCccOas(macroData.risk_regime);
    renderFrontRunChecklist(macroData);
  } catch (err) {
    document.getElementById('macroScoreRegime').textContent = 'Erreur: ' + err.message;
  }
}

function macroScoreColor(score) {
  if (score < 2) return '#70AD47';
  if (score < 4) return '#9DC3E6';
  if (score < 6) return '#FFD966';
  if (score < 8) return '#F4B942';
  return '#C00000';
}

function renderMacroGauge(score) {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('macroGauge');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const w = canvas.width;
  const h = canvas.height;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

  const cx = w / 2;
  const cy = h - 10;
  const r = 90;

  // Background arc segments
  const segments = [
    { start: Math.PI, end: Math.PI * 1.2, color: '#70AD47' },
    { start: Math.PI * 1.2, end: Math.PI * 1.4, color: '#9DC3E6' },
    { start: Math.PI * 1.4, end: Math.PI * 1.6, color: '#FFD966' },
    { start: Math.PI * 1.6, end: Math.PI * 1.8, color: '#F4B942' },
    { start: Math.PI * 1.8, end: Math.PI * 2, color: '#C00000' },
  ];

  segments.forEach(s => {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, s.start, s.end);
    ctx.lineWidth = 14;
    ctx.strokeStyle = s.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3;
    ctx.stroke();
  });

  // Active arc up to score
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  const scoreAngle = Math.PI + (score / 10) * Math.PI;
  segments.forEach(s => {
    const effectiveEnd = Math.min(s.end, scoreAngle);
    if (effectiveEnd > s.start) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, s.start, effectiveEnd);
      ctx.lineWidth = 14;
      ctx.strokeStyle = s.color;
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  });

  // Needle
  const needleAngle = Math.PI + (score / 10) * Math.PI;
  const needleLen = r - 20;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
  ctx.lineTo(
    cx + Math.cos(needleAngle) * needleLen,
    cy + Math.sin(needleAngle) * needleLen
  );
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
  ctx.strokeStyle = macroScoreColor(score);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Center dot
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = macroScoreColor(score);
  ctx.fill();

  // Labels
  ctx.font = '10px JetBrains Mono, monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--color-text-muted').trim() || '#888';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('0', cx - r - 5, cy + 12);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('10', cx + r + 5, cy + 12);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('5', cx, cy - r + 2);
}

// ---- Risk-On / Risk-Off Gauge ----
function renderRiskRegime(riskRegime) {
  if (!riskRegime) return;

  // Update text elements
  const labelEl = document.getElementById('riskRegimeLabel');
  const spreadEl = document.getElementById('riskRegimeSpread');
  const deltaEl = document.getElementById('riskRegimeDelta');

  if (labelEl) {
    labelEl.textContent = riskRegime.label;
    labelEl.style.color = riskRegime.color;
  }
  if (spreadEl) {
    spreadEl.textContent = `HY Spread: ${riskRegime.hy_spread} bps`;
  }
  if (deltaEl) {
    const d = riskRegime.hy_delta_30d;
    deltaEl.textContent = `30j: ${d >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d} bps`;
    deltaEl.style.color = d > 0 ? '#C00000' : '#70AD47';
  }

  // Draw gauge
  const canvas = document.getElementById('riskRegimeGauge');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const w = canvas.width;
  const h = canvas.height;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

  const cx = w / 2;
  const cy = h - 10;
  const r = 90;

  // Gauge segments: Risk-On (green) -> Neutral (yellow) -> Risk-Off (orange) -> Stress (red)
  // Map HY spread 100-600 to angle range PI -> 2*PI
  const segments = [
    { start: Math.PI,       end: Math.PI * 1.25, color: '#70AD47', label: 'RISK-ON' },   // <300 bps
    { start: Math.PI * 1.25, end: Math.PI * 1.5,  color: '#FFD966', label: 'NEUTRE' },    // 300-400
    { start: Math.PI * 1.5,  end: Math.PI * 1.75, color: '#F4B942', label: 'RISK-OFF' },  // 400-500
    { start: Math.PI * 1.75, end: Math.PI * 2,    color: '#C00000', label: 'STRESS' },    // >500
  ];

  // Background arcs
  segments.forEach(s => {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, s.start, s.end);
    ctx.lineWidth = 14;
    ctx.strokeStyle = s.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3;
    ctx.stroke();
  });

  // Active arc
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  // Map HY spread: 100->PI (full left), 600->2*PI (full right)
  const hy = Math.max(100, Math.min(600, riskRegime.hy_spread));
  const needleAngle = Math.PI + ((hy - 100) / 500) * Math.PI;

  segments.forEach(s => {
    const effectiveEnd = Math.min(s.end, needleAngle);
    if (effectiveEnd > s.start) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, s.start, effectiveEnd);
      ctx.lineWidth = 14;
      ctx.strokeStyle = s.color;
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  });

  // Needle
  const needleLen = r - 20;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
  ctx.lineTo(
    cx + Math.cos(needleAngle) * needleLen,
    cy + Math.sin(needleAngle) * needleLen
  );
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
  ctx.strokeStyle = riskRegime.color;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Center dot
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = riskRegime.color;
  ctx.fill();

  // Labels
  ctx.font = '10px JetBrains Mono, monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--color-text-muted').trim() || '#888';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('100', cx - r - 8, cy + 12);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('600', cx + r + 8, cy + 12);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('350', cx, cy - r + 2);
}

// ---- CCC OAS Stress Indicator ----
function renderCccOas(riskRegime) {
  if (!riskRegime || riskRegime.ccc_oas === undefined) return;

  const labelEl = document.getElementById('cccOasLabel');
  const spreadEl = document.getElementById('cccOasSpread');
  const deltaEl = document.getElementById('cccOasDelta');

  if (labelEl) {
    labelEl.textContent = riskRegime.ccc_label;
    labelEl.style.color = riskRegime.ccc_color;
  }
  if (spreadEl) {
    spreadEl.textContent = `CCC OAS: ${riskRegime.ccc_oas} bps`;
  }
  if (deltaEl) {
    const d = riskRegime.ccc_delta_30d;
    deltaEl.textContent = `30j: ${d >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d} bps`;
    deltaEl.style.color = d > 0 ? '#C00000' : '#70AD47';
  }

  // Draw CCC OAS gauge
  const canvas = document.getElementById('cccOasGauge');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const w = canvas.width;
  const h = canvas.height;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

  const cx = w / 2;
  const cy = h - 10;
  const r = 90;

  // 6 segments mapped over PI arc (PI to 2*PI)
  // Range: 400 bps to 1200 bps (total 800 bps range)
  // Segment boundaries: 400, 700, 868, 944, 1050, 1100, 1200
  const totalRange = 800; // 1200 - 400
  function bpsToAngle(bps) {
    return Math.PI + ((Math.max(400, Math.min(1200, bps)) - 400) / totalRange) * Math.PI;
  }

  const segments = [
    { start: bpsToAngle(400),  end: bpsToAngle(700),  color: '#70AD47' },  // SAIN
    { start: bpsToAngle(700),  end: bpsToAngle(868),  color: '#FFD966' },  // ATTENTION
    { start: bpsToAngle(868),  end: bpsToAngle(944),  color: '#F4B942' },  // STRESS NAISSANT
    { start: bpsToAngle(944),  end: bpsToAngle(1050), color: '#E05D6A' },  // STRESS MODÉRÉ
    { start: bpsToAngle(1050), end: bpsToAngle(1100), color: '#C00000' },  // RISK-OFF TOTAL
    { start: bpsToAngle(1100), end: bpsToAngle(1200), color: '#8B0000' },  // CRISE CCC
  ];

  // Background arcs
  segments.forEach(function(s) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, s.start, s.end);
    ctx.lineWidth = 14;
    ctx.strokeStyle = s.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3;
    ctx.stroke();
  });

  // Active arc up to needle position
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  const ccc = Math.max(400, Math.min(1200, riskRegime.ccc_oas));
  const needleAngle = bpsToAngle(ccc);

  segments.forEach(function(s) {
    const effectiveEnd = Math.min(s.end, needleAngle);
    if (effectiveEnd > s.start) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, s.start, effectiveEnd);
      ctx.lineWidth = 14;
      ctx.strokeStyle = s.color;
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  });

  // Needle
  const needleLen = r - 20;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
  ctx.lineTo(
    cx + Math.cos(needleAngle) * needleLen,
    cy + Math.sin(needleAngle) * needleLen
  );
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
  ctx.strokeStyle = riskRegime.ccc_color;
  ctx.stroke();

  // Center dot
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = riskRegime.ccc_color;
  ctx.fill();

  // Labels
  ctx.font = '10px JetBrains Mono, monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--color-text-muted').trim() || '#888';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('400', cx - r - 8, cy + 12);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('1200', cx + r + 8, cy + 12);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('800', cx, cy - r + 2);
}

// ---- Sentiment Social ----
function sentimentColor(score) {
  if (score >= 75) return '#70AD47';
  if (score >= 55) return '#9DC3E6';
  if (score >= 45) return '#FFD966';
  if (score >= 25) return '#F4B942';
  return '#C00000';
}

function drawSparkline(canvasId, history, colorFn) {
  const canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
  if (!canvas || !history || history.length < 2) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const w = canvas.width, h = canvas.height;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
  const scores = history.map(d => d.score);
  const min = Math.min(...scores) - 5;
  const max = Math.max(...scores) + 5;
  const range = max - min || 1;
  const step = w / (scores.length - 1);

  ctx.beginPath();
  scores.forEach((s, i) => {
    const x = i * step;
    const y = h - ((s - min) / range) * (h - 4) - 2;
    if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  });
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = colorFn(scores[scores.length - 1]);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Dot on latest
  const lastX = (scores.length - 1) * step;
  const lastY = h - ((scores[scores.length - 1] - min) / range) * (h - 4) - 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(lastX, lastY, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = colorFn(scores[scores.length - 1]);
  ctx.fill();
}

function drawSentimentGauge(canvasId, score, color) {
  const canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const w = canvas.width, h = canvas.height;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

  const cx = w / 2, cy = h - 6, r = 70;
  const segments = [
    { start: Math.PI,       end: Math.PI * 1.25, color: '#C00000' },
    { start: Math.PI * 1.25, end: Math.PI * 1.5,  color: '#F4B942' },
    { start: Math.PI * 1.5,  end: Math.PI * 1.75, color: '#9DC3E6' },
    { start: Math.PI * 1.75, end: Math.PI * 2,    color: '#70AD47' },
  ];

  // Background
  segments.forEach(s => {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, s.start, s.end);
    ctx.lineWidth = 12;
    ctx.strokeStyle = s.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25;
    ctx.stroke();
  });

  // Active
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  const needleAngle = Math.PI + (score / 100) * Math.PI;
  segments.forEach(s => {
    const effectiveEnd = Math.min(s.end, needleAngle);
    if (effectiveEnd > s.start) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, s.start, effectiveEnd);
      ctx.lineWidth = 12;
      ctx.strokeStyle = s.color;
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  });

  // Needle
  const nLen = r - 16;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(needleAngle) * nLen, cy + Math.sin(needleAngle) * nLen);
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeStyle = color;
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fill();

  // Labels
  ctx.font = '9px JetBrains Mono, monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--color-text-muted').trim() || '#888';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('Fear', cx - r - 2, cy + 10);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('Greed', cx + r + 2, cy + 10);
}

async function loadSentiment() {
  try {
    const data = await apiFetch('/api/sentiment');
    renderSentiment(data);
  } catch (_e) { /* silent fail */ }
}

function renderSentiment(data) {
  if (!data) return;

  // Crypto
  const c = data.crypto;
  if (c) {
    const el = document.getElementById('sentCryptoScore');
    if (el) { el.textContent = c.score; el.style.color = c.color; }
    const lbl = document.getElementById('sentCryptoLabel');
    if (lbl) { lbl.textContent = c.label; lbl.style.color = c.color; }
    const delta = document.getElementById('sentCryptoDelta');
    if (delta) {
      delta.textContent = `24h: ${c.delta_1d >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${c.delta_1d}`;
      delta.style.color = c.delta_1d >= 0 ? '#70AD47' : '#C00000';
    }
    drawSparkline('sentCryptoSparkline', c.history, sentimentColor);
  }

  // Equities
  const e = data.equities;
  if (e) {
    const el = document.getElementById('sentEquitiesScore');
    if (el) { el.textContent = e.score; el.style.color = e.color; }
    const lbl = document.getElementById('sentEquitiesLabel');
    if (lbl) { lbl.textContent = e.label + ` (VIX ${e.vix})`; lbl.style.color = e.color; }
    const delta = document.getElementById('sentEquitiesDelta');
    if (delta) {
      delta.textContent = `24h: ${e.delta_1d >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${e.delta_1d}`;
      delta.style.color = e.delta_1d >= 0 ? '#70AD47' : '#C00000';
    }
    drawSparkline('sentEquitiesSparkline', e.history, sentimentColor);
  }

  // Combined gauge = average of both
  const cScore = c ? c.score : null;
  const eScore = e ? e.score : null;
  let combined = null;
  if (cScore !== null && eScore !== null) combined = Math.round((cScore + eScore) / 2);
  else if (cScore !== null) combined = cScore;
  else if (eScore !== null) combined = eScore;

  if (combined !== null) {
    const color = sentimentColor(combined);
    drawSentimentGauge('sentCombinedGauge', combined, color);
    const lbl = document.getElementById('sentCombinedLabel');
    if (lbl) {
      let label = 'Neutral';
      if (combined >= 75) label = 'Extreme Greed';
      else if (combined >= 55) label = 'Greed';
      else if (combined >= 45) label = 'Neutral';
      else if (combined >= 25) label = 'Fear';
      else label = 'Extreme Fear';
      lbl.textContent = `${combined} — ${label}`;
      lbl.style.color = color;
    }
  }
}

function renderMacroHero(data) {
  const scoreEl = document.getElementById('macroScoreValue');
  const regimeEl = document.getElementById('macroScoreRegime');
  const deltaEl = document.getElementById('macroScoreDelta');

  const gs = data.global_score;
  const color = macroScoreColor(gs);

  scoreEl.textContent = Math.round(gs);
  scoreEl.style.color = color;
  regimeEl.textContent = data.regime;
  regimeEl.style.color = color;

  const delta = data.global_score_delta;
  if (delta != null) {
    const sign = delta > 0 ? '+' : '';
    deltaEl.textContent = `${sign}${delta.toFixed(1)} vs mois precedent`;
    deltaEl.style.color = delta > 0 ? '#C00000' : delta < 0 ? '#70AD47' : '';
  }
}

function renderMacroSubscores(subScores) {
  const container = document.getElementById('macroSubscores');
  container.innerHTML = subScores.map(s => {
    const score = s.value ?? s.score ?? 0;
    const color = s.color || macroScoreColor(score);
    const weightLabel = s.weight != null ? (typeof s.weight === 'number' ? (s.weight * 100).toFixed(0) + '%' : String(s.weight)) : '';
    const barWidth = Math.min(score * 10, 100); // scale 0-10 → 0-100%

    // Build KPI info from description or kpis array
    let kpisHtml = '';
    if (s.kpis && s.kpis.length) {
      kpisHtml = s.kpis.map(k =>
        `<div class="macro-kpi-row">
          <span class="macro-kpi-label">${esc(k.label)}</span>
          <span class="macro-kpi-value ${k.alert ? 'alert' : ''}">${esc(k.value)}</span>
        </div>`
      ).join('');
    } else if (s.description) {
      kpisHtml = `<div class="macro-kpi-row">
        <span class="macro-kpi-label" style="font-style:italic">${esc(s.description)}</span>
      </div>`;
    }

    // Delta from previous
    let deltaHtml = '';
    if (s.previous != null) {
      const delta = score - s.previous;
      const sign = delta > 0 ? '+' : '';
      const dColor = delta > 0 ? '#e74c3c' : delta < 0 ? '#2ecc71' : 'var(--text-muted)';
      deltaHtml = `<span style="font-size:10px;color:${dColor};margin-left:var(--space-1)">${sign}${delta.toFixed(1)}</span>`;
    }

    return `
      <div class="macro-subscore-card" style="border-top:3px solid ${color}">
        <div class="macro-subscore-header">
          <span class="macro-subscore-name">${esc(s.name)}</span>
          <span class="macro-subscore-badge" style="background:${color}20;color:${color}">${esc(weightLabel)}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-subscore-score" style="color:${color}">${score.toFixed(1)}${deltaHtml}</div>
        <div class="macro-subscore-bar">
          <div class="macro-subscore-bar-fill" style="width:${barWidth}%;background:${color}"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="macro-subscore-kpis">${kpisHtml}</div>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join('');
}

function renderMacroAlerts(alerts) {
  const list = document.getElementById('macroAlertsList');
  if (!alerts.length) {
    list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">Aucune alerte active</div>';
    return;
  }
  list.innerHTML = alerts.map(a => `
    <div class="macro-alert-item ${esc(a.type)}">
      <span class="macro-alert-level" style="color:${a.type === 'danger' ? '#C00000' : a.type === 'warning' ? '#F4B942' : '#70AD47'}">${esc(a.level)}</span>
      <span class="macro-alert-text">${esc(a.text)}</span>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

function renderMacroCorrelations(summary, history) {
  if (!summary) return;

  // Summary badges
  const corrBtcEl = document.getElementById('corrBtcVal');
  const corrNdxEl = document.getElementById('corrNdxVal');
  const sigBtcEl = document.getElementById('corrBtcSignal');
  const sigNdxEl = document.getElementById('corrNdxSignal');

  const corrBtc = summary.corr_btc_24m;
  const corrNdx = summary.corr_ndx_24m;

  if (corrBtc != null) {
    corrBtcEl.textContent = (corrBtc > 0 ? '+' : '') + corrBtc.toFixed(3);
    corrBtcEl.style.color = corrBtc > 0.3 ? '#2ecc71' : corrBtc < -0.3 ? '#e74c3c' : '';
  }
  if (corrNdx != null) {
    corrNdxEl.textContent = (corrNdx > 0 ? '+' : '') + corrNdx.toFixed(3);
    corrNdxEl.style.color = corrNdx > 0.3 ? '#2ecc71' : corrNdx < -0.3 ? '#e74c3c' : '';
  }

  function corrBadge(el, sig) {
    if (sig === 'BULLISH_SETUP') {
      el.className = 'badge badge-green';
      el.textContent = 'BULLISH';
    } else if (sig === 'BEARISH_SETUP') {
      el.className = 'badge badge-red';
      el.textContent = 'BEARISH';
    } else {
      el.className = 'badge badge-gray';
      el.textContent = sig || 'NEUTRE';
    }
  }
  corrBadge(sigBtcEl, summary.composite_btc);
  corrBadge(sigNdxEl, summary.composite_ndx);

  // Correlation chart with signal markers
  if (!history.length) return;
  const labels = history.map(h => h.date);
  const btcCorr = history.map(h => h.corr_btc_24m);
  const ndxCorr = history.map(h => h.corr_ndx_24m);

  // Build signal markers: BUY (green triangle up) / SELL (red triangle down) on chart
  const btcSignalPts = history.map(h => {
    if (h.composite_btc === 'BULLISH_SETUP' || h.signal_btc_cross === 'BUY_SETUP') return h.corr_btc_24m;
    if (h.composite_btc === 'BEARISH_SETUP' || h.signal_btc_cross === 'SELL_SETUP') return h.corr_btc_24m;
    return null;
  });
  const btcSignalColors = history.map(h => {
    if (h.composite_btc === 'BULLISH_SETUP') return '#2ecc71';
    if (h.composite_btc === 'BEARISH_SETUP') return '#e74c3c';
    if (h.signal_btc_cross === 'BUY_SETUP') return 'rgba(46,204,113,0.5)';
    if (h.signal_btc_cross === 'SELL_SETUP') return 'rgba(231,76,60,0.5)';
    return 'transparent';
  });
  const btcSignalRadius = history.map(h => {
    if (h.composite_btc === 'BULLISH_SETUP' || h.composite_btc === 'BEARISH_SETUP') return 8;
    if (h.signal_btc_cross === 'BUY_SETUP' || h.signal_btc_cross === 'SELL_SETUP') return 6;
    return 0;
  });
  const btcSignalStyles = history.map(h => {
    if (h.composite_btc === 'BULLISH_SETUP' || h.signal_btc_cross === 'BUY_SETUP') return 'triangle';
    if (h.composite_btc === 'BEARISH_SETUP' || h.signal_btc_cross === 'SELL_SETUP') return 'rectRot';
    return 'circle';
  });

  const ndxSignalPts = history.map(h => {
    if (h.composite_ndx === 'BULLISH_SETUP' || h.signal_ndx_cross === 'BUY_SETUP') return h.corr_ndx_24m;
    if (h.composite_ndx === 'BEARISH_SETUP' || h.signal_ndx_cross === 'SELL_SETUP') return h.corr_ndx_24m;
    return null;
  });
  const ndxSignalColors = history.map(h => {
    if (h.composite_ndx === 'BULLISH_SETUP') return '#2ecc71';
    if (h.composite_ndx === 'BEARISH_SETUP') return '#e74c3c';
    if (h.signal_ndx_cross === 'BUY_SETUP') return 'rgba(46,204,113,0.5)';
    if (h.signal_ndx_cross === 'SELL_SETUP') return 'rgba(231,76,60,0.5)';
    return 'transparent';
  });
  const ndxSignalRadius = history.map(h => {
    if (h.composite_ndx === 'BULLISH_SETUP' || h.composite_ndx === 'BEARISH_SETUP') return 8;
    if (h.signal_ndx_cross === 'BUY_SETUP' || h.signal_ndx_cross === 'SELL_SETUP') return 6;
    return 0;
  });
  const ndxSignalStyles = history.map(h => {
    if (h.composite_ndx === 'BULLISH_SETUP' || h.signal_ndx_cross === 'BUY_SETUP') return 'triangle';
    if (h.composite_ndx === 'BEARISH_SETUP' || h.signal_ndx_cross === 'SELL_SETUP') return 'rectRot';
    return 'circle';
  });

  const colors = getChartColors();
  const canvas = document.getElementById('corrChart');
  if (!canvas) return;

  if (macroCorrChart) macroCorrChart.destroy();
  macroCorrChart = new Chart(canvas, {
    type: 'line',
    data: {
      labels,
      datasets: [
        {
          label: 'Corr BTC 24m',
          data: btcCorr,
          borderColor: '#F4B942',
          backgroundColor: 'transparent',
          borderWidth: 2,
          tension: 0.3,
          pointRadius: 0,
        },
        {
          label: 'Corr NDX 24m',
          data: ndxCorr,
          borderColor: '#9DC3E6',
          backgroundColor: 'transparent',
          borderWidth: 2,
          tension: 0.3,
          pointRadius: 0,
        },
        {
          label: 'Signal BTC',
          data: btcSignalPts,
          borderColor: 'transparent',
          backgroundColor: btcSignalColors,
          pointRadius: btcSignalRadius,
          pointStyle: btcSignalStyles,
          pointBorderColor: btcSignalColors,
          pointBorderWidth: 2,
          borderWidth: 0,
          showLine: false,
          fill: false,
        },
        {
          label: 'Signal NDX',
          data: ndxSignalPts,
          borderColor: 'transparent',
          backgroundColor: ndxSignalColors,
          pointRadius: ndxSignalRadius,
          pointStyle: ndxSignalStyles,
          pointBorderColor: ndxSignalColors,
          pointBorderWidth: 2,
          borderWidth: 0,
          showLine: false,
          fill: false,
        },
      ],
    },
    options: {
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      animation: { duration: 400 },
      plugins: {
        legend: {
          display: true, position: 'top',
          labels: {
            boxWidth: 12, font: { size: 10 },
            filter: (item) => !item.text.startsWith('Signal'),
          },
        },
        tooltip: {
          backgroundColor: '#1c1c1b',
          titleColor: '#706f6d',
          bodyColor: '#c8c7c5',
          borderColor: '#302f2d',
          borderWidth: 1,
          padding: 10,
          callbacks: {
            label: function(ctx) {
              if (ctx.dataset.label === 'Signal BTC') {
                const h = history[ctx.dataIndex];
                const sig = h.composite_btc || h.signal_btc_cross || '';
                return sig ? `BTC Signal: ${_formatSignalLabel(sig)}` : null;
              }
              if (ctx.dataset.label === 'Signal NDX') {
                const h = history[ctx.dataIndex];
                const sig = h.composite_ndx || h.signal_ndx_cross || '';
                return sig ? `NDX Signal: ${_formatSignalLabel(sig)}` : null;
              }
              return `${ctx.dataset.label}: ${ctx.parsed.y != null ? ctx.parsed.y.toFixed(3) : '—'}`;
            },
          },
        },
        // Zero line annotation via custom plugin
        annotation: undefined,
      },
      scales: {
        x: {
          grid: { color: colors.grid, drawBorder: false },
          ticks: { color: colors.tick, font: { size: 10 }, maxTicksLimit: 12, maxRotation: 0 },
        },
        y: {
          grid: { color: colors.grid, drawBorder: false },
          ticks: { color: colors.tick, font: { size: 10 } },
          min: -1, max: 1,
        },
      },
    },
    plugins: [{
      id: 'zeroLine',
      afterDraw(chart) {
        const yScale = chart.scales.y;
        const ctx = chart.ctx;
        const y = yScale.getPixelForValue(0);
        ctx.save();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.moveTo(chart.chartArea.left, y);
        ctx.lineTo(chart.chartArea.right, y);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
      },
    }],
  });

  // Render signal history log
  _renderCorrSignalLog(history);

  // Render BTC & QQQ price chart
  _renderFrontRunPriceChart(history);
}

function _renderFrontRunPriceChart(history) {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('frontRunPriceChart');
  if (!canvas || !history.length) return;

  const labels = history.map(h => h.date);
  const btcPrices = history.map(h => h.btc_price || null);
  const qqqPrices = history.map(h => h.qqq_price || null);
  const colors = getChartColors();

  // Build BUY and SELL scatter data arrays for signal markers
  const buyData = history.map(h => {
    if (h.signal_btc_cross && h.signal_btc_cross.includes('BUY')) return h.btc_price;
    return null;
  });
  const sellData = history.map(h => {
    if (h.signal_btc_cross && h.signal_btc_cross.includes('SELL')) return h.btc_price;
    return null;
  });

  if (frontRunPriceChart) frontRunPriceChart.destroy();
  frontRunPriceChart = new Chart(canvas, {
    type: 'line',
    data: {
      labels,
      datasets: [
        {
          label: 'BTC (USD)',
          data: btcPrices,
          borderColor: '#F4B942',
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(244,185,66,0.08)',
          borderWidth: 2,
          tension: 0.3,
          pointRadius: 3,
          pointHoverRadius: 5,
          pointBackgroundColor: '#F4B942',
          fill: true,
          yAxisID: 'yBtc',
        },
        {
          label: 'QQQ (USD)',
          data: qqqPrices,
          borderColor: '#9DC3E6',
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(157,195,230,0.08)',
          borderWidth: 2,
          tension: 0.3,
          pointRadius: 3,
          pointHoverRadius: 5,
          pointBackgroundColor: '#9DC3E6',
          fill: true,
          yAxisID: 'yQqq',
        },
        {
          label: 'BUY Signal',
          data: buyData,
          type: 'scatter',
          borderColor: '#00C853',
          backgroundColor: '#00C853',
          pointStyle: 'triangle',
          pointRadius: 10,
          pointHoverRadius: 14,
          pointBorderWidth: 2,
          pointBorderColor: '#00C853',
          showLine: false,
          yAxisID: 'yBtc',
        },
        {
          label: 'SELL Signal',
          data: sellData,
          type: 'scatter',
          borderColor: '#FF1744',
          backgroundColor: '#FF1744',
          pointStyle: 'triangle',
          rotation: 180,
          pointRadius: 10,
          pointHoverRadius: 14,
          pointBorderWidth: 2,
          pointBorderColor: '#FF1744',
          showLine: false,
          yAxisID: 'yBtc',
        },
      ],
    },
    options: {
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      animation: { duration: 400 },
      interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
      plugins: {
        legend: {
          display: true, position: 'top',
          labels: { boxWidth: 12, font: { size: 10 } },
        },
        tooltip: {
          backgroundColor: '#1c1c1b',
          titleColor: '#706f6d',
          bodyColor: '#c8c7c5',
          borderColor: '#302f2d',
          borderWidth: 1,
          padding: 10,
          callbacks: {
            label: function(ctx) {
              const val = ctx.parsed.y;
              if (ctx.dataset.label === 'BUY Signal') {
                const date = history[ctx.dataIndex]?.date || '';
                return `▲ BUY Signal — BTC $${val != null ? val.toLocaleString('fr-FR') : '—'} (${date})`;
              }
              if (ctx.dataset.label === 'SELL Signal') {
                const date = history[ctx.dataIndex]?.date || '';
                return `▼ SELL Signal — BTC $${val != null ? val.toLocaleString('fr-FR') : '—'} (${date})`;
              }
              if (ctx.dataset.label.startsWith('BTC')) return `BTC: $${val != null ? val.toLocaleString('fr-FR') : '—'}`;
              return `QQQ: $${val != null ? val.toFixed(0) : '—'}`;
            },
          },
        },
      },
      scales: {
        x: {
          grid: { color: colors.grid, drawBorder: false },
          ticks: { color: colors.tick, font: { size: 10 }, maxTicksLimit: 12, maxRotation: 0 },
        },
        yBtc: {
          type: 'linear',
          position: 'left',
          grid: { color: colors.grid, drawBorder: false },
          ticks: {
            color: '#F4B942',
            font: { size: 10 },
            callback: function(v) { return '$' + (v / 1000).toFixed(0) + 'k'; },
          },
          title: { display: true, text: 'BTC', color: '#F4B942', font: { size: 10 } },
        },
        yQqq: {
          type: 'linear',
          position: 'right',
          grid: { drawOnChartArea: false },
          ticks: {
            color: '#9DC3E6',
            font: { size: 10 },
            callback: function(v) { return '$' + v; },
          },
          title: { display: true, text: 'QQQ', color: '#9DC3E6', font: { size: 10 } },
        },
      },
    },
  });
}

function _formatSignalLabel(sig) {
  const map = {
    'BULLISH_SETUP': 'BULLISH',
    'BEARISH_SETUP': 'BEARISH',
    'BUY_SETUP': 'BUY',
    'SELL_SETUP': 'SELL',
    'STRONG_INVERSE': 'Forte corr. inverse',
    'STRONG_POSITIVE': 'Forte corr. positive',
    'ROTATION_FAST_PLUS': 'Rotation rapide +',
    'ROTATION_FAST_MINUS': 'Rotation rapide −',
  };
  return map[sig] || sig;
}

function _renderCorrSignalLog(history) {
  const container = document.getElementById('corrSignalLog');
  if (!container) return;

  // Collect all signal events (most recent first)
  const events = [];
  for (let i = history.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const h = history[i];
    const btcSig = h.composite_btc || h.signal_btc_cross;
    const ndxSig = h.composite_ndx || h.signal_ndx_cross;
    if (btcSig) {
      events.push({ date: h.date, asset: 'BTC', signal: btcSig, corr: h.corr_btc_24m });
    }
    if (ndxSig) {
      events.push({ date: h.date, asset: 'NDX', signal: ndxSig, corr: h.corr_ndx_24m });
    }
  }

  if (!events.length) {
    container.innerHTML = '<div class="text-muted" style="font-size:var(--text-xs);padding:var(--space-2)">Aucun signal detecte sur la periode</div>';
    return;
  }

  const header = `<div class="section-header" style="margin-bottom:var(--space-2)">
    <span class="section-title" style="font-size:var(--text-sm)">Journal des Signaux</span>
    <span class="text-muted" style="font-size:var(--text-xs)">${events.length} signal(s) sur 24 mois</span>
  </div>`;

  const rows = events.slice(0, 12).map(ev => {
    const isBuy = ev.signal.includes('BULLISH') || ev.signal.includes('BUY');
    const isSell = ev.signal.includes('BEARISH') || ev.signal.includes('SELL');
    const badgeClass = isBuy ? 'badge-green' : isSell ? 'badge-red' : 'badge-gray';
    const sideLabel = isBuy ? 'BUY' : isSell ? 'SELL' : '—';
    const corrStr = ev.corr != null ? (ev.corr > 0 ? '+' : '') + ev.corr.toFixed(3) : '—';
    const corrColor = ev.corr > 0.3 ? 'color:#2ecc71' : ev.corr < -0.3 ? 'color:#e74c3c' : '';

    return `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--space-3);padding:var(--space-1) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(255,255,255,0.06))">
      <span class="mono" style="font-size:var(--text-xs);color:var(--text-muted);min-width:56px">${esc(ev.date)}</span>
      <span class="mono" style="font-size:var(--text-xs);min-width:32px;font-weight:600">${esc(ev.asset)}</span>
      <span class="badge ${badgeClass}" style="min-width:44px;text-align:center">${sideLabel}</span>
      <span style="font-size:var(--text-xs);color:var(--text-secondary)">${_formatSignalLabel(ev.signal)}</span>
      <span class="mono" style="font-size:var(--text-xs);margin-left:auto;${corrColor}">${corrStr}</span>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');

  container.innerHTML = header + '<div style="max-height:260px;overflow-y:auto">' + rows + '</div>';
}

/**
 * Render the Front-Run confirmation checklist.
 * Dynamically evaluates 5 criteria from the macro data.
 */
function renderFrontRunChecklist(macroData) {
  const container = document.getElementById('checklistItems');
  const scoreEl = document.getElementById('checklistCount');
  if (!container || !scoreEl || !macroData) return;

  const summary = macroData.correlation_summary || {};
  const subScores = macroData.sub_scores || [];
  const history = macroData.history || [];

  // Criterion 1: Corr_BTC_24m or Corr_NDX_24m < 0
  const corrBtc = summary.corr_btc_24m;
  const corrNdx = summary.corr_ndx_24m;
  const c1 = (corrBtc != null && corrBtc < 0) || (corrNdx != null && corrNdx < 0);

  // Criterion 2: Signal_X_Velocity = ROTATION_FAST_MINUS
  const velocity = summary.signal_x_velocity || '';
  const c2 = velocity === 'ROTATION_FAST_MINUS';

  // Criterion 3: GlobalScore en hausse sur 3 mois consécutifs
  let c3 = false;
  if (history.length >= 3) {
    const last3 = history.slice(-3);
    c3 = last3[1].GlobalScore > last3[0].GlobalScore && last3[2].GlobalScore > last3[1].GlobalScore;
  }

  // Criterion 4: HY Spread > 400 bps (simulate from DebtScore > 6.0)
  const debtScore = subScores.find(s => s.name === 'DebtScore');
  const c4 = debtScore ? debtScore.value > 6.0 : false;

  // Criterion 5: DebtScore or PriceFXScore en accélération
  let c5 = false;
  const priceFX = subScores.find(s => s.name === 'PriceFXScore');
  if (debtScore && debtScore.previous != null) {
    c5 = (debtScore.value - debtScore.previous) > 0.3;
  }
  if (!c5 && priceFX && priceFX.previous != null) {
    c5 = (priceFX.value - priceFX.previous) > 0.2;
  }

  const checks = [
    { label: 'Corr_BTC_24m ou Corr_NDX_24m < 0', detail: corrBtc != null ? `BTC: ${corrBtc > 0 ? '+' : ''}${corrBtc.toFixed(3)}, NDX: ${corrNdx > 0 ? '+' : ''}${corrNdx.toFixed(3)}` : '—', ok: c1 },
    { label: 'Velocity = ROTATION_FAST_MINUS', detail: velocity || 'N/A', ok: c2 },
    { label: 'GlobalScore hausse 3 mois consécutifs', detail: history.length >= 3 ? history.slice(-3).map(h => h.GlobalScore.toFixed(1)).join(' → ') : '—', ok: c3 },
    { label: 'HY Spread > 400 bps (DebtScore > 6.0)', detail: debtScore ? debtScore.value.toFixed(1) : '—', ok: c4 },
    { label: 'DebtScore ou PriceFXScore en accélération', detail: debtScore ? `Debt Δ${(debtScore.value - (debtScore.previous||0)).toFixed(1)}` : '—', ok: c5 },
  ];

  const count = checks.filter(c => c.ok).length;

  container.innerHTML = checks.map(c => {
    const icon = c.ok ? '<span style="color:#2ecc71;font-weight:700">✓</span>' : '<span style="color:#e74c3c;font-weight:700">✗</span>';
    return `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--space-2);padding:var(--space-1) var(--space-2);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);background:${c.ok ? 'rgba(46,204,113,0.06)' : 'rgba(231,76,60,0.04)'}">
      ${icon}
      <span style="font-size:var(--text-xs);flex:1">${esc(c.label)}</span>
      <span class="mono" style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text-muted)">${esc(c.detail)}</span>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');

  const statusColor = count >= 3 ? '#e74c3c' : count >= 1 ? '#F4B942' : '#2ecc71';
  const statusText = count >= 3 ? `${count}/5 — SIGNAL CONFIRMÉ` : count >= 1 ? `${count}/5 — Surveillance` : `${count}/5 — Pas de signal`;
  scoreEl.innerHTML = `<span style="color:${statusColor}">${statusText}</span>`;
}

function renderMacroCalendar(events) {
  const tbody = document.getElementById('calendarBody');
  if (!events.length) {
    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" class="empty-state">Aucun événement</td></tr>';
    return;
  }

  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  tbody.innerHTML = events.map(ev => {
    const isToday = ev.date === today;
    const isPast = ev.date < today;
    const rowClass = isToday ? 'style="background:var(--color-primary-highlight,rgba(77,184,191,0.08))"' : isPast ? 'style="opacity:0.5"' : '';
    const impactDot = `<span class="impact-dot ${esc(ev.impact)}"></span>${esc(ev.impact).toUpperCase()}`;

    const dateObj = new Date(ev.date + 'T00:00:00');
    const dateStr = dateObj.toLocaleDateString('fr-FR', { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });

    // Actual value: highlight surprise (green if better than forecast, red if worse for growth indicators)
    const actualVal = ev.actual ?? '';
    let actualDisplay = '';
    if (actualVal) {
      const numActual = parseFloat(actualVal.replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g, ''));
      const numForecast = parseFloat((ev.forecast || '').replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g, ''));
      let surpriseColor = '';
      if (!isNaN(numActual) && !isNaN(numForecast)) {
        const diff = numActual - numForecast;
        if (Math.abs(diff) > 0.05) {
          surpriseColor = diff > 0 ? 'color:#2ecc71;font-weight:600' : 'color:#e74c3c;font-weight:600';
        }
      }
      actualDisplay = `<span style="${surpriseColor}">${esc(actualVal)}</span>`;
    } else {
      actualDisplay = '<span class="text-muted">—</span>';
    }

    return `
      <tr ${rowClass}>
        <td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--text-xs)">${esc(dateStr)}</td>
        <td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--text-xs)">${esc(ev.time)}</td>
        <td><strong>${esc(ev.event)}</strong></td>
        <td>${impactDot}</td>
        <td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--text-xs)">${esc(ev.previous)}</td>
        <td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--text-xs)">${esc(ev.forecast)}</td>
        <td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--text-xs)">${actualDisplay}</td>
        <td><span class="category-badge">${esc(ev.category)}</span></td>
      </tr>
    `;
  }).join('');
}

function renderMacroHistory(history) {
  if (!history.length) return;
  const colors = getChartColors();
  const canvas = document.getElementById('macroHistoryChart');
  if (!canvas) return;

  const labels = history.map(h => h.date);
  const globalScores = history.map(h => h.GlobalScore);
  const debtScores = history.map(h => h.DebtScore);
  const priceScores = history.map(h => h.PriceFXScore);
  const jobsScores = history.map(h => h.JobsScore);
  const iaScores = history.map(h => h.IAScore);

  if (macroHistChart) macroHistChart.destroy();
  macroHistChart = new Chart(canvas, {
    type: 'line',
    data: {
      labels,
      datasets: [
        { label: 'Global', data: globalScores, borderColor: '#4db8bf', borderWidth: 3, tension: 0.3, pointRadius: 5, pointHoverRadius: 7, pointBackgroundColor: '#4db8bf', fill: false },
        { label: 'Dette', data: debtScores, borderColor: '#C00000', borderWidth: 1.5, tension: 0.3, pointRadius: 0, borderDash: [6, 3], fill: false },
        { label: 'Prix/FX', data: priceScores, borderColor: '#F4B942', borderWidth: 1.5, tension: 0.3, pointRadius: 0, borderDash: [6, 3], fill: false },
        { label: 'Emploi', data: jobsScores, borderColor: '#9DC3E6', borderWidth: 1.5, tension: 0.3, pointRadius: 0, borderDash: [6, 3], fill: false },
        { label: 'IA', data: iaScores, borderColor: '#70AD47', borderWidth: 1.5, tension: 0.3, pointRadius: 0, borderDash: [6, 3], fill: false },
      ],
    },
    options: {
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      animation: { duration: 400 },
      plugins: {
        legend: { display: true, position: 'top', labels: { boxWidth: 14, padding: 16, font: { size: 12 } } },
        tooltip: {
          backgroundColor: '#1c1c1b',
          titleColor: '#706f6d',
          bodyColor: '#c8c7c5',
          borderColor: '#302f2d',
          borderWidth: 1,
          padding: 10,
          bodyFont: { size: 12 },
          titleFont: { size: 12 },
        },
      },
      scales: {
        x: {
          grid: { color: colors.grid, drawBorder: false },
          ticks: { color: colors.tick, font: { size: 11 }, maxTicksLimit: 12, maxRotation: 0 },
        },
        y: {
          grid: { color: colors.grid, drawBorder: false },
          ticks: { color: colors.tick, font: { size: 11 } },
          min: (function() { const all = [].concat(globalScores, debtScores, priceScores, jobsScores, iaScores).filter(v => v != null); return Math.floor(Math.min(...all)); })(),
          max: (function() { const all = [].concat(globalScores, debtScores, priceScores, jobsScores, iaScores).filter(v => v != null); return Math.ceil(Math.max(...all)); })(),
        },
      },
    },
  });
}

let geoData = null;

async function loadGeoRiskData() {
  try {
    geoData = await apiFetch('/api/geopolitical/risk');
    renderGeoHero(geoData);
    renderGeoSubscores(geoData.sub_scores || []);
    renderGeoGauge(geoData.composite_score);
    renderGeoChokepoints(geoData.chokepoints || []);
    renderGeoTheaters(geoData.theaters || []);
    renderGeoAlerts(geoData.alerts || []);
    renderGeoScoreChart(geoData.score_history || []);
  } catch (err) {
    const msgEl = document.getElementById('geoScoreRegime');
    if (msgEl) msgEl.textContent = 'Chargement en cours...';
    // Retry once after 15s
    setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        geoData = await apiFetch('/api/geopolitical/risk');
        renderGeoHero(geoData);
        renderGeoSubscores(geoData.sub_scores || []);
        renderGeoGauge(geoData.composite_score);
        renderGeoChokepoints(geoData.chokepoints || []);
        renderGeoTheaters(geoData.theaters || []);
        renderGeoAlerts(geoData.alerts || []);
        renderGeoScoreChart(geoData.score_history || []);
      } catch (e2) {
        if (msgEl) msgEl.textContent = 'Données temporairement indisponibles (GDELT). Rechargez dans 1 min.';
      }
    }, 15000);
  }
}

function geoScoreColor(score) {
  if (score < 20) return '#70AD47';
  if (score < 40) return '#9DC3E6';
  if (score < 60) return '#FFD966';
  if (score < 80) return '#F4B942';
  return '#C00000';
}

function renderGeoGauge(score) {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('geoGauge');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const w = canvas.width;
  const h = canvas.height;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

  const cx = w / 2;
  const cy = h - 10;
  const r = 90;

  const segments = [
    { start: Math.PI, end: Math.PI * 1.2, color: '#70AD47' },
    { start: Math.PI * 1.2, end: Math.PI * 1.4, color: '#9DC3E6' },
    { start: Math.PI * 1.4, end: Math.PI * 1.6, color: '#FFD966' },
    { start: Math.PI * 1.6, end: Math.PI * 1.8, color: '#F4B942' },
    { start: Math.PI * 1.8, end: Math.PI * 2, color: '#C00000' },
  ];

  segments.forEach(s => {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, s.start, s.end);
    ctx.lineWidth = 14;
    ctx.strokeStyle = s.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3;
    ctx.stroke();
  });

  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  const scoreAngle = Math.PI + (score / 100) * Math.PI;
  segments.forEach(s => {
    const effectiveEnd = Math.min(s.end, scoreAngle);
    if (effectiveEnd > s.start) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, s.start, effectiveEnd);
      ctx.lineWidth = 14;
      ctx.strokeStyle = s.color;
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  });

  // Needle
  const needleAngle = Math.PI + (score / 100) * Math.PI;
  const needleLen = r - 20;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
  ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(needleAngle) * needleLen, cy + Math.sin(needleAngle) * needleLen);
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
  ctx.strokeStyle = geoScoreColor(score);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = geoScoreColor(score);
  ctx.fill();

  ctx.font = '10px JetBrains Mono, monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--color-text-muted').trim() || '#888';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('0', cx - r - 5, cy + 12);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('100', cx + r + 5, cy + 12);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('50', cx, cy - r + 2);
}

function renderGeoHero(data) {
  const scoreEl = document.getElementById('geoScoreValue');
  const regimeEl = document.getElementById('geoScoreRegime');
  const color = geoScoreColor(data.composite_score);
  scoreEl.textContent = Math.round(data.composite_score);
  scoreEl.style.color = color;
  regimeEl.textContent = data.regime;
  regimeEl.style.color = color;
}

    return `
      <div class="macro-subscore-card" style="border-top:3px solid ${color}">
        <div class="macro-subscore-header">
          <span class="macro-subscore-name">${esc(s.name)}</span>
          <span class="macro-subscore-badge" style="background:${color}20;color:${color}">${esc(s.weight)}</span>

        <div class="macro-subscore-bar">

    </div>
  `).join('');

function renderGeoScoreChart(history) {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('geoScoreHistoryChart');
  if (!canvas || !history || !history.length) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  canvas.width = rect.width * dpr;
  canvas.height = rect.height * dpr;
  ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
  const W = rect.width;
  const H = rect.height;

  const isDark = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark';
  const textColor = isDark ? '#b0b8c4' : '#555';
  const gridColor = isDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.07)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.07)';
  const bgColor = isDark ? '#1a1d23' : '#ffffff';

  /* Series definition */
  const series = [
    { key: 'composite',      label: 'Composite',      color: '#3B82F6', width: 2.5, dash: [] },
    { key: 'conflicts',      label: 'Conflits',       color: '#C00000', width: 1.2, dash: [4,3] },
    { key: 'supply_chain',   label: 'Supply Chain',   color: '#F4B942', width: 1.2, dash: [4,3] },
    { key: 'theaters',       label: 'Th\u00e9\u00e2tres',       color: '#E67E22', width: 1.2, dash: [4,3] },
    { key: 'infrastructure', label: 'Infrastructure', color: '#9DC3E6', width: 1.2, dash: [4,3] }
  ];

  /* Compute dynamic Y range: floor(global min) to ceil(global max) */
  let allVals = [];
  history.forEach(pt => {
    series.forEach(s => {
      if (pt[s.key] != null) allVals.push(pt[s.key]);
    });
  });
  const dataMin = Math.min(...allVals);
  const dataMax = Math.max(...allVals);
  const scaleMin = Math.floor(dataMin);
  const scaleMax = Math.ceil(dataMax);
  const yRange = scaleMax - scaleMin || 1;

  /* Layout */
  const padL = 42, padR = 30, padT = 12, padB = 44;
  const chartW = W - padL - padR;
  const chartH = H - padT - padB;

  /* Clear */
  ctx.fillStyle = bgColor;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  /* Helper: value to Y pixel */
  const yOf = v => padT + chartH - ((v - scaleMin) / yRange) * chartH;
  const xOf = i => padL + (i / (history.length - 1)) * chartW;

  /* Grid lines & Y labels — nice step */
  const rawStep = yRange / 5;
  const step = rawStep <= 2 ? 1 : rawStep <= 5 ? 2 : rawStep <= 12 ? 5 : 10;
  const firstTick = Math.ceil(scaleMin / step) * step;
  ctx.font = '10px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  for (let val = firstTick; val <= scaleMax; val += step) {
    const y = yOf(val);
    ctx.strokeStyle = gridColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(padL, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W - padR, y);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
    ctx.fillText(val.toString(), padL - 6, y);
  }

  /* X labels */
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
  history.forEach((pt, i) => {
    const x = xOf(i);
    ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
    ctx.fillText(pt.date, x, padT + chartH + 6);
  });

  /* Draw series lines */
  series.forEach(s => {
    ctx.strokeStyle = s.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = s.width;
    ctx.setLineDash(s.dash);
    ctx.beginPath();
    history.forEach((pt, i) => {
      const x = xOf(i);
      const y = yOf(pt[s.key]);
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
      else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    });
    ctx.stroke();
  });

  /* Dots on composite */
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  history.forEach((pt, i) => {
    const x = xOf(i);
    const y = yOf(pt.composite);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = geoScoreColor(pt.composite);
    ctx.fill();
  });

  /* Legend */
  const legendY = padT + chartH + 24;
  let lx = padL;
  ctx.font = '10px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif';
  series.forEach(s => {
    ctx.setLineDash(s.dash);
    ctx.strokeStyle = s.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = s.width;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(lx, legendY + 5);
    ctx.lineTo(lx + 18, legendY + 5);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(s.label, lx + 22, legendY);
    lx += ctx.measureText(s.label).width + 36;
  });
}

/* =====================================================
   AUTH / SESSION MANAGEMENT
   ===================================================== */

function saveSession(token, user) {
  state.token = token;
  state.user = user;
}

function clearSession() {
  state.token = null;
  state.user = null;
}

function isLoggedIn() {
  return !!state.token;
}

function showLogin() {
  document.getElementById('loginOverlay').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('dashboard').style.display = 'none';
}

function hideLogin() {
  document.getElementById('loginOverlay').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('dashboard').style.display = '';
  // Show user info in header
  const userEl = document.getElementById('headerUser');
  if (state.user && userEl) {
    userEl.textContent = state.user.full_name || state.user.username;
  }
  // Show/hide admin nav based on role
  const adminNav = document.getElementById('navAdmin');
  if (adminNav) {
    adminNav.style.display = (state.user && state.user.role === 'admin') ? '' : 'none';
  }
}

async function handleLogin(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const btn = document.getElementById('loginBtn');
  const errEl = document.getElementById('loginError');
  const username = document.getElementById('loginUsername').value.trim();
  const password = document.getElementById('loginPassword').value;

  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = 'Connexion...';
  errEl.hidden = true;

  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/auth/login`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ username, password }),
    });
    if (!resp.ok) {
      const data = await resp.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(data.detail || 'Identifiants incorrects');
    }
    const data = await resp.json();
    saveSession(data.access_token, data.user);
    hideLogin();
    refreshAll();
  } catch (err) {
    errEl.textContent = err.message;
    errEl.hidden = false;
  } finally {
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.textContent = 'Se connecter';
  }
}

function handleLogout() {
  clearSession();
  showLogin();
  // Clear login form
  document.getElementById('loginUsername').value = '';
  document.getElementById('loginPassword').value = '';
  document.getElementById('loginError').hidden = true;
}

async function validateSession() {
  if (!state.token) return false;
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/auth/me`, {
      headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${state.token}` },
    });
    if (!resp.ok) {
      clearSession();
      return false;
    }
    const user = await resp.json();
    state.user = user;
    return true;
  } catch {
    clearSession();
    return false;
  }
}

/* =====================================================
   INIT
   ===================================================== */

async function init() {
  initTheme();
  initClock();
  initSidebar();
  initRouter();
  initFilters();

  // Auth: login form
  document.getElementById('loginForm').addEventListener('submit', handleLogin);
  document.getElementById('logoutBtn').addEventListener('click', handleLogout);

  // Check if already logged in
  const valid = await validateSession();
  if (valid) {
    hideLogin();
    refreshAll();
  } else {
    showLogin();
  }

  // Run Decision Cycle button
  document.getElementById('runCycleBtn').addEventListener('click', runDecisionCycle);

  // Refresh button
  document.getElementById('refreshBtn').addEventListener('click', refreshAll);

  // Close detail panel
  document.getElementById('detailOverlay').addEventListener('click', closeDetailPanel);
  document.getElementById('detailClose').addEventListener('click', closeDetailPanel);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') closeDetailPanel();
  });
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);


/* =====================================================
   BACKTEST MODULE
   ===================================================== */

let _btChart = null;
let _lastBacktestData = null;

function initBacktest() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('btRunBtn');
  if (btn) btn.addEventListener('click', runBacktest);
  const csvBtn = document.getElementById('btExportCsv');
  if (csvBtn) csvBtn.addEventListener('click', exportBacktestCsv);
}

async function runBacktest() {
  // [PATCH_UI_BACKTEST_REGIME_V2]
  const applyRegime = (document.getElementById('btApplyRegime') && document.getElementById('btApplyRegime').checked) || false;
  const preset   = document.getElementById('btPreset').value;
  const months   = parseInt(document.getElementById('btMonths').value, 10);
  const capital  = parseFloat(document.getElementById('btCapital').value) || 100000;
  const benchmark = document.getElementById('btBenchmark').value;

  // Build request based on preset
  const body = { months, initial_capital: capital, benchmark };
  if (preset === 'equity')      { body.include_equity = true;  body.include_crypto = false; }
  else if (preset === 'crypto') { body.include_equity = false; body.include_crypto = true;  }
  else if (preset === 'mixed')  {
    body.tickers = ['AAPL','MSFT','NVDA','GOOGL','AMZN','TSLA','META','JPM','BAC','XOM','JNJ','UNH','BTC','ETH'];
    const eqW = 0.6 / 12;
    const crW = 0.4 / 2;
    body.custom_weights = {};
    ['AAPL','MSFT','NVDA','GOOGL','AMZN','TSLA','META','JPM','BAC','XOM','JNJ','UNH'].forEach(t => body.custom_weights[t] = eqW);
    body.custom_weights['BTC'] = crW;
    body.custom_weights['ETH'] = crW;
  }
  else { body.include_equity = true; body.include_crypto = true; }

  // UI states
  document.getElementById('btLoading').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('btResults').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('btRunBtn').disabled = true;

  // [PATCH_UI_BACKTEST_REGIME_V2]
  body.apply_regime = applyRegime;
  try {
    const resp = await apiFetch('/api/backtest', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
    if (resp.error) {
      showToast(resp.error, 'error');
      return;
    }
    renderBacktestResults(resp, benchmark);
    _lastBacktestData = resp;
  } catch (e) {
    showToast('Erreur backtest: ' + e.message, 'error');
  } finally {
    document.getElementById('btLoading').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('btRunBtn').disabled = false;
  }
}

function renderBacktestResults(data, benchTicker) {
  document.getElementById('btResults').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('btBenchLabel').textContent = benchTicker;

  const s = data.stats || {};
  const b = data.benchmark_stats || {};

  // KPI cards
  document.getElementById('btKPIs').innerHTML = [
    btKpi('Rendement total', fmtPctSigned(s.total_return_pct), s.total_return_pct),
    btKpi('Rendement ann.', fmtPctSigned(s.annualized_return_pct), s.annualized_return_pct),
    btKpi('Volatilité ann.', (s.volatility_pct != null ? s.volatility_pct.toFixed(1) + '%' : '—'), null),
    btKpi('Sharpe', s.sharpe != null ? s.sharpe.toFixed(2) : '—', s.sharpe > 1 ? 1 : s.sharpe < 0 ? -1 : 0),
    btKpi('Max Drawdown', s.max_drawdown_pct != null ? '-' + s.max_drawdown_pct.toFixed(1) + '%' : '—', s.max_drawdown_pct > 20 ? -1 : 0),
    btKpi('Valeur finale', s.final_value != null ? fmtUSD(s.final_value) : '—', s.total_return_pct),
  ].join('');

  // Stats comparison table
  const metrics = [
    ['Rendement total', 'total_return_pct', '%'],
    ['Rendement annualisé', 'annualized_return_pct', '%'],
    ['Volatilité', 'volatility_pct', '%'],
    ['Sharpe', 'sharpe', ''],
    ['Sortino', 'sortino', ''],
    ['Max Drawdown', 'max_drawdown_pct', '%'],
    ['Calmar', 'calmar', ''],
    ['Win Rate', 'win_rate_pct', '%'],
    ['Meilleur jour', 'best_day_pct', '%'],
    ['Pire jour', 'worst_day_pct', '%'],
  ];
  document.getElementById('btStatsBody').innerHTML = metrics.map(([label, key, suffix]) => {
    const pv = s[key];
    const bv = b[key];
    const pfmt = pv != null ? (suffix === '%' ? pv.toFixed(2) + '%' : pv.toFixed(2)) : '—';
    const bfmt = bv != null ? (suffix === '%' ? bv.toFixed(2) + '%' : bv.toFixed(2)) : '—';
    return `<tr><td class="text-muted">${label}</td><td class="mono">${pfmt}</td><td class="mono">${bfmt}</td></tr>`;
  }).join('');

  // Per-asset table
  const assets = data.per_asset || [];
  document.getElementById('btAssetBody').innerHTML = assets.map(a => {
    const retCls = a.return_pct >= 0 ? 'color:#2ecc71' : 'color:#e74c3c';
    const cCls   = a.contribution_pct >= 0 ? 'color:#2ecc71' : 'color:#e74c3c';
    return `<tr>
      <td><strong>${esc(a.ticker)}</strong></td>
      <td class="mono">${a.weight.toFixed(1)}%</td>
      <td class="mono" style="${retCls}">${a.return_pct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${a.return_pct.toFixed(2)}%</td>
      <td class="mono" style="${cCls}">${a.contribution_pct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${a.contribution_pct.toFixed(2)}%</td>
    </tr>`;
  }).join('');

  // Meta
  const skipped = data.tickers_skipped || [];
  let meta = `Période : ${data.start_date} → ${data.end_date} (${data.period_days} jours) | ${(data.tickers_used || []).length} actifs`;
  if (skipped.length) meta += ` | ${skipped.length} exclu(s) : ${skipped.join(', ')}`;
  document.getElementById('btMeta').textContent = meta;

  // Equity curve chart
  renderBtChart(data.portfolio_equity || [], data.benchmark_equity || [], benchTicker);
  // [PATCH_UI_BACKTEST_REGIME_V2]
  try { renderBacktestRegime(data); } catch(e) { console.warn('regime render fail', e); }
}

function btKpi(label, value, sentiment) {
  let cls = '';
  if (sentiment > 0) cls = 'color:#2ecc71';
  else if (sentiment < 0) cls = 'color:#e74c3c';
  return `<div class="kpi-card">
    <div class="kpi-label">${label}</div>
    <div class="kpi-value" style="${cls}">${value}</div>
  </div>`;
}

function fmtPctSigned(v) {
  if (v == null) return '—';
  return (v >= 0 ? '+' : '') + v.toFixed(2) + '%';
}

function renderBtChart(portEquity, benchEquity, benchLabel) {
  const ctx = document.getElementById('btChart');
  if (!ctx) return;

  if (_btChart) { _btChart.destroy(); _btChart = null; }

  // Thin out labels for readability (show every ~20th date)
  const labels = portEquity.map(p => p.date);
  const step = Math.max(1, Math.floor(labels.length / 20));

  const datasets = [{
    label: 'Portfolio',
    data: portEquity.map(p => p.value),
    borderColor: '#20808D',
    backgroundColor: 'rgba(32,128,141,0.08)',
    fill: true,
    tension: 0.3,
    pointRadius: 0,
    borderWidth: 2,
  }];

  if (benchEquity.length) {
    datasets.push({
      label: benchLabel,
      data: benchEquity.map(p => p.value),
      borderColor: '#A84B2F',
      backgroundColor: 'transparent',
      fill: false,
      tension: 0.3,
      pointRadius: 0,
      borderWidth: 1.5,
      borderDash: [5, 3],
    });
  }

  _btChart = new Chart(ctx, {
    type: 'line',
    data: { labels, datasets },
    options: {
      responsive: true,
      maintainAspectRatio: false,
      interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
      plugins: {
        legend: { position: 'top', labels: { font: { size: 11 }, usePointStyle: true, padding: 16 } },
        tooltip: {
          callbacks: {
            label: ctx => `${ctx.dataset.label}: $${ctx.parsed.y.toLocaleString('en-US', {minimumFractionDigits: 0})}`,
          },
        },
      },
      scales: {
        x: {
          ticks: {
            maxTicksLimit: 12,
            font: { size: 10 },
            callback: function(val, idx) { return idx % step === 0 ? this.getLabelForValue(val) : ''; }
          },
          grid: { display: false },
        },
        y: {
          ticks: {
            font: { size: 10 },
            callback: v => '$' + (v / 1000).toFixed(0) + 'k',
          },
          grid: { color: 'rgba(128,128,128,0.1)' },
        },
      },
    },
  });
}

function exportBacktestCsv() {
  if (!_lastBacktestData || !_lastBacktestData.trade_journal || !_lastBacktestData.trade_journal.length) {
    showToast('Aucun journal de trading disponible. Lancez un backtest d\'abord.', 'warning');
    return;
  }

  const journal = _lastBacktestData.trade_journal;
  const sep = ';';  // semicolon for French Excel compatibility

  // CSV header
  const headers = ['Date', 'Ticker', 'Poids (%)', 'Prix', 'Rendement Jour (%)', 'Rendement Cumul (%)', 'Valeur Position'];
  const rows = [headers.join(sep)];

  // Sort by date then ticker
  const sorted = [...journal].sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.date < b.date) return -1;
    if (a.date > b.date) return 1;
    return a.ticker.localeCompare(b.ticker);
  });

  for (const row of sorted) {
    rows.push([
      row.date,
      row.ticker,
      row.poids_pct,
      row.prix,
      row.rendement_jour_pct,
      row.rendement_cumul_pct,
      row.valeur_position,
    ].join(sep));
  }

  // Add summary section
  const stats = _lastBacktestData.stats || {};
  rows.push('');
  rows.push('Statistiques Portfolio');
  rows.push(['Rendement Total (%)', stats.total_return_pct].join(sep));
  rows.push(['Rendement Annualisé (%)', stats.annualized_return_pct].join(sep));
  rows.push(['Volatilité (%)', stats.volatility_pct].join(sep));
  rows.push(['Sharpe', stats.sharpe].join(sep));
  rows.push(['Sortino', stats.sortino].join(sep));
  rows.push(['Max Drawdown (%)', stats.max_drawdown_pct].join(sep));
  rows.push(['Win Rate (%)', stats.win_rate_pct].join(sep));
  rows.push(['Période', _lastBacktestData.start_date + ' → ' + _lastBacktestData.end_date].join(sep));
  rows.push(['Jours de trading', stats.trading_days].join(sep));
  rows.push(['Valeur finale', stats.final_value].join(sep));

  // BOM for UTF-8 Excel compatibility
  const bom = '﻿';
  const csvContent = bom + rows.join('\n');
  const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `backtest_journal_${_lastBacktestData.start_date}_${_lastBacktestData.end_date}.csv`;
  a.style.display = 'none';
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, 100);

  showToast('Journal de trading exporté en CSV', 'success');
}

/* =====================================================
   ADMIN MODULE
   ===================================================== */

async function loadAdminUsers() {
  try {
    const resp = await apiFetch('/api/admin/users');
    const users = resp.users || [];
    const tbody = document.getElementById('adminUsersBody');
    if (!users.length) {
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" class="text-muted" style="text-align:center;padding:var(--space-4)">Aucun utilisateur</td></tr>';
      return;
    }
    tbody.innerHTML = users.map(u => {
      const roleBadge = _adminRoleBadge(u.role);
      const statusBadge = u.is_active
        ? '<span class="badge" style="background:#2ecc71;color:#fff;font-size:10px">Actif</span>'
        : '<span class="badge" style="background:#e74c3c;color:#fff;font-size:10px">Inactif</span>';
      const lastLogin = u.last_login ? u.last_login.replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16) : '—';
      const isSelf = state.user && state.user.id === u.id;
      return `<tr style="${!u.is_active ? 'opacity:0.5' : ''}">
        <td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--text-xs)">${u.id}</td>
        <td><strong>${esc(u.username)}</strong></td>
        <td class="text-muted" style="font-size:var(--text-xs)">${esc(u.email)}</td>
        <td style="font-size:var(--text-xs)">${esc(u.full_name || '—')}</td>
        <td>${roleBadge}</td>
        <td>${statusBadge}</td>
        <td class="mono" style="font-size:var(--text-xs)">${lastLogin}</td>
        <td>
          <div style="display:flex;gap:4px">
            <select class="input-field" style="font-size:10px;padding:2px 4px;min-width:80px" 
              onchange="adminChangeRole(${u.id}, this.value)" ${isSelf ? 'disabled' : ''}>
              <option value="viewer" ${u.role === 'viewer' ? 'selected' : ''}>Viewer</option>
              <option value="analyst" ${u.role === 'analyst' ? 'selected' : ''}>Analyst</option>
              <option value="manager" ${u.role === 'manager' ? 'selected' : ''}>Manager</option>
              <option value="admin" ${u.role === 'admin' ? 'selected' : ''}>Admin</option>
            </select>
            ${!isSelf ? `<button class="btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:2px 6px;border:1px solid var(--border)" 
              onclick="adminToggleActive(${u.id}, ${u.is_active ? 0 : 1})">
              ${u.is_active ? 'Désactiver' : 'Réactiver'}
            </button>` : '<span class="text-muted" style="font-size:10px">(vous)</span>'}
          </div>
        </td>
      </tr>`;
    }).join('');
  } catch (e) {
    // If 403 (not admin), show message
    const tbody = document.getElementById('adminUsersBody');
    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" class="text-muted" style="text-align:center;padding:var(--space-4);color:#e74c3c">Accès refusé — rôle admin requis</td></tr>';
  }
}

function _adminRoleBadge(role) {
  const colors = {
    viewer: '#95a5a6', analyst: '#20808D', manager: '#e67e22', admin: '#e74c3c'
  };
  return `<span class="badge" style="background:${colors[role] || '#666'};color:#fff;font-size:10px">${role}</span>`;
}

async function adminChangeRole(userId, newRole) {
  try {
    await apiFetch('/api/admin/users/' + userId, {
      method: 'PUT',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ role: newRole }),
    });
    showToast('Rôle mis à jour', 'success');
    await loadAdminUsers();
  } catch (e) {
    showToast('Erreur : ' + e.message, 'error');
    await loadAdminUsers();
  }
}

async function adminToggleActive(userId, newState) {
  try {
    await apiFetch('/api/admin/users/' + userId, {
      method: 'PUT',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ is_active: !!newState }),
    });
